.sd-item.sd-native{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;border:2px solid #69aeca!important;overflow:hidden;align-items:stretch;justify-content:stretch}.sd-item.sd-native:before{content:attr(data-label);position:absolute;top:3px;right:3px;z-index:8;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:5px;background:#073b70;color:#fff;font:900 12px Arial;pointer-events:none}.sd-native-preview{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;background:#fff}.sd-native-preview>*{margin:0!important;max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}.sd-native-preview .report-view,.sd-native-preview .screen-designer,.sd-native-preview .screen-custom-layer{display:none!important}.sd-native-preview .brand-asset{display:block!important}.native-layout-active>.brand-asset,.native-layout-active>.quick-filters,.native-layout-active>.top-tools,.native-layout-active>#cards{margin:0!important;box-sizing:border-box}.sd-native-note{grid-column:1/-1;padding:8px;border:1px solid #82b4cd;border-radius:7px;background:#e5f5fc;color:#174b68;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}

/* Keep the system-tools dropdown above the work cards in the editable native layout. */
.native-layout-active>.top-tools{overflow:visible!important;z-index:100!important;isolation:isolate}
.native-layout-active>.top-tools details{z-index:110!important}
.native-layout-active>.top-tools .report-tools-menu{z-index:1000!important;top:42px!important;bottom:auto!important}

/* Live native components must match the exact box shown in the visual designer. */
.native-layout-active>.brand-asset{max-width:none!important}
.native-layout-active>.brand-asset>img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:fill!important}

/* Custom images must fill the exact rectangle set in the designer on the live screen. */
.screen-live-item.sd-image{overflow:hidden!important;line-height:0}
.screen-live-item.sd-image>img{
  display:block!important;
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  min-width:100%!important;
  max-width:none!important;
  max-height:none!important;
  margin:0!important;
  object-fit:fill!important;
  object-position:center!important;
}

/* Center the complete 1600px designed workspace inside the browser viewport. */
.app.native-layout-active{margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important}

/* Existing-control styling and dual desktop/mobile designer. */
.sd-device-label{background:#e4f4fb;border:1px solid #75b8d7;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 8px!important;font-weight:900}.sd-device-label select{border:0;background:transparent;color:#073b70;font-weight:900}.sd-control-editor{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:2px solid #8bbdd4;margin-top:4px;padding-top:10px}.sd-control-editor h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:#073b70}.sd-control-editor .control-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.sd-control-editor label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.sd-control-editor .wide{grid-column:1/-1}.sd-control-editor button{min-height:36px;border:1px solid #8eb9cf;border-radius:7px;background:#fff;color:#073b70;font-weight:900}.sd-mobile-badge{position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;z-index:9999;background:#0a79bd;color:#fff;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:900;pointer-events:none}

/* Stage 6 desktop redesign based on the supplied visual reference. */
:root{--ui-navy:#061b52;--ui-blue:#0c78bd;--ui-cyan:#11d6e9;--ui-bg:#f4fafc}
html,body,button,input,select,textarea{font-family:"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial,sans-serif!important}
body{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0,#f1f8fb 45%,#e9f3f7 100%);font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.01em}
button,summary,select{font-weight:700}.app{color:#102f48}.quick-filters{gap:5px;align-items:start;justify-content:flex-end;padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(239,246,249,.94);border-top:14px solid #dfe8ec}
.quick-filters>.quick-filter>summary,.quick-filters>#clearQuickFilters,.quick-filters>#viewModeToggle{background:#030303!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #12cfe5!important;border-radius:10px!important;min-height:42px!important;font-size:16px!important;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(7,59,112,.15)!important}
.quick-filters .upload-visible>summary{background:#087fc4!important}.quick-filters #viewModeToggle{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;position:relative!important;z-index:25!important}
.native-layout-active>.quick-filters{overflow:visible!important;min-height:58px!important;height:auto!important}
.quick-filter-panel{z-index:500;background:#fff;border:2px solid #16cce1;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(3,37,65,.22)}
.department-nav{gap:10px}.department-nav .dept-jump{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#f4f4fb)!important;color:#111979!important;border:3px solid #12d3e6!important;border-radius:9px!important;min-height:62px!important;font-size:17px!important;box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(7,59,112,.12)!important}.department-nav .dept-jump span{font-size:12px;color:#657e91}
.top-tools>details>summary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#118bcf,#0870b1)!important;color:#fff!important;border:0!important;border-radius:9px!important;min-height:42px!important}
.department-box{background:#eef7fb;border:1px solid #a9c8d8;border-radius:17px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(7,59,112,.08)}.department-box>header{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d4c83,#0c80c8);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px}.department-box>header h2{font-size:21px;font-weight:800}.department-box>header span{background:#356c9c;border-radius:16px;padding:7px 12px;font-weight:800}
.department-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;align-items:start}
.work-card.tabbed-work-card{height:620px;min-height:620px;max-height:620px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid #b9d4df;border-top:5px solid #38a1ff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(7,59,112,.1)}
.work-card.tabbed-work-card.immediate{border-top-color:#ef2934}.work-card.tabbed-work-card.today{border-top-color:#ff9f13}.work-card.tabbed-work-card.tomorrow{border-top-color:#12ad81}.work-card.tabbed-work-card.night{border-top-color:#1457b8}
.card-tabs.card-tabs-top{order:-1;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:0;background:#edf7fb;padding:7px 7px 0;gap:4px;flex:0 0 auto}.card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab{display:block!important;min-height:39px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#164260!important;border:1px solid #9fc7d8!important;border-bottom:3px solid transparent!important;border-radius:9px 9px 0 0!important;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:800!important}.card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab.active{background:#087fc4!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#087fc4!important;border-bottom-color:#12d6e8!important;box-shadow:0 -2px 10px rgba(8,127,196,.18)!important}
.card-pane-stack{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}.card-pane{height:100%;overflow:auto;padding:10px;background:#fff}.card-pane.hidden{display:none!important}.general-pane{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.general-pane .card-head{padding:0}.general-pane .summary{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;padding:0}.card-head .ids{gap:5px}.card-head .id,.datum{background:#f3f8fa;border:1px solid #d7e8ee;border-radius:8px}.desc{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#12354e}.detail-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.datum b{color:#557185;font-size:12px}.datum div{font-size:14px}
/* Restore operational-priority colors, regardless of generic button designer settings. */
#cards .quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:5px;margin-top:auto}#cards .quick button{min-height:40px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:9px!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:900!important;box-shadow:none!important}#cards .quick .q-immediate{background:#ee2934!important}#cards .quick .q-today{background:#f6a313!important}#cards .quick .q-tomorrow{background:#12aa80!important}#cards .quick .q-night{background:#1457b8!important}#cards .quick button.selected{outline:3px solid #071d4e!important;outline-offset:2px;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.rows-table-wrap{border:1px solid #9fc7d8;border-radius:12px;overflow:auto;background:#fff}.rows-table th{background:#0b5f9b;color:#fff;font-size:14px}.rows-table td{font-size:14px}.rows-table .row-actions button{color:#fff!important}
#viewModeToggle.active{background:#0a7fc3!important;color:#fff!important}
@media(max-width:1100px){.department-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:600px){body{font-size:14px}.quick-filters{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;gap:6px!important;padding:5px!important}.quick-filters>*{width:100%!important}.department-nav{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}.department-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.work-card.tabbed-work-card{height:650px;min-height:650px;max-height:650px}.card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab{font-size:13px!important;padding:5px 2px!important}.detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.department-box{padding:6px}.department-box>header h2{font-size:18px}#cards .quick button{font-size:13px!important;padding:4px!important}.native-layout-active>.quick-filters{height:auto!important;overflow:visible!important}}

/* Stage 7: top-edge system tools, half-height cards, restored rows toggle. */
.native-layout-active>.top-tools{overflow:visible!important}
.top-tools>details{position:absolute!important;top:8px!important;left:8px!important;right:auto!important;z-index:1300!important}
.top-tools>details>summary{min-width:124px!important;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(4,39,70,.24)!important}
.top-tools .report-tools-menu{left:0!important;right:auto!important;top:46px!important}
.row-view-top{display:inline-flex!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:178px!important;min-height:42px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#075985!important;border:2px solid #0ea5d4!important;border-radius:9px!important;font-weight:900!important;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(4,39,70,.17)!important}
.row-view-top.active{background:#087fc4!important;color:#fff!important}
.work-card.tabbed-work-card{height:310px!important;min-height:310px!important;max-height:310px!important}
.card-tabs.card-tabs-top{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)) minmax(135px,1.25fr)!important;align-items:end}
.card-tabs.card-tabs-top .improvement-opportunity{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:39px!important;height:39px!important;padding:5px 8px!important;border:1px solid #d59b00!important;border-bottom:3px solid #f1b900!important;border-radius:9px 9px 0 0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8cf,#ffd75a)!important;color:#624300!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:900!important;box-shadow:0 -2px 10px rgba(213,155,0,.18)!important;cursor:pointer}
.card-tabs.card-tabs-top .improvement-opportunity:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff4b0,#ffc928)!important;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.general-pane .summary{overflow:auto}.general-pane .card-head{flex:0 0 auto}.general-pane .quick{flex:0 0 auto}
@media(max-width:600px){.top-tools>details{top:4px!important;left:4px!important}.row-view-top{top:4px!important;left:132px!important;min-width:150px!important;font-size:12px!important}.work-card.tabbed-work-card{height:330px!important;min-height:330px!important;max-height:330px!important}.card-tabs.card-tabs-top{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important}.card-tabs.card-tabs-top .improvement-opportunity{grid-column:1/-1;border-radius:7px!important;height:34px!important;min-height:34px!important}.card-pane-stack{min-height:0}}


/* כלי המערכת ותצוגת השורות הם רכיבי מסך עצמאיים, מחוץ לתיבת המחלקות. */
.app.native-layout-active>#systemTools,.app.native-layout-active>#rowViewTop{margin:0!important;box-sizing:border-box}
.app.native-layout-active>#systemTools{overflow:visible!important;isolation:isolate}
#systemTools>summary{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;min-height:42px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#118bcf,#0870b1)!important;color:#fff!important;border:0!important;border-radius:9px!important;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(4,39,70,.24)!important;cursor:pointer}
#systemTools>.report-tools-menu{position:absolute!important;top:calc(100% + 4px)!important;left:0!important;right:auto!important;z-index:5000!important}
#rowViewTop{width:100%;height:100%}
@media(max-width:600px){#systemTools>summary,#rowViewTop{min-height:38px!important;font-size:12px!important}}


/* סטאטוס אוטומטי: נגזר אך ורק מסטטוס ההיתר ומרשימת סטטוסי ההזמנה הסגורים. */
.auto-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:105px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid transparent}
.auto-status.auto-done{background:#7b858d;color:#fff;border-color:#626b72}
.auto-status.auto-treatment{background:#dff3ff;color:#075b91;border-color:#39a7df}
.auto-status.auto-pending{background:#f3f6f8;color:#536775;border-color:#bac8d0}
.auto-status.auto-request,.permit-status.permit-request{background:#ff202d!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #a8000b!important;animation:tovatiRequestRedBlink .72s steps(1,end) infinite!important}
.rows-table tbody tr.row-completed>td{background:#e1e5e8!important;color:#626b72!important;border-color:#c3cbd0!important}
.rows-table tbody tr.row-completed:hover>td{background:#d5dade!important}
.rows-table tbody tr.row-completed .auto-status.auto-done{background:#68727a!important;color:#fff!important}
@keyframes tovatiRequestRedBlink{0%,48%,100%{background:#ff202d;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 4px #ff202d,0 0 13px rgba(255,0,18,.8);transform:scale(1)}49%,99%{background:#780008;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 16px #ff0012,0 0 30px rgba(255,0,18,1);transform:scale(1.08)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.auto-status.auto-request,.permit-status.permit-request{animation:none!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,32,45,.25)!important}}


.notification-datetime{display:inline-block;direction:ltr;unicode-bidi:isolate;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.worker-cell{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:180px}
.worker-free-text{width:100%;min-width:175px;min-height:64px;resize:vertical;border:1px solid #168bd4;border-radius:7px;padding:7px;background:#fff;color:#14324b;font:inherit}
.transfer-department-select{width:100%;min-width:175px;height:34px;border:1px solid #168bd4;border-radius:7px;background:#fff;color:#14324b;padding:0 7px;font-weight:800}
.quick-filter.is-active>summary{background:#087fc4!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #11d6e9,0 4px 12px rgba(8,121,201,.28)!important}
.quick-filter-panel input[type="date"],.quick-filter-panel select{cursor:pointer}


.working-filter-toolbar{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,1fr) minmax(180px,1.15fr) minmax(145px,.9fr) minmax(145px,.9fr) auto auto minmax(200px,1.3fr) auto auto;gap:9px!important;align-items:end!important;padding:10px 12px!important;background:#eef7fb!important;border:1px solid #9bc8dd!important;border-radius:12px!important;overflow:visible!important;min-height:76px!important;height:auto!important}
.working-filter-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0}.working-filter-field label{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#073b70}.working-filter-field select,.working-filter-field input{display:block!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;height:42px!important;border:2px solid #0ba8d5!important;border-radius:8px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#102f48!important;padding:0 10px!important;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:800!important;opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;pointer-events:auto!important}
.working-date-field input{direction:ltr;text-align:center}.working-apply,.working-clear{height:42px!important;min-width:112px!important;display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:auto!important}.working-apply{background:#0879c9!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #075e9b!important}.working-clear{background:#fff!important;color:#a10b18!important;border:2px solid #d62736!important}.working-filter-status{align-self:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#526b7b;line-height:1.4}.working-filter-toolbar.has-active-filter{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(17,214,233,.25)!important}.working-filter-toolbar.has-active-filter .working-filter-status{color:#075e9b}.working-filter-toolbar>.upload-visible,.working-filter-toolbar>#viewModeToggle{align-self:end}.working-filter-toolbar>.upload-visible>summary,.working-filter-toolbar>#viewModeToggle{height:42px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important}
@media(max-width:1200px){.working-filter-toolbar{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(150px,1fr))}.working-filter-status{grid-column:span 2}}
@media(max-width:700px){.working-filter-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}.working-filter-status{grid-column:1/-1}.working-filter-toolbar>.upload-visible,.working-filter-toolbar>#viewModeToggle{width:100%!important}}


/* המסננים חייבים להופיע מתחת ללוגו ולתפריט המחלקות, גם אם קיימת פריסה ישנה ב-localStorage. */
.app.native-layout-active>#workingFilterToolbar{z-index:80!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;pointer-events:auto!important;overflow:visible!important}
.app.native-layout-active>#workingFilterToolbar *{pointer-events:auto}


.permit-ticker{direction:rtl;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:42px;padding:5px 10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#087fc4,#066aa9);border:2px solid #19c7e7;border-radius:10px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(7,59,112,.18);overflow:hidden}
.permit-ticker-title{flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;z-index:2;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:#073b70;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.permit-ticker-window{direction:ltr;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.permit-ticker-track{display:inline-flex;direction:rtl;align-items:center;gap:18px;width:max-content;animation:permitTickerRun 380s linear infinite;will-change:transform}
.permit-ticker:hover .permit-ticker-track{animation-play-state:paused}
.permit-ticker-item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);color:#163c56;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.permit-ticker-item b{padding:2px 7px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff}
.permit-ticker-item.ticker-outside b{background:#079447}.permit-ticker-item.ticker-request b{background:#e5292f;animation:permitTickerRequestBlink .9s steps(2,end) infinite}
@keyframes permitTickerRun{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@keyframes permitTickerRequestBlink{50%{background:#7f1d1d;box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff4b50}}
.native-layout-active>#permitTicker,.native-layout-active>#workingFilterToolbar{margin:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}
@media(max-width:600px){.permit-ticker{height:72px;align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.permit-ticker-title{text-align:center;font-size:12px}.permit-ticker-track{animation-duration:280s}.permit-ticker-item{font-size:11px}}


.table-layout-editor{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(330px,520px) 1fr;gap:14px;min-height:0;overflow:auto}
.table-column-palette,.table-layout-preview{background:#fff;border:1px solid #b5cad5;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;overflow:auto}
.table-column-palette h3,.table-layout-preview h3{margin:0 0 10px;color:#073b70}
.table-column-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.table-column-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 34px minmax(0,1fr) 105px;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px;border:1px solid #abc5d2;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#edf5f8)}
.table-column-item.dragging{opacity:.45}.table-column-item.hidden-column{opacity:.62;background:#f2f3f4}
.table-column-grip{font-size:20px;color:#4f7e96;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none}.table-column-grip:active{cursor:grabbing}.table-column-position{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#0879c9;color:#fff;font-weight:900}
.table-column-item label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-weight:900;color:#153f59}.table-column-source{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#6d8492;font-weight:400;margin-top:2px}
.table-column-title-control{grid-column:3/-1;display:grid!important;gap:3px!important;font-size:11px!important;color:#526f80!important}.table-column-title-control input{width:100%;height:32px;border:1px solid #168bd4;border-radius:6px;padding:0 7px;background:#fff;color:#14324b;font-weight:800}.table-column-title-control input::placeholder{color:#8ca0ac;font-weight:400}.table-column-width-control{grid-column:3;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:auto 24px;gap:4px!important;align-items:center!important;font-size:11px!important;color:#526f80!important}.table-column-width-control input{grid-row:2;width:76px;height:32px;border:1px solid #8fb5c6;border-radius:6px;padding:0 6px;color:#14324b;font-weight:900}.table-column-width-control span{grid-row:2;color:#6d8492}.table-column-actions{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;align-items:end;gap:5px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #c9dce5}.table-column-actions label{display:grid!important;gap:2px!important;font-size:10px!important;color:#526f80!important}.table-column-actions input{width:62px;height:32px;border:1px solid #168bd4;border-radius:6px;padding:0 5px;text-align:center;font-weight:900}.table-column-actions button{width:auto;min-width:0;height:32px;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid #69a9c3;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#174a69;cursor:pointer;font-weight:900;font-size:12px}.table-column-actions button:hover{background:#dff5fb;border-color:#0879c9}
.table-column-actions button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:not-allowed}
.table-preview-scroll{overflow:auto;border:1px solid #afc5d0;border-radius:9px}.table-layout-preview table{border-collapse:collapse;min-width:max-content;width:100%}.table-layout-preview th,.table-layout-preview td{padding:9px;border-left:1px solid #d3e1e7;border-bottom:1px solid #d3e1e7;white-space:nowrap}.table-layout-preview th{background:#176da6;color:#fff}.table-layout-preview td{background:#f8fbfc;color:#526f80}
.table-layout-hint{margin:0 0 10px;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;background:#e8f5fb;color:#24566f;font-weight:700}.table-layout-status-active{color:#087a55}
@media(max-width:900px){.table-layout-editor{grid-template-columns:1fr}.table-column-bulk{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


.screen-designer-fixed-button{position:fixed!important;left:18px!important;bottom:18px!important;right:auto!important;top:auto!important;display:flex!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;min-width:142px!important;height:48px!important;padding:0 16px!important;border:2px solid #56d5f0!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#087fc4,#055b96)!important;color:#fff!important;font:900 15px Arial,sans-serif!important;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,38,76,.38)!important;z-index:2147483000!important;cursor:pointer!important;isolation:isolate!important}

body:has(#screenDesigner:not(.designer-hidden)) .screen-designer-fixed-button{display:none!important}

.rows-table tbody tr{cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .15s ease,transform .15s ease,background .15s ease}

.rows-table tbody tr:focus{outline:3px solid #19b7dc;outline-offset:-3px}
.row-detail-overlay{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;z-index:2100000000!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;padding:24px!important;background:rgba(3,27,50,.72)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);direction:rtl}
.row-detail-dialog{position:relative;width:min(1120px,96vw);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;background:#eef7fa;border:2px solid #40c6e6;border-radius:18px;padding:58px 16px 16px;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}

.row-detail-dialog .card-pane-stack{min-height:0!important}.row-detail-dialog .card-pane{overflow:auto!important}
body.row-detail-open{overflow:hidden!important}.row-detail-open .screen-designer-fixed-button,.row-detail-open .editor-hub{display:none!important}.row-detail-open .app>:not(#cards){visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}.row-detail-open #cards>.department-box{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}.row-detail-open #cards>.row-detail-overlay{visibility:visible!important;pointer-events:auto!important}
@media(max-width:600px){.row-detail-overlay{padding:7px!important}.row-detail-dialog{width:100%;max-height:96vh;padding:52px 7px 7px;border-radius:12px}.row-detail-title{font-size:16px;right:12px}.row-detail-close{left:7px;min-width:82px}.row-detail-dialog .work-card.tabbed-work-card{height:760px!important;min-height:760px!important;max-height:760px!important}}

.editor-hub{position:fixed!important;left:18px!important;bottom:76px!important;right:auto!important;top:auto!important;z-index:2147483001!important;width:min(330px,calc(100vw - 36px));padding:10px;background:#fff;border:2px solid #36c0e2;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,35,70,.42);direction:rtl}
.editor-hub.hidden{display:none!important}.editor-hub header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 3px 10px;color:#073b70;font-size:17px}.editor-hub header button{width:32px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#b91c1c;color:#fff;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}
.editor-hub>button[data-editor-action]{display:flex;width:100%;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:3px;margin:6px 0;padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid #9bc7d8;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#edf8fc);color:#123f5b;text-align:right;cursor:pointer}

.table-column-bulk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;margin-bottom:9px}.table-column-bulk button{padding:8px;border:1px solid #5caeca;border-radius:8px;background:#e7f7fb;color:#075985;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.table-column-bulk button:hover{background:#cceff8}
.table-column-list{max-height:58vh;overflow:auto;padding-left:3px}.table-column-item[hidden]{display:none!important}


/* Phone layout: normal document flow instead of the desktop designer canvas. */
.mobile-only{display:none!important}
#mobileBackdrop,#mobileToast{display:none}
@media (max-width:1024px){
  :root{--mobile-gap:10px;--mobile-ink:#113b58}
  html{width:100%;overflow-x:hidden;scroll-padding-top:12px;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
  body{width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:0;background:#eef5fa!important;color:var(--mobile-ink);font-size:16px!important;overflow-x:hidden!important}
  .mobile-only{display:block!important}
  button,summary,select,a{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  button:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0ba8d5!important;outline-offset:3px}
  input,select,textarea{font-size:16px!important}
  .app,.app.native-layout-active{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;grid-template-areas:'brand brand brand' 'ticker ticker ticker' 'heading heading heading' 'filterbutton rows system' 'search search search' 'depart depart depart' 'filters filters filters' 'cards cards cards'!important;gap:10px!important;align-items:start!important;width:100%!important;max-width:800px!important;height:auto!important;min-height:100dvh!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:8px 12px max(28px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;position:relative!important;transform:none!important;background:#eef5fa!important;overflow:visible!important}
  .app>.brand-asset,.app>#permitTicker,.app>#systemTools,.app>#rowViewTop,.app>.top-tools,.app>#workingFilterToolbar,.app>#cards{position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;transform:none!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;margin:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}
  .app>*{min-width:0}
  .app>.brand-asset{grid-area:brand;display:block!important;z-index:1!important;overflow:hidden!important;min-height:0!important}
  .app.native-layout-active>.brand-asset>img,.app>.brand-asset>img{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:110px!important;object-fit:contain!important;display:block!important}
  .app>#permitTicker{grid-area:ticker;display:flex!important;height:32px!important;min-height:32px!important;padding:0!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;border:0!important;border-radius:9px!important;box-shadow:none!important;background:#deedf6!important;overflow:hidden!important;z-index:1!important}
  .permit-ticker-title{background:transparent!important;color:#235575!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.4!important;padding:0 6px!important;text-align:center;white-space:normal!important}
  .permit-ticker-window{display:none!important}
  #mobileHeading{grid-area:heading;display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:3px 0}
  #mobileHeading h1{font-size:23px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.4px;margin:0;color:#093e67}
  #mobileResultCount{white-space:nowrap;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c9e0ed;color:#225b7c;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
  .app>#systemTools{grid-area:system;z-index:1200!important;overflow:visible!important;display:block!important;height:46px!important}
  .app>#rowViewTop{grid-area:rows;display:flex!important;z-index:5!important;min-width:0!important;height:46px!important;min-height:46px!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  #mobileFilterToggle{grid-area:filterbutton;display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;height:46px!important;min-width:0!important;position:relative}
  #mobileFilterToggle,#systemTools>summary,#rowViewTop{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.2!important;padding:6px!important;white-space:normal!important;border:1px solid #93bfda!important;border-radius:11px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#0c5686!important;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(20,64,93,.05)!important;min-height:46px!important;height:46px!important;min-width:0!important;font-weight:800!important}
  #mobileFilterToggle svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
  #mobileFilterToggle[aria-expanded='true'],#mobileFilterToggle.has-filters,#rowViewTop.active{background:#087ac1!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#087ac1!important}
  #systemTools>summary{list-style:none;display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  #systemTools>summary::marker,#systemTools>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  #systemTools>.report-tools-menu{position:fixed!important;inset:auto 12px max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;z-index:1300!important;width:auto!important;min-width:0!important;max-height:82vh!important;max-height:82dvh!important;overflow:auto!important;padding:12px!important;border:1px solid #c4dce9!important;border-radius:18px!important;box-shadow:0 16px 60px rgba(0,34,66,.25)!important}
  #mobileToolsHeading{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 0 10px;gap:8px;font-size:19px;color:#073b70}
  #mobileCloseTools{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#edf3f8;color:#34546c;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
  #systemTools .report-tools-menu>.btn{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%!important;min-height:48px!important;height:auto!important;padding:10px!important;margin:7px 0!important;font-size:16px!important;white-space:normal}
  #systemTools .report-tools-menu>[data-toggle-compact],#systemTools .report-tools-menu>[data-open-screen-designer]{display:none!important}
  #mobileSourceStatus{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.5;margin:12px 2px 0;color:#546e80;font-weight:500}
  body.mobile-menu-open #mobileBackdrop{display:block;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,34,55,.48);z-index:1100;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
  body.mobile-menu-open{overflow:hidden!important}
  #mobileSearchBar{grid-area:search;display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid #b1cfe1;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:0 12px;min-height:48px}
  #mobileSearchBar>svg{width:19px;height:19px;color:#557a94;flex:none}
  #mobileSearch{height:46px;min-width:0;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0 0 0 3px;color:#183e5c;outline:none!important;font-weight:500!important}
  #mobileSearch::placeholder{color:#71899b;font-size:14px}
  #mobileClearSearch{flex:none;width:38px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#5d7c92;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
  #mobileClearSearch[hidden]{display:none!important}

  .mode-choice.active .choice-check{opacity:1;color:#0576af}
  #mobileWorkspace #mobileSearchBar{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;position:static!important;width:100%!important;min-height:48px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid #9cc5df;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);box-shadow:0 4px 14px #16486c0a;margin:0}

}

/* Live permit strip. The data remains the imported permit report, not card filtering. */
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-window{display:block!important;min-width:0;overflow:hidden!important;direction:ltr}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-track{
  display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;direction:ltr!important;
  align-items:center;gap:0!important;width:max-content!important;
  animation:tovatiPermitScroll var(--permit-run-time,360s) linear infinite!important;
  animation-play-state:running!important;will-change:transform
}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-group{display:flex;direction:ltr;align-items:center;flex:none;gap:12px;padding-right:12px}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-item{direction:rtl;flex:none;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-item b{animation:none!important}
#permitTicker.ticker-paused .permit-ticker-track{animation-play-state:paused!important}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-pause{
  display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 30px;width:30px;height:30px;min-height:30px;
  padding:5px;border:1px solid #c1d9e8;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#226486;cursor:pointer
}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-pause svg{width:15px;height:15px}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-empty{direction:rtl;font-size:12px;color:#496d82}
#permitTicker.ticker-empty .permit-ticker-track{animation:none!important;transform:none!important}
@keyframes tovatiPermitScroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
#cards .priority-collapsed-row{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){
  .app.native-layout-active>#permitTicker,.app>#permitTicker{
    grid-area:ticker;display:flex!important;position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;
    flex-direction:row!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;
    gap:7px!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;
    height:40px!important;min-height:40px!important;max-height:40px!important;margin:0!important;
    padding:4px 6px!important;overflow:hidden!important;border:1px solid #c4dce9!important;
    border-radius:11px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8fcff,#eaf5fc)!important;
    box-shadow:0 3px 10px #194f7510!important;color:#174c6c!important;z-index:1!important
  }
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-title{
    display:block!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:800!important;
    line-height:1.2!important;padding:2px 4px!important;background:transparent!important;
    color:#19557b!important;white-space:nowrap!important
  }
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-window{display:block!important;flex:1!important;width:0!important;height:30px!important;line-height:30px}
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-track{height:30px!important}
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-item{height:27px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.3;border:1px solid #d1e4ef;background:#fff}
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-item b{font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;padding:2px 5px}
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box .work-card.tabbed-work-card.priority-folded{
    height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;
    padding:0!important;gap:0!important;border-radius:12px!important;overflow:hidden!important
  }
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box .work-card.tabbed-work-card.priority-folded>:not(.priority-collapsed-row){display:none!important}
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box .work-card.tabbed-work-card.priority-folded>.priority-collapsed-row{
    display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;order:0;flex:none;
    width:100%;min-width:0;height:44px;min-height:44px;margin:0;padding:9px 12px;
    border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#153f5d;text-align:right;
    font:700 15px/1.4 "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer
  }
  .app #cards .priority-collapsed-row>span{display:block;min-width:0;width:100%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .app #cards .priority-collapsed-row:focus-visible{outline-offset:-3px!important}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #permitTicker:not(.ticker-motion-enabled) .permit-ticker-track{animation:none!important;transform:none!important;will-change:auto}
  #permitTicker:not(.ticker-motion-enabled) .permit-ticker-window{overflow-x:auto!important;scrollbar-width:thin}
  #permitTicker:not(.ticker-motion-enabled) .permit-ticker-group[aria-hidden="true"]{display:none}
}


/* New top menu only. The banner, ticker, cards and existing navigation retain their styling. */
#tovatiTopNav{box-sizing:border-box;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));align-items:center;width:100%;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:2px 12px;min-height:53px;direction:rtl;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,#f8fcff);border-bottom:1px solid #e4edf3;color:#386783}
#tovatiTopNav button{appearance:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-width:0;min-height:48px;padding:3px 5px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
#tovatiTopNav .tovati-top-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:27px;border-radius:9px}
#tovatiTopNav svg{width:22px;height:22px;flex:none}
#tovatiTopNav .tovati-top-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;white-space:nowrap}
#tovatiTopNav button[aria-expanded="true"],#tovatiTopNav button:active{color:#0879b4;background:#edf8ff}
#tovatiTopNav button[aria-expanded="true"] .tovati-top-icon{background:#e0f3ff}
#tovatiTopNav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0ba8d5;outline-offset:-2px}
@media(hover:hover){#tovatiTopNav button:hover{background:#f0f8fc;color:#0879b4}}
@media(min-width:1025px){#tovatiTopNav{max-width:1600px;width:calc(100% - 32px)}}
#tovatiTopPanel{box-sizing:border-box;position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;width:min(540px,calc(100vw - 24px));max-width:100%;max-height:80vh;max-height:80dvh;padding:0;border:1px solid #c5dce9;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;color:#173e59;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #163e613d;direction:rtl;overflow:hidden;z-index:2147483502}
#tovatiTopPanel:not([open]){display:none!important}
#tovatiTopPanel[open]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#tovatiTopPanel::backdrop{background:rgba(12,36,54,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex:none;padding:12px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid #e0ebf3;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f5faff)}
#tovatiTopPanel h2{margin:0;font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#143f5d}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-close{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;flex:none;border:1px solid #d2e3ed;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#436e87;cursor:pointer}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-close svg{width:20px;height:20px}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-close[hidden]{display:none!important}
#tovatiTopPanelContent{padding:14px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;min-height:0;flex:1}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-intro{margin:0 0 13px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#627e90}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-section{margin:0 0 17px}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-section h3{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:#245573}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-section h3 b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#0a6aa0}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-list{display:grid;gap:8px}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-item{box-sizing:border-box;display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;text-align:right;border:1px solid #d5e4ed;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f8fbfd);padding:11px 12px;color:#244d69;font:inherit}
#tovatiTopPanel button.top-panel-item{cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
#tovatiTopPanel button.top-panel-item:hover{border-color:#8bbbd8;background:#f1f9ff}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-item-meta{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#658297;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:5px}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-item-title{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-item-note{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:8px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;border-top:1px solid #e0ebf2;padding-top:8px;color:#2e5a76}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-empty{padding:20px 14px;border:1px dashed #c5dbe9;border-radius:13px;text-align:center;background:#fbfdff;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#5c7c91}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;margin-top:18px}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-actions button{flex:1;min-height:44px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #b8d4e5;border-radius:11px;background:#f7fbfd;color:#265d7e;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-actions .top-primary{background:#0879b7;color:#fff;border-color:#0879b7}
#tovatiTopPanel .top-exit-info{padding:12px;border:1px solid #d7e7f0;border-radius:12px;background:#f4faff;color:#54778e;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}
body.tovati-top-panel-open{overflow:hidden!important}
body.tovati-local-exited>.app,body.tovati-local-exited>#tovatiTopNav,body.tovati-local-exited>#mobileBottomNav,body.tovati-local-exited>#mobileWorkspace{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
@media print{#tovatiTopNav,#tovatiTopPanel{display:none!important}}


@media(max-width:1024px){
  /* Expanded cards retain the existing separation; adjacent folded rows sit 4px apart. */
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box>.department-cards{row-gap:0!important}
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box>.department-cards>.work-card+.work-card{margin-top:20px!important}
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box>.department-cards>.work-card.priority-folded+.work-card.priority-folded{margin-top:4px!important}
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box .work-card.priority-folded{border-radius:8px!important;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #13436312!important}
  body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards .priority-collapsed-row,
  body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards [data-op],
  body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards .row-actions,
  body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards .work-priority-editor,
  body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards [data-manual="operational"]{display:none!important}
}


/* Pilot modules are namespaced; the approved work-card layout is preserved. */
:root{--p-ink:#173f59;--p-muted:#66808f;--p-blue:#087bb5;--p-line:#d4e2ea;--p-soft:#eff7fb;--p-shadow:0 7px 24px #143e5b0b;--p-radius:17px}
#pilotShell[hidden],#pilotModal[hidden],.p-hidden{display:none!important}
#pilotShell{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1700;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f4f8fa);color:var(--p-ink);display:flex;flex-direction:column;direction:rtl;font:15px/1.5 "Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
body.pilot-open{overflow:hidden!important}body.pilot-open>.app{pointer-events:none}body.row-detail-open #pilotShell{visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.p-shell-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-right));border-bottom:1px solid var(--p-line);background:#ffffffee;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);flex:none}
.p-shell-head h1{margin:0;font-size:22px;line-height:1.3}.p-shell-head .p-subtitle{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--p-muted)}
.p-shell-title{flex:1;min-width:0}.p-shell-head button,.p-icon-btn{border:1px solid var(--p-line);background:#fff;border-radius:12px;min-height:44px;min-width:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#39677f;cursor:pointer}
.p-shell-head svg,.p-icon-btn svg,.p-btn svg,.p-schedule-card svg{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none}
#pilotContent{flex:1;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:16px max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));min-height:0}
.p-inner{width:100%;max-width:1180px;margin:auto}.p-local-bar{padding:5px 14px;background:#eff8fc;color:#406b80;border-bottom:1px solid #d8e9f0;font-size:11px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex:none}
#pilotStorageWarning{display:none;padding:9px 13px;background:#fff0e7;color:#8f3513;border-bottom:1px solid #e8b89f;font-size:12px}body.pilot-volatile #pilotStorageWarning{display:block}
.p-card{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#fbfdff);border:1px solid var(--p-line);border-radius:var(--p-radius);padding:15px;box-shadow:var(--p-shadow);min-width:0;margin-bottom:12px}
.p-card h2,.p-card h3{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:18px}.p-card p{margin:7px 0;color:var(--p-muted)}
.p-intro{margin:0 0 15px;color:var(--p-muted);font-size:13px}.p-empty{padding:24px 15px;text-align:center;color:var(--p-muted);background:#fff;border:1px dashed #bccfdb;border-radius:15px;line-height:1.8}
.p-empty strong{display:block;color:var(--p-ink);font-size:17px}.p-empty .p-btn{margin-top:12px}.p-muted{color:var(--p-muted);font-size:12px}.p-alert-note{padding:10px 12px;background:#fff8e9;border:1px solid #ecd9ac;border-radius:11px;color:#795d22;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin:10px 0}
.p-success-note{background:#edf9f2;border-color:#b8dbc6;color:#236947}.p-error{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #e5b5b5;border-radius:10px;background:#fff1f1;color:#a02530;line-height:1.6;font-size:13px;white-space:pre-wrap;margin:8px 0}
.p-module-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:12px 0 16px}
#pilotContent .p-module{padding:17px 10px;min-height:144px;border:1px solid var(--p-line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff,#fcfeff);text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;color:#365b6d;cursor:pointer}
.p-module .p-module-icon{height:45px;width:45px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#eef7fa;color:#257c9f;border-radius:14px}.p-module-icon svg{width:25px;height:25px}.p-module strong{font-size:15px}.p-module small{color:#78909d;font-size:12px;font-weight:400}
.p-module:hover,.p-module:focus-visible{border-color:#439cc3;background:#f5fbff}.p-mod-badge{font-size:11px;color:#227cac;background:#e8f6fc;border-radius:15px;padding:2px 8px}
.p-toolbar,.p-row{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}.p-row.between{justify-content:space-between}.p-row>h2,.p-row>h3{margin:0}.p-toolbar .p-grow{flex:1;min-width:150px}
.p-btn{border:1px solid #b9d5e4;border-radius:11px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#f2f9fc);color:#216483;font:700 13px/1.3 "Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;min-height:42px;padding:9px 13px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;white-space:normal}
.p-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b86be,#0872a6);border-color:#0872a6;color:#fff}.p-btn.danger{background:#fff7f7;color:#a13a42;border-color:#e2c2c6}.p-btn.small{min-height:36px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px}.p-btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.p-btn:focus-visible,#pilotShell input:focus-visible,#pilotModal input:focus-visible,#pilotModal textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #36aad6;outline-offset:2px}
.p-segments{display:flex;gap:4px;background:#edf4f8;border-radius:12px;padding:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}.p-segments button{flex:1;border:0;min-height:38px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;color:#54758a;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.p-segments button.active{background:#fff;color:#096b9a;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #315e7914}
.p-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}.p-metric{border:1px solid var(--p-line);border-radius:15px;background:#fff;padding:13px;box-shadow:var(--p-shadow)}.p-metric b{display:block;font-size:28px;line-height:1.2;color:#164d6a;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.p-metric span{font-size:12px;color:#6e8795}.p-metric small{font-size:11px;color:#7b95a4;display:block;margin-top:5px}
.p-progress{width:100%;height:8px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:#e7f0f5;margin:9px 0}.p-progress>span{display:block;height:100%;background:#15a886;border-radius:20px;max-width:100%}
.p-filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:12px 0}.p-filters .p-wide{grid-column:1/-1}
#pilotShell input,#pilotShell select,#pilotShell textarea,#pilotModal input,#pilotModal select,#pilotModal textarea{box-sizing:border-box;font:400 16px/1.35 "Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;color:#173f59;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c2d7e3;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;min-width:0;max-width:100%;width:100%;min-height:43px}
#pilotShell input[type=checkbox],#pilotModal input[type=checkbox]{width:19px;height:19px;min-height:19px;accent-color:#0c88b9;flex:none}
#pilotShell input[type=date],#pilotShell input[type=time],#pilotModal input[type=date],#pilotModal input[type=time]{direction:ltr;text-align:right;min-width:0;appearance:none}
#pilotShell label,#pilotModal label{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:#587788;display:block}#pilotShell label>span,#pilotModal label>span{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.p-table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--p-line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff}.p-table{border-collapse:collapse;min-width:640px;width:100%;font-size:13px}.p-table th{background:#f0f7fa;color:#496e83;text-align:right;position:sticky;top:0}.p-table td,.p-table th{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2ebf0;vertical-align:top}.p-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}.p-table .p-table-desc{min-width:210px;max-width:320px;white-space:normal}.p-table bdi{white-space:nowrap}
.p-list{display:grid;gap:10px}.p-list-card{border:1px solid var(--p-line);border-radius:14px;padding:13px;background:#fff;min-width:0}.p-list-card h3{font-size:15px;margin:7px 0;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.p-list-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;font-size:11px;color:#678594}.p-list-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}.p-list-card .p-preview{font-size:13px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:8px 0}
.p-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:20px;padding:3px 8px;background:#edf5f9;color:#476f87;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}.p-chip.red{color:#a42d3c;background:#fff0f2}.p-chip.green{color:#15745a;background:#eaf8f0}.p-chip.orange{color:#93600a;background:#fff6dc}.p-chip.blue{color:#146494;background:#e9f5ff}
.p-dept-line{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid #e6edf2;padding:9px 0;gap:10px;font-size:13px}.p-dept-line:last-child{border:0}.p-dept-line b{font-size:17px;color:#14587c}
.p-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.p-form-grid>.p-wide{grid-column:1/-1}.p-check{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #dbe7ef;border-radius:10px;color:#335c76!important;font-size:13px!important}.p-check span{margin:0!important;display:inline!important}.p-checkboxes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;max-height:210px;overflow:auto}
#pilotModal{width:min(620px,calc(100vw - 20px));max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 20px);padding:0;border:1px solid #c8dae6;border-radius:20px;color:var(--p-ink);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 24px 80px #11395444;overflow:hidden;direction:rtl}
#pilotModal::backdrop{background:#173a5155;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}#pilotModal[open]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.p-modal-head{padding:12px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid #e0ebf2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex:none}.p-modal-head h2{margin:0;font-size:19px}.p-modal-head button{border:1px solid #d8e6f0;background:#f6fafc;border-radius:10px;color:#466f83;min-height:40px;min-width:40px;font-size:23px;cursor:pointer}.p-modal-body{padding:15px;overflow:auto;min-height:0}.p-modal-foot{padding:11px 15px;border-top:1px solid #e1ebf2;display:flex;gap:8px;flex:none;background:#fafdff}.p-modal-foot .primary{flex:1}#pilotModal textarea{min-height:90px;resize:vertical}
.p-board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(165px,1fr));gap:9px;min-width:1220px}.p-board-wrap{overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 0 10px;overscroll-behavior-x:contain}.p-day{border:1px solid #d8e4ed;border-radius:14px;min-height:240px;background:#f8fbfd;padding:8px}.p-day.today{border-color:#258fbb;background:#f1faff}.p-day-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#4c6b7b;font-size:12px}.p-day-head strong{font-size:13px}.p-day-head button{min-height:32px;min-width:32px;border:1px solid #c8dce7;background:#fff;border-radius:9px;color:#0874a7;cursor:pointer}.p-event{display:block;width:100%;text-align:right;color:#205573;border:1px solid #c3d9e8;border-right:4px solid #2a90c6;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:10px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;white-space:normal}.p-event strong{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;display:block}.p-event small{display:block;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#698699;margin-top:4px}.p-event .p-time{font-size:13px;color:#1c6d96;font-weight:800;direction:ltr;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;text-align:right}.p-event.done{border-right-color:#20a27f}.p-event.inprogress{border-right-color:#dd9914}.p-event.immediate{border-right-color:#d52f45}.p-event.today{border-right-color:#e39b1c}.p-event.tomorrow{border-right-color:#15a67f}
.p-day-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);gap:7px;margin:8px 0;align-items:start}.p-hour{color:#6b889a;font-size:12px;direction:ltr;padding:11px 0;text-align:center}.p-day-list .p-event{min-height:70px}.p-unscheduled{max-height:470px;overflow:auto;display:grid;gap:8px}.p-unscheduled .p-list-card{padding:10px}
.p-legend{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11px;color:#668599;margin:6px 0 12px}.p-legend span::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;background:#2895b8;border-radius:50%;margin-left:5px}
.p-journal{border-right:2px solid #d9e9f1;padding-right:12px}.p-journal article{padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e3edf3;font-size:13px}.p-journal time{font-size:11px;color:#7794a5;display:block}.p-comment{padding:7px 10px;margin-top:8px;background:#f4f9fc;border-radius:9px;font-size:12px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.p-tabs-scroll{overflow:auto;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;gap:7px;padding:0 0 8px;margin-bottom:10px}.p-tabs-scroll .p-btn{flex:none}.p-tabs-scroll .active{background:#e9f7ff;border-color:#1d8abc;color:#126e9d}
.p-desktop-launch{display:none}.p-schedule-card{display:none!important}body.mobile-screen-maintenance .p-schedule-card{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;border-top:1px solid #d0e3ed;padding:10px 11px;background:#ffffff9c;color:#315d78;font-size:12px}body.mobile-screen-maintenance .p-schedule-card span{flex:1;min-width:0;line-height:1.5}body.mobile-screen-maintenance .p-schedule-card .p-btn{flex:none;min-height:38px}
#maintenancePlanToolbar{display:none!important}body.mobile-screen-maintenance #maintenancePlanToolbar{display:flex!important;grid-area:planning;gap:7px}#maintenancePlanToolbar .p-btn{flex:1;padding:8px 7px;font-size:12px}
#pilotToast{position:fixed;z-index:2147483550;bottom:calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:14px;right:14px;max-width:600px;margin:auto;padding:11px 15px;border-radius:13px;background:#134765;color:#fff;font:14px/1.5 Arial;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #15496833;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;display:none}#pilotToast.show{display:block}
body.pilot-open #mobileBottomNav{display:none!important}.p-details{font-size:13px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e0eaf0}.p-details b{color:#527487;display:block;font-size:11px}.p-details span{overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:pre-wrap}
@media(max-width:1024px){body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app,body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app.native-layout-active{grid-template-areas:'topnav topnav' 'brand brand' 'ticker ticker' 'summary summary' 'filterbutton rows' 'filters filters' 'planning planning' 'cards cards'!important}}
@media(min-width:700px){.p-module-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.p-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.p-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:14px}.p-filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.p-filters .p-wide{grid-column:span 2}.p-list.two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(min-width:1025px){.p-desktop-launch{display:flex;position:fixed;top:10px;left:12px;z-index:1650}#pilotShell .p-inner{padding-top:6px}.p-module-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:359px){.p-form-grid{gap:8px}.p-module{min-height:133px!important}.p-checkboxes{grid-template-columns:1fr}.p-shell-head h1{font-size:20px}}
@media print{body>*:not(#pilotShell){display:none!important}#pilotShell{position:static;display:block!important;overflow:visible}#pilotContent{overflow:visible}.p-shell-head button,.p-btn,.p-local-bar,#pilotStorageWarning{display:none!important}.p-board{min-width:0}.p-board-wrap{overflow:visible}.p-card{break-inside:avoid;box-shadow:none}.p-table-wrap{overflow:visible}}

#pilotBack[hidden]{display:none!important}

/* Role display is respected on desktop as well as on the phone; not an authentication boundary. */
body.pilot-maintenance #cards .quick,
body.pilot-maintenance #cards [data-manual="operational"],
body.pilot-maintenance #cards label:has(+ [data-manual="operational"]),
body.pilot-maintenance #cards [data-table-column="operational"]{display:none!important}
@media(min-width:1025px){body.pilot-maintenance .p-schedule-card{display:flex!important;flex:none;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:8px;border-top:1px solid #c9deea;background:#f5fbff;font-size:11px}body.pilot-maintenance .p-schedule-card .p-btn{font-size:11px;padding:6px;min-height:34px}body.pilot-maintenance .p-schedule-card span{min-width:0;flex:1}}



/* Canonical phone layer: final authority for every <=1024px viewport.
   Keeps operational data storage intact, but removes visual differences caused by older responsive layers. */
@media (max-width:1024px){
  html{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%!important;text-size-adjust:100%!important;scroll-padding-top:8px!important}
  body{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;margin:0!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;background:#fff!important;color:#163c57!important;font-family:"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial,sans-serif!important;font-size:16px!important;letter-spacing:0!important}
  body *{box-sizing:border-box}
  button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit!important}
  input,select,textarea{font-size:16px!important}
  .app,.app.native-layout-active{
    display:grid!important;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
    grid-template-areas:'topnav topnav' 'brand brand' 'ticker ticker' 'summary summary' 'filterbutton rows' 'filters filters' 'planning planning' 'cards cards'!important;
    gap:9px!important;
    align-items:start!important;
    align-content:start!important;
    width:100%!important;
    max-width:800px!important;
    height:auto!important;
    min-height:100dvh!important;
    margin:0 auto!important;
    padding:6px 12px calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;
    position:relative!important;
    inset:auto!important;
    transform:none!important;
    background:#fff!important;
    overflow:visible!important;
  }
  .app>*{min-width:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}
  .app>.screen-custom-layer,.app>.system-title,.app>#sourceNotice,.app>.uploadbar,.app>.toolbar,.app>.kpis,.app>.feed-head,.app>.pager,.app>.screen-designer-fixed-button{display:none!important}

  .permit-ticker-track{display:inline-flex!important;direction:rtl!important;align-items:center!important;gap:16px!important;width:max-content!important;animation:permitTickerRun 300s linear infinite!important;will-change:transform!important}

  #mobileHeading,.app>#systemTools,.app>.top-tools,.app>#mobileSearchBar{display:none!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox{grid-area:summary!important;display:block!important;position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;width:100%!important;margin:0!important;padding:10px 12px 8px!important;border:1px solid #cbdce8!important;border-radius:15px!important;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff 25%,#f7fbfe 70%,#fff)!important;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(26,69,108,.09),inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important}

  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-total{display:flex!important;align-items:baseline!important;gap:5px!important;line-height:1!important;color:#0b436b!important;white-space:nowrap!important}

  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-total small{font-size:11px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#587286!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-departments{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;column-gap:16px!important;row-gap:0!important}

  #mobileFilterToggle,.app>#rowViewTop{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:7px!important;position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;height:42px!important;min-height:42px!important;margin:0!important;padding:7px!important;border:1px solid #bdd2e2!important;border-radius:11px!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f6fafd)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff,0 3px 10px rgba(25,79,117,.06)!important;color:#1b587d!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:700!important;line-height:1.2!important;white-space:normal!important}
  #mobileFilterToggle{grid-area:filterbutton!important}

  #maintenancePlanToolbar{grid-area:planning!important;position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;width:100%!important;margin:0!important}

  .app #cards .department-box{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:0!important;margin:0 0 20px!important;width:100%!important;border-radius:0!important;scroll-margin-top:12px!important}
  .app #cards .department-box>header{padding:8px 11px!important;min-height:41px!important;gap:8px!important;margin:3px 0 12px!important;border-radius:12px!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(4,99,153,.13)!important;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#076699,#1686bd)!important;color:#fff!important}
  .app #cards .department-box>header h2{font-size:16px!important;line-height:1.4!important;margin:0!important}

  .app #cards .department-cards{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:20px!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.tabbed-work-card{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;width:100%!important;margin:0!important;border:1.5px solid #b4ccdd!important;border-top:4px solid #268bce!important;border-right:1.5px solid #b4ccdd!important;border-radius:15px!important;box-shadow:0 7px 19px rgba(19,67,99,.11),0 1px 3px rgba(21,70,105,.09),inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#fdfefe 65%,#f4f9fc)!important;overflow:hidden!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.immediate{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff1f2,#ffe0e5)!important;border-top-color:#e6293a!important}

  .app #cards .work-card.tomorrow{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f6fffb,#dbf7ed)!important;border-top-color:#10a780!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:4px!important;padding:4px 6px!important;border:0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fbfe,#edf5fa)!important;flex:none!important;order:-1!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;min-height:38px!important;height:38px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:14px!important;padding:4px 2px!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:#39627e!important;background:transparent!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab.active{background:#fff!important;color:#0679bf!important;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(15,70,108,.12)!important;border-bottom:2px solid #12add2!important}
  .app #cards .card-pane-stack{flex:none!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;overflow:visible!important;position:static!important}

  .app #cards .pane.card-pane.hidden{display:none!important}
  .app #cards .general-pane>.card-head{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;gap:8px!important}

  .app #cards .desc{font-size:17px!important;font-weight:750!important;line-height:1.35!important;min-height:0!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;color:#0b395b!important}

  .app #cards .operations-meta-row{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(110px,.7fr)!important;gap:7px!important;align-items:stretch!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0!important}
  .app #cards .elapsed-chip{background:rgba(247,251,254,.9)!important;border:1px solid #dbe8ed!important;border-radius:10px!important;padding:7px 6px!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:3px!important;min-width:0!important;text-align:center!important}

  #mobileBottomNav{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:2px!important;position:fixed!important;z-index:1400!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;padding:6px max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-left)) calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;min-height:68px!important;border-top:1px solid #c9dce9!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(20px)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px)!important;box-shadow:0 -5px 22px rgba(28,78,113,.10)!important}
  #mobileWorkspace{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;position:fixed!important;z-index:1300!important;inset:0 0 calc(68px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;padding:0!important;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff 65%,#f4faff)!important;overflow:hidden!important}
  #mobileWorkspace[hidden]{display:none!important}
  body.mobile-panel-open{overflow:hidden!important}
  body.mobile-panel-open .app{pointer-events:none!important}

}
@media (max-width:359px){

  #mobileBottomNav small{font-size:10px!important}
}

  .app>#permitTicker{grid-area:ticker;display:flex!important;height:46px!important;min-height:46px!important;padding:5px 9px!important;border:1px solid #acd3e5!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fdff,#edf8fd)!important;color:#1e506e!important;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(16,75,110,.06)!important;overflow:hidden!important}
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-title{background:#0b6d9f!important;color:#fff!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:12px!important;padding:5px 9px!important}
