  .app>#workingFilterToolbar{grid-area:filters;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(150px,1fr)) auto auto!important;gap:8px!important;align-items:end!important;min-height:0!important;padding:11px!important;border:1px solid #ccdee9!important;border-radius:15px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;box-shadow:var(--desk-shadow)!important;overflow:visible!important;z-index:70!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-filter-field{min-width:0!important;gap:3px!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-filter-field label{font-size:11px!important;color:#54748a!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-filter-field select,#workingFilterToolbar .working-filter-field input{height:38px!important;min-height:38px!important;border:1px solid #a9c8da!important;border-radius:9px!important;padding:0 8px!important;font-size:13px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#173f5c!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-apply,#workingFilterToolbar .working-clear{height:38px!important;min-height:38px!important;min-width:96px!important;font-size:12px!important;border-radius:9px!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-filter-status{grid-column:1/-1!important;padding:6px 8px!important;border-radius:8px!important;background:#f2f8fc!important;font-size:11px!important;color:#5c788c!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar>.upload-visible,#workingFilterToolbar>#viewModeToggle{display:none!important}

  .app>#rowViewTop{grid-area:rows;display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px!important;height:44px!important;padding:6px 12px!important;border:1px solid #a8cadc!important;border-radius:11px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#0b669c!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:800!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,60,90,.05)!important}
  .app>#rowViewTop.active{background:#0b79b7!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#0b79b7!important}
  .app>#systemTools{grid-area:system;display:block!important;min-height:44px!important;height:44px!important;overflow:visible!important;z-index:100!important}
  .app>#systemTools>summary{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;width:100%!important;height:44px!important;min-height:44px!important;border:1px solid #0b79b7!important;border-radius:11px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#168bc8,#0875ae)!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:800!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(11,108,159,.18)!important}
  .app>#systemTools>.report-tools-menu{position:absolute!important;top:49px!important;left:0!important;right:auto!important;width:320px!important;max-height:70vh!important;overflow:auto!important;padding:10px!important;border:1px solid #bcd5e3!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(11,55,85,.18)!important;z-index:2500!important}

  .app>#cards{grid-area:cards;display:block!important;min-height:300px!important;overflow:visible!important}
  .app #cards .department-box{width:100%!important;margin:0 0 16px!important;padding:10px!important;border:1px solid #cbdde7!important;border-radius:16px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(15,60,90,.06)!important}
  .app #cards .department-box>header{min-height:48px!important;margin:0 0 10px!important;padding:9px 13px!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#0a628f,#1789c1)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
  .app #cards .department-box>header h2{font-size:17px!important}
  .app #cards .department-box>header span{font-size:11px!important;padding:5px 8px!important}
  .app #cards .department-cards{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:12px!important;align-items:start!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.tabbed-work-card{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;margin:0!important;border:1px solid #bdd2df!important;border-top:4px solid #2b95d0!important;border-right:1px solid #bdd2df!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(17,63,91,.07)!important;overflow:hidden!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.immediate{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff7f7,#ffebee)!important;border-top-color:#e62f3a!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.today{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffdf7,#fff4dc)!important;border-top-color:#e7a01b!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.tomorrow{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f8fffc,#e9faf3)!important;border-top-color:#13a67f!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:3px!important;padding:5px 6px!important;background:#eef6fa!important;border:0!important;order:-1!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab{height:34px!important;min-height:34px!important;padding:3px 4px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:7px!important;background:transparent!important;color:#45677d!important;font-size:12px!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab.active{background:#fff!important;color:#0878b6!important;box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(13,74,110,.08)!important;border-bottom:2px solid #1aa8cf!important}
  .app #cards .card-pane-stack{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;overflow:visible!important}
  .app #cards .pane.card-pane{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;padding:10px!important;overflow:visible!important;background:transparent!important}
  .app #cards .pane.card-pane.hidden{display:none!important}
  .app #cards .general-pane>.card-head{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;align-items:flex-start!important;gap:10px!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important}
  .app #cards .card-head .ids{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:5px!important;flex:1!important}
  .app #cards .card-head .id{padding:5px!important;text-align:center!important;border-radius:8px!important;background:rgba(245,250,253,.9)!important}
  .app #cards .card-head .id b{font-size:10px!important}
  .app #cards .card-head .id strong{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.25!important}
  .app #cards .card-head>.ids+div{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:flex-end!important;gap:4px!important;min-width:145px!important;font-size:11px!important;color:#607c8f!important}
  .app #cards .priority{font-size:11px!important;padding:4px 7px!important;border-width:1px!important}
  .app #cards .summary{padding:0!important;margin-top:7px!important}
  .app #cards .desc{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.35!important;min-height:0!important;color:#123e5d!important}
  .app #cards .summary-grid,.app #cards .detail-grid,.app #cards .mobile-more-grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:6px!important;margin-top:7px!important}
  .app #cards .datum{padding:6px!important;border-radius:8px!important;background:rgba(247,251,253,.9)!important;font-size:12px!important}
  .app #cards .datum b{font-size:10px!important}
  .app #cards .quick{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:6px!important;padding:8px 0 0!important;margin:0!important}
  .app #cards .quick button{min-height:36px!important;padding:4px!important;font-size:13px!important;border-radius:8px!important}
  .app #cards .mobile-notes{margin-top:7px!important}
  .app #cards .mobile-more>summary{min-height:34px!important;font-size:12px!important}
  .app #cards .rows-table-wrap{width:100%!important;overflow:auto!important;border-radius:12px!important}
  .app #cards .rows-table{min-width:1180px!important;width:100%!important}
  .app #cards .rows-table th{font-size:12px!important;padding:8px!important}
  .app #cards .rows-table td{font-size:12px!important;padding:8px!important}

  .app>.screen-custom-layer,.app>.system-title,.app>#sourceNotice,.app>.toolbar,.app>.feed-head,.app>.pager,.app>.screen-designer-fixed-button{display:none!important}
  #mobileHeading,#mobileSummaryBox,#mobileFilterToggle,#mobileSearchBar,#mobileWorkspace,#mobileBottomNav{display:none!important}

  @media (min-width:1500px){
    .app #cards .department-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
    .app,.app.native-layout-active{grid-template-columns:270px minmax(0,1fr) 200px!important}
  }
  @media (max-width:1250px){
    .app>.uploadbar{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
    .app,.app.native-layout-active{grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr) 170px!important}
    .app>#workingFilterToolbar{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(145px,1fr)) auto auto!important}
    .app #cards .department-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
    .app>.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
  }
}


/* TOVATI — light blue / silver glass skin, mobile only.
   Presentation only: no data, handlers, permissions, or desktop layout changes.
   Priority colors remain red / amber / green, as in the approved workflow. */
.brand-asset>img.tovati-mobile-banner,
.app>.brand-asset>img.tovati-mobile-banner,
.app.native-layout-active>.brand-asset>img.tovati-mobile-banner{display:none!important}
@media (max-width:1024px){
  :root{
    --tovati-ice:#e9f6ff;
    --tovati-ink:#143c60;
    --tovati-blue:#0879e4;
    --tovati-soft-border:#c3e1f5;
    --tovati-glass:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.99),rgba(245,251,255,.93));
    --tovati-blue-button:linear-gradient(150deg,#22c2f4 0%,#118ff2 48%,#0962d9 100%);
    --tovati-soft-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(28,103,162,.09),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.98);
    --p-ink:#143c60;--p-muted:#5e7c94;--p-blue:#0879e4;--p-line:#c3e1f5;
    --p-soft:#edf8ff;--p-shadow:var(--tovati-soft-shadow);--p-radius:20px;
  }
  html{background:#edf8ff!important}
  body{
    background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 88% 0,rgba(122,213,255,.17),transparent 44%),linear-gradient(180deg,#fcfeff 0,#e5f3ff 540px,#f4faff 100%)!important;
    color:var(--tovati-ink)!important;
  }
  .app,.app.native-layout-active{background:transparent!important;padding-top:0!important;padding-bottom:calc(104px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;gap:10px!important}
  /* Use the exact image supplied by the user, with its natural proportions. */
  .app>.brand-asset,.app.native-layout-active>.brand-asset{
    padding:0!important;margin:2px 0 4px!important;border:1px solid #d3edff!important;
    border-radius:20px!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#edf8ff!important;
    box-shadow:0 10px 27px rgba(29,131,203,.13),0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.88)!important;
  }
  .app>.brand-asset>img.tovati-desktop-banner,
  .app.native-layout-active>.brand-asset>img.tovati-desktop-banner{display:none!important}
  .app>.brand-asset>img.tovati-mobile-banner,
  .app.native-layout-active>.brand-asset>img.tovati-mobile-banner{
    display:block!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;height:auto!important;
    min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;
    object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;margin:0!important;
    border:0!important;background:transparent!important;
  }
  /* Keep the existing four working actions; only restyle them. */
  #tovatiTopNav{
    padding:7px 14px 6px!important;min-height:63px!important;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(177,218,244,.64)!important;
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.98),rgba(235,247,255,.9))!important;
    color:#176da7!important;
  }
  #tovatiTopNav button{gap:3px!important;min-height:49px!important;border-radius:16px!important}
  #tovatiTopNav .tovati-top-icon{
    width:34px!important;height:34px!important;border-radius:50%!important;
    border:1px solid #c5e4f9!important;background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;
    box-shadow:0 3px 9px rgba(31,118,178,.09),inset 0 0 0 2px #fff!important;
  }
  #tovatiTopNav svg{width:20px!important;height:20px!important}
  #tovatiTopNav .tovati-top-label{color:#2b6188!important;font-size:11px!important}
  #tovatiTopNav button[aria-expanded=true] .tovati-top-icon{
    background:var(--tovati-blue-button)!important;color:#fff!important;
    border-color:#76d5ff!important;box-shadow:0 3px 13px #46bded55!important;
  }
  /* Existing ticker and report counts: no illustrative or invented numbers. */
  .app>#permitTicker,.app.native-layout-active>#permitTicker{
    background:linear-gradient(120deg,#f9fdff,#e4f3ff)!important;
    border-color:#bfdff3!important;border-radius:15px!important;
    box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff,0 4px 13px #2569930d!important;
  }
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-title{color:#175b8c!important;background:transparent!important}
  .app>#permitTicker .permit-ticker-item{border-color:#d3e8f5!important;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #31628609!important}
  #permitTicker .permit-ticker-pause{border-radius:11px!important;color:#1276b9!important;border-color:#bfdff3!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox{
    background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;border:1px solid var(--tovati-soft-border)!important;
    border-radius:21px!important;box-shadow:var(--tovati-soft-shadow)!important;padding:12px 13px 10px!important;
  }
  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-topline{border-bottom-color:#dcecf6!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-title{color:#153d61!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox .mode-indicator{color:#0873c1!important;background:#e4f4ff!important;border-radius:9px!important;padding:4px 7px!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-total strong{color:#0668b9!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-department{color:#42627c!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-department b{color:#0e70b4!important}
  #mobileFilterToggle,.app>#rowViewTop{
    border-radius:15px!important;border-color:#b9ddf3!important;
    background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;color:#1269a4!important;
    box-shadow:var(--tovati-soft-shadow)!important;min-height:44px!important;height:44px!important;
  }
  #mobileFilterToggle[aria-expanded=true],#mobileFilterToggle.has-filters,.app>#rowViewTop.active{
    background:var(--tovati-blue-button)!important;color:#fff!important;
    border-color:#65c4f1!important;box-shadow:0 6px 16px #078ce32e,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff70!important;
  }
  .app>#workingFilterToolbar{background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;border-color:#bbdef4!important;border-radius:18px!important;box-shadow:var(--tovati-soft-shadow)!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-filter-field select,#workingFilterToolbar .working-filter-field input{border-color:#bedff3!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#fbfdff!important;color:#153e61!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-apply{background:var(--tovati-blue-button)!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #1598ec!important;border-radius:12px!important}
  #workingFilterToolbar .working-clear{background:#fff6f7!important;color:#a32439!important;border:1px solid #ebc3ca!important;border-radius:12px!important}
  /* Department groups and real work cards. */
  .app #cards .department-box>header{
    background:linear-gradient(115deg,#fafdff,#e8f7ff 62%,#d5efff)!important;
    color:#0c538d!important;border:1px solid #a9d8f5!important;border-radius:17px!important;
    box-shadow:0 5px 15px #258fc413,inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important;
  }
  .app #cards .department-box>header h2{color:#125581!important}
  .app #cards .department-box>header>span{background:#d4efff!important;color:#176695!important;border:1px solid #c0e4fa!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.tabbed-work-card{
    border-color:#bddcf0!important;border-top-color:#4ab5ee!important;border-radius:20px!important;
    background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff 20%,#f5fbff 100%)!important;
    box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(24,97,156,.10),0 1px 3px #3c799912,inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important;
  }
  .app #cards .work-card.immediate{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff7f8,#ffe8ed)!important;border-top-color:#ee3956!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.today{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffdf5,#fff2d7)!important;border-top-color:#efa41c!important}
  .app #cards .work-card.tomorrow{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f6fffc,#e0f7ef)!important;border-top-color:#11aa83!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fcff,#eaf6fe)!important;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0!important;padding:6px!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab{border-radius:12px!important;color:#386789!important}
  .app #cards .card-tabs.card-tabs-top .card-tab.active{
    background:var(--tovati-blue-button)!important;color:#fff!important;border:0!important;
    box-shadow:0 3px 10px #129ee433,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff80!important;
  }
  .app #cards .card-head .id{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#eff8ff)!important;border-color:#d2e7f5!important;border-radius:12px!important}
  .app #cards .card-head .id strong{color:#0c5088!important}
  .app #cards .card-head .id .id-status{color:#36627e!important}
  .app #cards .desc{color:#153e61!important}
  .app #cards .datum{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#eff8ff)!important;border-color:#cde5f5!important;border-radius:11px!important}
  .app #cards .ops-notes-toggle,.app #cards .elapsed-chip{
    background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;border-color:#c2e0f4!important;border-radius:15px!important;
    box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important;color:#215e88!important;
  }
  .app #cards .ops-note-action{border-radius:12px!important;background:#e1f3ff!important;color:#0673b8!important}
  .app #cards .ops-notes-panel textarea{border-color:#b5d9f0!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:#fcfeff!important;color:#194a6c!important}
  .app #cards .quick button{
    border-radius:13px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff60,0 3px 9px #244f701a!important;
    border:1px solid #ffffff50!important;min-height:42px!important;
  }
  .app #cards .quick .q-immediate{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#ff6375,#ec2842)!important;color:#fff!important}
  .app #cards .quick .q-today{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#ffd770,#f5b83f)!important;color:#553500!important}
  .app #cards .quick .q-tomorrow{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#18c29b,#068361)!important;color:#fff!important}
  .app #cards .quick button.selected{outline:2px solid #11517e!important;outline-offset:2px!important}
  /* Preserve compact folded rows and all role-specific show/hide rules. */
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app #cards>.department-box .work-card.priority-folded{border-radius:12px!important;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #2d77a314!important}
  .app #cards .maintenance-open{color:#1074b5!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#eaf7ff)!important;border-top-color:#cce5f5!important}
  .app #cards .p-schedule-card{background:rgba(246,252,255,.94)!important;border-top-color:#c9e3f4!important;color:#315d7d!important}
  .app #cards .p-schedule-card .p-btn{background:var(--tovati-blue-button)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#65bdf2!important;border-radius:12px!important}
  /* Navigation keeps the same labels, order and click targets. */
  #mobileBottomNav{
    padding:6px max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-left)) calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;
    min-height:76px!important;border:1px solid #cce7f8!important;border-bottom:0!important;
    border-radius:22px 22px 0 0!important;background:rgba(251,254,255,.96)!important;
    box-shadow:0 -7px 23px rgba(37,136,196,.10),inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important;
  }
  #mobileBottomNav button{min-height:62px!important;gap:3px!important;color:#50718d!important;background:transparent!important;border-radius:17px!important}
  #mobileBottomNav .nav-icon{
    width:39px!important;height:39px!important;border-radius:50%!important;
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff,#edf7fe)!important;border:1px solid #e0edf6!important;
    color:#316788!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important;
  }
  #mobileBottomNav button.active .nav-icon{
    width:43px!important;height:43px!important;background:var(--tovati-blue-button)!important;
    border:2px solid #e7f9ff!important;color:#fff!important;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #b9ebff,0 4px 15px #159cdb4d!important;
  }
  #mobileBottomNav button.active small{color:#0769b5!important;font-weight:800!important}
  #mobileBottomNav small{font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.25!important}
  #mobileWorkspace{bottom:calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#eaf7ff)!important}
  #mobileWorkspace .workspace-header,#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-head{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;border-bottom-color:#cce5f6!important}
  #mobileWorkspace .workspace-close,#tovatiTopPanel .top-panel-close{border-radius:50%!important;border-color:#c4e1f3!important;color:#1475b2!important}
  #mobileWorkspace button:not(.workspace-close):not(.workspace-text-button),#mobileWorkspace .workspace-empty{border-color:#bfdef3!important;border-radius:17px!important}
  #tovatiTopPanel{border-color:#c5e5f9!important;background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;border-radius:23px!important}
  /* Apply the same palette to existing planning / report / staff screens. */
  #pilotShell{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fbfeff,#e9f6ff)!important}
  #pilotShell .p-shell-head,#pilotModal .p-modal-head{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95)!important;border-bottom-color:#cae5f6!important}
  #pilotContent .p-module,.p-card,.p-list-card,.p-metric{
    background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;border-color:#c3e0f3!important;
    border-radius:20px!important;box-shadow:var(--tovati-soft-shadow)!important;
  }
  #pilotContent .p-module{color:#184e77!important}
  #pilotContent .p-module .p-module-icon{
    border-radius:50%!important;width:49px!important;height:49px!important;
    border:1px solid #cbe6f7!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#e9f6ff)!important;
    box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff,0 3px 11px #1d8cc31c!important;color:#0876bb!important;
  }
  .p-btn{background:var(--tovati-glass)!important;color:#1269a2!important;border-color:#bcdef4!important;border-radius:13px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff!important}
  .p-btn.primary,.p-segments button.active,.p-tabs-scroll .p-btn.active{
    background:var(--tovati-blue-button)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#5dc9f5!important;
    box-shadow:0 4px 12px #118cce2b,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff66!important;
  }
  .p-btn.danger{color:#a72f43!important;background:#fff2f4!important;border-color:#ebc1cb!important}
  .p-segments{background:#e3f1fc!important;border-radius:16px!important}
  .p-segments button{border-radius:12px!important}
  .p-metric b{color:#0876c4!important}
  .p-event{border-color:#c0e0f5!important;border-right-color:#299ee0!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:#fff!important}
  .p-event.done{border-right-color:#11a17b!important}.p-event.inprogress,.p-event.today{border-right-color:#e6a41a!important}.p-event.immediate{border-right-color:#e83b54!important}.p-event.tomorrow{border-right-color:#11a17b!important}
  #pilotShell input,#pilotShell select,#pilotShell textarea,#pilotModal input,#pilotModal select,#pilotModal textarea{border-color:#bcddf2!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#fbfdff!important}
  #pilotModal{border-color:#c6e3f5!important;border-radius:23px!important;background:#fcfeff!important}
  #pilotShell button:focus-visible,#pilotModal button:focus-visible,.app button:focus-visible,#mobileBottomNav button:focus-visible,#tovatiTopNav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0868b5!important;outline-offset:2px!important}
}



/* Full-screen pilot modules must cover the underlying top navigation (z=1800). */
body.pilot-open #pilotShell{z-index:1900!important}
/* TOVATI user directory. Scoped to the pilot modules; main work cards are unchanged. */
#pilotContent .u-subnav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:20px}
#pilotContent .u-subnav .active{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#20bafa,#0672df);color:#fff;border-color:#6acbfb;box-shadow:0 5px 15px #218edd22}
#pilotContent .u-hero{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:24px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fff,#e7f6ff);border:1px solid #d0e5f2;margin-bottom:20px;box-shadow:0 9px 25px #2478af0d}
#pilotContent .u-hero-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1dbeed,#0878dc);color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #fff6,0 8px 20px #168bcc30}
#pilotContent .u-hero-icon svg{width:32px;height:32px}
#pilotContent .u-hero h2,#pilotContent .u-directory-head h2{font-size:25px;color:#163d5d;margin:4px 0 8px}
#pilotContent .u-hero p,#pilotContent .u-directory-head p{margin:0;color:#657d90;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
#pilotContent .u-eyebrow{color:#078bcb;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
#pilotContent .u-settings-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
#pilotContent .u-settings-tile{cursor:pointer;text-align:right;color:#163d5d;border:1px solid #d0e5f1;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff,#f4fbff);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #286da811;transition:box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s;font:inherit}
#pilotContent .u-settings-tile:hover{border-color:#6dcaf2;box-shadow:0 9px 28px #168bcc24}
#pilotContent .u-settings-tile>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:15px;background:#e8f6fe;color:#158ccd;margin-bottom:14px}
#pilotContent .u-settings-tile svg{width:25px;height:25px}
#pilotContent .u-settings-tile h3{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 8px}
#pilotContent .u-settings-tile p{font-size:14px;font-weight:400;color:#647c8d;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 12px}
#pilotContent .u-settings-tile b{font-size:13px;color:#177cad}
#pilotContent .u-directory-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}
#pilotContent .u-toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:16px 0}
#pilotContent .u-branch-tabs{background:#eef6fc;border:1px solid #d6e8f3;gap:4px;padding:5px;border-radius:16px}
#pilotContent .u-branch-tabs .p-btn{border:0;border-radius:12px;background:transparent;min-height:40px;color:#56768a;gap:10px;display:flex;align-items:center}
#pilotContent .u-branch-tabs .p-btn b{font-size:12px;border-radius:8px;padding:2px 6px;background:#ffffff99}
#pilotContent .u-branch-tabs .p-btn.active{color:#07669d;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #1673a620}
#pilotContent .u-filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,1.6fr) repeat(4,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:12px;padding:16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d6e7f0;border-radius:18px}
#pilotContent .u-filters label{display:grid;gap:6px;min-width:0;font-size:12px;color:#607b8e;font-weight:700}
#pilotContent .u-filters input,#pilotContent .u-filters select,#pilotContent .u-scope{font:inherit;min-width:0;max-width:100%;width:100%;height:40px;border:1px solid #c6deec;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 10px;background:#f9fdff;color:#173f59}
#pilotContent .u-scope{min-width:130px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#eef8ff);color:#12669b;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
#pilotContent .u-list-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#59788b;font-size:13px;margin:14px 0 4px}
#pilotContent .u-sort-note{font-size:12px;color:#708797;margin:8px 0 12px;line-height:1.6}
#pilotContent .u-feedback:empty{display:none}
#pilotContent .u-feedback{border:1px solid #b5dccb;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin:10px 0;background:#effbf5;color:#197747;font-size:13px}
#pilotContent .u-feedback.is-error{background:#fff2ef;border-color:#efc1b7;color:#a4342d}
#pilotContent .u-table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid #cce1ee;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;max-width:100%;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #2d76a610}
#pilotContent .u-table{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;text-align:right;font-size:13px;min-width:1030px;line-height:1.5}
#pilotContent .u-table thead th{background:#eaf5fd;color:#315874;padding:14px 12px;white-space:nowrap;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1;border-bottom:1px solid #c9e0ee}
#pilotContent .u-table tbody td{padding:14px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5eef4;vertical-align:middle;color:#31546c}
#pilotContent .u-table tbody td strong{color:#153f5b;font-size:14px;display:block;min-width:90px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#pilotContent .u-table .u-group-row th{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#f5faff,#ecf7fe);border-bottom:1px solid #d5e9f5;border-top:1px solid #d7e9f3;padding:10px 14px;color:#1381b7;font-size:13px}
#pilotContent .u-table tbody tr:not(.u-group-row):hover td{background:#f8fcff}
#pilotContent .u-actions>div{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:194px}
#pilotContent .u-actions .p-btn{min-height:32px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:12px;border-radius:9px}
#pilotContent .u-inactive td{background:#f4f7f9;color:#7b8c96}
#pilotContent .u-local-note,#pilotModal .u-local-note{background:#f0f7fc;border:1px solid #d7e8f2;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;color:#587588;line-height:1.7;font-size:13px;margin:18px 0}
#pilotContent .u-local-note .p-btn{margin-right:8px}
#pilotContent .u-group-section{margin-top:16px}
#pilotContent .u-group-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
#pilotContent .u-group-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #deebf3;border-radius:12px;background:#fbfdff}
#pilotContent .u-group-item>div{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#pilotContent .u-group-item small{display:block;color:#738b9b;line-height:1.6;margin-top:4px;font-size:12px}
#pilotContent .u-group-item .p-btn{flex-shrink:0}
#pilotContent .u-sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap}
#pilotModal .u-org-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;border-top:1px solid #e2edf4;padding-top:14px;margin-top:4px}
#pilotModal .u-form-hint{font-size:12px;color:#648296;line-height:1.65}
#pilotModal .u-availability{border:1px solid #d4e6f2;border-radius:12px;background:#f8fcff;padding:0 14px;min-width:0}
#pilotModal .u-availability>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:13px;color:#246a95;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}
#pilotModal .u-availability>summary::after{content:'+';margin-right:auto;font-size:20px}
#pilotModal .u-availability[open]>summary::after{content:'−'}
#pilotModal .u-availability>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#pilotModal .u-availability svg{width:18px;height:18px}
#pilotModal .u-availability>.p-form-grid{padding:10px 0 16px}
#pilotModal .u-preview-head{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#pilotModal .u-preview-list{display:grid;gap:8px}
#pilotModal .u-preview-list article{padding:12px;border:1px solid #d9e9f2;border-radius:12px;background:#fbfdff;line-height:1.65}
#pilotModal .u-preview-list article div{color:#728b9b;font-size:12px}
#pilotContent :is(.u-directory,.u-groups,.u-settings) button:focus-visible,#pilotContent .u-scope:focus-visible,#pilotModal .u-user-form :is(input,select,summary):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #38b6e4;outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:1100px){#pilotContent .u-filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}#pilotContent .u-filters .u-search{grid-column:span 2}}
@media(max-width:700px){
 #pilotContent .u-subnav{gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px}#pilotContent .u-subnav .p-btn{font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px;min-height:38px}
 #pilotContent .u-hero{padding:18px;gap:12px}#pilotContent .u-hero h2,#pilotContent .u-directory-head h2{font-size:22px}#pilotContent .u-hero-icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:16px}
 #pilotContent .u-settings-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}#pilotContent .u-settings-tile{padding:18px}
 #pilotContent .u-settings-tile>span{float:left;margin:0 10px 0 0}
 #pilotContent .u-directory-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}#pilotContent .u-directory-head>.p-btn{align-self:stretch;justify-content:center;min-height:44px}
 #pilotContent .u-directory-head p{font-size:13px}#pilotContent .u-toolbar{align-items:stretch}#pilotContent .u-branch-tabs{width:100%;display:flex}#pilotContent .u-branch-tabs .p-btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:8px 10px}
 #pilotContent .u-filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));padding:12px;gap:10px}#pilotContent .u-filters .u-search{grid-column:1/-1}
 #pilotContent .u-table-wrap{border:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;overflow:visible}
 #pilotContent .u-table{display:block;min-width:0;font-size:13px}#pilotContent .u-table thead{display:none}#pilotContent .u-table tbody{display:block}
 #pilotContent .u-table tr:not(.u-group-row){display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));padding:14px;border:1px solid #cee3f1;border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:14px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff,#f7fcff);gap:12px;box-shadow:0 7px 18px #17689b0e}
 #pilotContent .u-table tbody td{display:block;border:0;padding:0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
 #pilotContent .u-table tbody td::before{content:attr(data-label);display:block;font-size:11px;color:#8298a6;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:400}
 #pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(1){grid-column:2;grid-row:1;text-align:left}#pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(2){grid-column:1;grid-row:1}
 #pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(3){grid-column:1;grid-row:2}#pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(8){grid-column:2;grid-row:2;text-align:left}
 #pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(4){grid-column:1;grid-row:3}#pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(5){grid-column:2;grid-row:3}
 #pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(6){grid-column:1;grid-row:4;align-self:center}#pilotContent .u-table tbody td:nth-child(7){grid-column:2;grid-row:4}
 #pilotContent .u-table tbody .u-actions{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px solid #e5eef5;padding-top:12px}#pilotContent .u-actions>div{min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
 #pilotContent .u-actions .p-btn{min-height:38px;font-size:12px}#pilotContent .u-actions:before{display:none!important}
 #pilotContent .u-table .u-group-row{display:block}#pilotContent .u-table .u-group-row th{display:block;border:0;background:transparent;padding:6px 4px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
 #pilotContent .u-scope{min-width:0;height:42px;font-size:13px;padding:6px}
 #pilotContent .u-inactive{opacity:.75}#pilotContent .u-group-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 #pilotContent .u-local-note,#pilotModal .u-local-note{font-size:12px;padding:12px;line-height:1.65}
 #pilotModal .u-org-fields{gap:10px}#pilotModal .u-user-form{gap:12px}
}
@media(max-width:380px){#pilotModal .u-org-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}#pilotContent .u-subnav .p-btn{font-size:11px;padding:7px 8px}}

#pilotHeading:focus:not(:focus-visible){outline:none}
@media(max-width:700px){
 #pilotContent .u-directory-head{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:10px}
 #pilotContent .u-directory-head .u-eyebrow,#pilotContent .u-directory-head p{display:none}
 #pilotContent .u-directory-head h2{font-size:20px;margin:0}
 #pilotContent .u-directory-head>.p-btn{align-self:auto;min-height:42px;font-size:13px;flex-shrink:0}
 #pilotContent .u-sort-note{font-size:11px}
}



/* PM 5346 repair: keep approved mobile home compact; preventive loading is available from Tools. */
@media(max-width:1024px){
  [data-workspace-pane="tools"] [data-mobile-tool="upload-preventive"]{display:flex!important}
}


/* New login and employee media only; the approved work-card theme is unchanged. */
body.test-login-required{overflow:hidden!important}
body.test-login-required>.app,body.test-login-required>#tovatiTopNav,body.test-login-required>#mobileBottomNav,body.test-login-required>#mobileWorkspace,body.test-login-required>#pilotShell,body.test-login-required>.p-desktop-launch{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#tovatiTestLogin[hidden],#tovatiTestIdentity[hidden]{display:none!important}
#tovatiTestLogin{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:25000;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top right,#def3ff,transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,#eef8fe);color:#14324b;direction:rtl;font-family:Arial,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;padding:14px;box-sizing:border-box}
#tovatiTestLogin *{box-sizing:border-box}
.tu-login-layout{max-width:1060px;min-height:calc(100dvh - 28px);margin:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.02fr) minmax(0,.98fr);gap:20px;align-items:center}
.tu-login-art{padding:4px}.tu-login-logo{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d5e9f4;box-shadow:0 10px 26px #137cc518;background:#fff;margin-bottom:12px}
.tu-login-logo img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:1536/658;object-fit:cover}
.tu-demo-pill{display:inline-flex;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:50px;background:#e1f2ff;color:#0c62a0;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #b8dff8}
.tu-login-art h1{font-size:32px;color:#103e67;line-height:1.1;margin:10px 0 6px}.tu-login-art p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:#526f86;margin:0 0 10px}
.tu-login-counts{display:flex;gap:14px;margin:12px 0 0}.tu-login-counts>div{padding:4px 14px;border-inline-start:2px solid #99d9ff}.tu-login-counts b{font-size:26px;color:#0678ce;display:block}.tu-login-counts span{font-size:12px;color:#52738c}
.tu-login-card{padding:18px;border:1px solid #cee5f4;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fffffff2,#f4fbfff2);box-shadow:0 12px 34px #16689d14,inset 0 1px 1px #fff;min-width:0}
.tu-login-branches{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;background:#eaf3fa;padding:4px;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:14px}
.tu-login-branches button{min-height:44px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:#54758a;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;cursor:pointer}
.tu-login-branches button.active{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#19b5ec,#086ddd);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 12px #047ed42b}.tu-login-branches svg{width:21px;height:21px}
.tu-login-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px 10px}.tu-login-fields label{display:block;min-width:0}.tu-login-fields label>span{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#53728a;display:block;margin:0 3px 5px}.tu-login-fields select,.tu-login-fields input{width:100%;height:40px;font-size:13px;color:#143e60;padding:0 9px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c9dfec;border-radius:11px;min-width:0}.tu-wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.tu-login-fields :focus-visible,.tu-login-card button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #46b9ef;outline-offset:2px}
.tu-login-preview{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;border:1px solid #d3e8f5;border-radius:16px;padding:10px 12px;margin:12px 0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#edf8ff);min-height:80px}.tu-login-preview>div{min-width:0;flex:1}.tu-login-preview strong{display:block;font-size:16px;color:#123f66}.tu-login-preview span:not(.tu-avatar){display:block;font-size:12px;color:#2978ad;margin:3px 0}.tu-login-preview small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#5c798d;line-height:1.45}.tu-login-preview bdi{font-size:10px;color:#6b879b;display:inline-block;margin-top:3px}
.tu-login-submit{width:100%;height:44px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#15b0ed,#066bdc);color:#fff;border:1px solid #0877c9;border-radius:13px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 7px 15px #087bd633;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;cursor:pointer}.tu-login-submit svg{width:18px;height:18px}.tu-login-submit:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.tu-login-disclaimer{color:#768c9d;text-align:center;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin:8px 0 0}.tu-admin-link{display:block;width:100%;background:transparent;color:#1a75ae;border:0;border-top:1px solid #dceaf3;margin-top:10px;padding:10px 2px 0;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.45}
.tu-avatar{width:42px;height:42px;border:2px solid white;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#edfaff,#bfdeef);color:#126da7;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #c0dced;flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:middle}.tu-avatar img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:cover}.tu-avatar.large{width:56px;height:56px;font-size:21px}.tu-avatar.small{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:13px}.tu-avatar.tiny{width:25px;height:25px;font-size:10px;margin-inline-end:6px;border-width:1px}
.tu-user-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:130px}.tu-demo-label{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#64839c;font-weight:400;margin-top:4px}.tu-hierarchy{display:block;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;color:#5f8098!important;margin-top:4px;max-width:250px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#tovatiTestIdentity{display:flex!important;grid-area:auto!important;grid-column:1/-1!important;order:-40;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:6px 0 8px;padding:8px 11px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#eff9ff);border:1px solid #c8e2f2;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 4px 13px #2175b00a;font-size:13px}
#tovatiTestIdentity[hidden]{display:none!important}.tu-identity-user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}.tu-identity-user>div{min-width:0}.tu-identity-user strong{display:block;color:#174c72}.tu-identity-user small{display:block;color:#638098;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.tu-identity-user+.tu-avatar{flex-shrink:0}
#tovatiTestIdentity button{border:1px solid #a8d4ef;border-radius:11px;background:#eef8ff;color:#126ba3;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;min-height:37px;padding:6px 11px;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer}
.tu-photo-editor{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:14px;background:#f4faff;border:1px solid #cee4f2;border-radius:16px;min-width:0}.tu-photo-editor>div:last-of-type{min-width:0;flex:1}.tu-photo-editor p{margin:6px 0;color:#607d90;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.tu-photo-editor small{font-size:11px;color:#617e95;line-height:1.6;display:block}.tu-photo-editor .p-row{margin:6px 0}.tu-photo-editor input[hidden]{display:none!important}
.tu-hierarchy-editor{padding:12px;border:1px solid #d2e5f1;border-radius:14px;background:#f7fbff}.tu-hierarchy-editor>summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#285f81;padding:4px}.tu-hierarchy-editor .p-form-grid{margin-top:14px}.tu-managed-sections{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:10px;max-height:200px;overflow:auto}
@media(max-width:1024px){
 #tovatiTestLogin{padding:8px 8px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}

/* Completed management/navigation update. Existing cards, source data and branding retained. */

.am-rule.is-paused{opacity:.75}.am-design-section{margin-top:18px}.am-design-section h2{font-size:18px}
.am-inbox{margin-bottom:26px}.am-inbox h2{font-size:18px}.am-inbox-card{border-inline-start:4px solid #2eafe9!important}.am-inbox-card.is-read{border-inline-start-color:#c7dbe4!important}.am-inbox-card.severity-critical{border-inline-start-color:#df5270!important}.am-inbox-card.severity-important{border-inline-start-color:#e9aa36!important}
.am-body,.am-message-preview p{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;margin:12px 0}
.am-message-preview{padding:16px;border:1px solid #bcdef0;background:white;border-radius:14px}.am-message-preview small{display:block;color:#62818f;line-height:1.5}
.am-preview-box{padding:14px;background:#eaf8ff;border:1px solid #bce2f3;border-radius:16px;margin:10px 0}.am-preview-box h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 16px}.am-preview-box .p-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.am-preview-box .p-metric{padding:10px}.am-preview-box .p-metric b{font-size:22px}.am-preview-box .p-metric span{font-size:11px}

.am-token-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-top:10px}.am-token-list>span{width:100%;font-size:12px;color:#718793;margin:2px 0 5px}.am-token-list .p-btn.small{min-height:30px;font-size:11px;padding:5px 8px}
.am-preview-action{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:16px 0}.am-preview-action>span{font-size:12px;color:#758a97}
.am-management-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important}

.ig-feed{display:grid;gap:14px}
.ig-toolbar{display:grid;gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.96),rgba(236,247,255,.94));border:1px solid #cfe6f5;border-radius:24px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(18,84,130,.08)}
.ig-toolbar-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ig-title-wrap h2{margin:0;color:#154a73;font-size:28px}.ig-title-wrap p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#607f95;line-height:1.5}
.ig-quick-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ig-quick-actions .p-btn{border-radius:18px;min-height:44px;padding-inline:14px}
.ig-story-strip{display:flex;gap:12px;overflow:auto;padding:2px 2px 8px;scrollbar-width:none}.ig-story-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ig-story{min-width:82px;max-width:92px;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;color:#194d74}
.ig-story-ring{width:74px;height:74px;margin:0 auto 7px;border-radius:50%;padding:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#31c8f5,#1489eb 55%,#0e5bc8);box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(17,117,193,.18)}
.ig-story.is-empty .ig-story-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d7edf9,#bdddf2)}
.ig-story-media{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fafdff,#e6f4ff);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative}
.ig-story-media img,.ig-story-media video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}.ig-story-media video{pointer-events:none}
.ig-story-badge{position:absolute;inset:auto 5px 5px auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:24px;height:24px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(8,103,197,.92);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;border:2px solid #fff}
.ig-story-fallback{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#edf8ff,#d7ecff);color:#0d67b6;font-size:28px;font-weight:900}
.ig-story-author{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ig-story-time{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#7690a2;text-align:center;margin-top:2px}.ig-story-worker .ig-story-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#21c2ef,#0d72dd 55%,#0b4eb1)}.ig-story-worker .ig-story-time{font-weight:700;color:#5f7d95}.ig-worker-spotlight{display:grid;gap:14px}.ig-worker-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #d4e8f4;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#eef8ff)}.ig-worker-card .ig-avatar{width:72px;height:72px;flex-basis:72px;font-size:24px}.ig-worker-card h3{margin:0;color:#13496f}.ig-worker-card p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#5c798f}.ig-worker-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.ig-worker-stats .p-dept-line{min-height:78px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;border-radius:18px}.ig-worker-posts{display:grid;gap:8px}.ig-worker-posts article{padding:12px;border-radius:16px;background:#f4fbff;border:1px solid #d7ebf7}.ig-worker-posts b{display:block;color:#13496f;margin-bottom:4px}
.ig-feed-list{display:grid;gap:16px}
.ig-post{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.98),rgba(241,249,255,.95));border:1px solid #cde2f0;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(15,73,121,.08)}
.ig-post-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px 10px}
.ig-avatar{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 48px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#18b9ec,#0a68dd);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:18px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(14,112,191,.24);overflow:hidden}
.ig-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.ig-author-meta{min-width:0;flex:1}.ig-author-meta strong{display:block;font-size:16px;color:#113f66}.ig-author-sub{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#648198;font-size:12px;margin-top:3px}
.ig-post-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#eaf6ff;color:#0d69be;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;border:1px solid #cae6fb}
.ig-post-caption{padding:0 16px 14px;color:#234b66;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;white-space:pre-wrap}
.ig-media-stack{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:0 12px 12px}.ig-media-scroll{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:auto;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;padding-bottom:2px}.ig-media-item{scroll-snap-align:start;min-width:min(100%,360px);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d1e7f5;background:#dfeffc;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.ig-media-item img,.ig-media-item video{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;max-height:440px;object-fit:cover;background:#dfeffc}
.ig-media-single .ig-media-item{min-width:100%}
.ig-post-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:0 16px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ig-post-tools{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ig-mini-btn{border:1px solid #c8e0f0;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;color:#19557f;font-weight:800;min-height:38px;padding:0 13px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer}.ig-mini-btn.is-liked{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#28c0f2,#0d73e2);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
.ig-post-comments{padding:0 16px 16px;display:grid;gap:8px}.ig-comment{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:16px;background:#f4fbff;border:1px solid #d6ebf7;color:#2a4d66;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}.ig-comment b{color:#13456d}
.ig-empty{padding:34px 20px;border:1px dashed #c7ddec;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#ffffff,#eff8ff);text-align:center}.ig-empty h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:#16466d}.ig-empty p{margin:0;color:#65829b;line-height:1.6}
.ig-uploader-note{font-size:12px;color:#5f7d95;line-height:1.5}.ig-upload-preview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:8px}.ig-upload-preview .ig-upload-cell{border:1px solid #d3e8f4;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#eef8ff);padding:8px;display:grid;gap:6px}.ig-upload-preview img,.ig-upload-preview video{width:100%;height:96px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;background:#dbeefe}.ig-upload-preview b{font-size:11px;color:#15496f}.ig-upload-preview span{font-size:11px;color:#6c879a;word-break:break-word}
.ig-story-view{display:grid;gap:12px}.ig-story-view .ig-media-item{min-width:100%}
@media (max-width:900px){.ig-toolbar-top{align-items:flex-start}.ig-title-wrap h2{font-size:22px}.ig-quick-actions{width:100%}.ig-quick-actions .p-btn{flex:1 1 calc(33.333% - 8px);justify-content:center;padding-inline:10px}.ig-post{border-radius:22px}.ig-post-head{padding:13px 13px 10px}.ig-post-caption,.ig-post-comments,.ig-post-actions{padding-left:13px;padding-right:13px}.ig-media-stack{padding-left:10px;padding-right:10px;padding-bottom:10px}.ig-story-strip{margin-inline:-2px;padding-inline:2px}}

.p-filters input[type=month]{width:100%;height:42px;border:1px solid #cbdde7;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#14324b;padding:0 10px}.p-list-card .p-list-meta bdi{font-weight:900;color:#0879c9}.p-list-card .p-list-actions{flex-wrap:wrap}


/* Instagram-style feed cleanup */
.ig-feed{display:grid;gap:14px}
.ig-toolbar{display:grid;gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#f4fbff);border:1px solid #d5e7f3;border-radius:24px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(14,86,137,.06)}
.ig-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ig-head-title{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#164d76;line-height:1.1}
.ig-head-sub{margin-top:4px;color:#6a869a;line-height:1.5;font-size:13px}
.ig-head-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ig-head-btn{height:38px;padding:0 14px;border:none;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25c4f2,#0f75e1);color:#fff;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(22,115,197,.18)}
.ig-story-strip{display:flex;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;padding:2px 0 8px;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.ig-story-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ig-story{flex:0 0 78px;width:78px;min-width:78px;max-width:78px;padding:0;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:#183f62;font:inherit}
.ig-story-ring{width:78px;height:78px;margin:0 auto 7px;padding:3px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#35c9f7,#0f77e1 55%,#0a55c0);display:block;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(15,115,193,.18)}
.ig-story-worker .ig-story-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dbeefd,#a7d8ff)}
.ig-story-add .ig-story-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e4f5ff,#bde3fb)}
.ig-story-post .ig-story-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#32c8f6,#0974e1 55%,#1647ba)}
.ig-story-media{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;background:#ebf6ff}
.ig-story-media img,.ig-story-media video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.ig-story-badge{position:absolute;left:4px;bottom:4px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#0f75e1;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.ig-story-fallback{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fafdff,#dcedff);color:#0b66ba;font-size:24px;font-weight:900}
.ig-story-author,.ig-story-time{display:block;width:100%;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ig-story-author{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25}
.ig-story-time{font-size:10px;color:#7b92a3;margin-top:2px}
.ig-inline-empty{padding:8px 4px;color:#6f8797;font-size:13px}
.ig-feed-list{display:grid;gap:16px}
.ig-post{overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d6e6f0;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(15,78,126,.08)}
.ig-post-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 14px 10px}
.ig-avatar{width:46px;height:46px;flex:0 0 46px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#29c3f2,#0d73dd);color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:18px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(16,112,191,.18)}
.ig-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.ig-author-meta{min-width:0;flex:1}.ig-author-meta strong{display:block;color:#133e63;font-size:16px}
.ig-author-sub{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#6b879b;font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
.ig-post-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 9px;background:#eef7ff;border:1px solid #d6eaf7;color:#0c68bc;font-size:11px;font-weight:900}
.ig-media-stack{padding:0;background:#ecf7ff}
.ig-media-scroll{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none}
.ig-media-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ig-media-item{min-width:100%;scroll-snap-align:start;background:#deefff}
.ig-media-item img,.ig-media-item video{display:block;width:100%;max-height:420px;object-fit:cover;background:#deefff}
.ig-post-caption{padding:12px 14px 6px;color:#274760;line-height:1.75;font-size:14px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.ig-post-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 14px 14px}
.ig-post-tools{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ig-mini-btn{height:36px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #cfe3ef;background:#fff;color:#15537f;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ig-mini-btn.is-liked{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#28c2f2,#0f76e2);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
.ig-post-comments{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:0 14px 14px}.ig-comment{background:#f5fbff;border:1px solid #ddebf5;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;color:#35536a;line-height:1.55}.ig-comment b{color:#163f62}
.ig-empty{padding:36px 18px;border:1px dashed #cfe1ed;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#f2f9ff);text-align:center}.ig-empty h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:#184d74}.ig-empty p{margin:0;color:#71899a;line-height:1.6}
.ig-story-view{display:grid;gap:12px}
.ig-worker-spotlight{display:grid;gap:14px}.ig-worker-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #d4e8f4;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#eef8ff)}.ig-worker-card .ig-avatar{width:72px;height:72px;flex-basis:72px;font-size:24px}.ig-worker-card h3{margin:0;color:#13496f}.ig-worker-card p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#5c798f}.ig-worker-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.ig-worker-stats .p-dept-line{min-height:78px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;border-radius:18px}.ig-worker-posts{display:grid;gap:8px}.ig-worker-posts article{padding:12px;border-radius:16px;background:#f4fbff;border:1px solid #d7ebf7}.ig-worker-posts b{display:block;color:#13496f;margin-bottom:4px}
@media (max-width:900px){.ig-toolbar{padding:12px}.ig-head-title{font-size:24px}.ig-head-actions{width:100%}.ig-head-btn{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}.ig-story{flex-basis:74px;width:74px;min-width:74px;max-width:74px}.ig-story-ring{width:74px;height:74px}.ig-post{border-radius:22px}.ig-post-head{padding:13px 13px 10px}.ig-post-caption,.ig-post-actions,.ig-post-comments{padding-left:13px;padding-right:13px}.ig-media-item img,.ig-media-item video{max-height:360px}}

/* Repair r1: scoped layout guards, without changing operational cards. */
:root{--tovati-css-ready:1}
#tovatiTestLogin{padding:10px;overflow:auto}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-layout{min-height:0;max-width:920px;gap:20px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-art{padding:0}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-logo{margin:0 0 8px;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #137cc518}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-logo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:160px;object-fit:contain;aspect-ratio:1536/658}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-art h1{font-size:21px;text-align:center;margin:6px 0}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-demo-pill{font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px;margin:0 auto;display:table}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-counts,#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-desktop-note{display:none}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-card{padding:12px;border-radius:20px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-branches{margin-bottom:8px;padding:3px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-branches button{min-height:40px;font-size:15px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields{gap:7px 8px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields label>span{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields select,#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields input{height:38px;font-size:13px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview{min-height:64px;padding:7px 10px;margin:8px 0;gap:10px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview .tu-avatar{width:44px;height:44px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview strong{font-size:15px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview span:not(.tu-avatar){font-size:12px;margin:2px 0}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview small{font-size:11px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview bdi{display:none}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-submit{height:42px;font-size:16px}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-disclaimer{font-size:10px;margin:6px 0 0;line-height:1.3}
#tovatiTestLogin .tu-admin-link{min-height:28px;margin-top:6px;padding:6px 0 0;font-size:11px}
@media(max-width:1024px){#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-layout{max-width:440px;display:block}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-art{padding-bottom:5px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-logo img{max-height:min(22dvh,150px)}}
@media(max-height:650px) and (max-width:600px){#tovatiTestLogin{padding:6px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-logo img{max-height:100px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-art h1{font-size:17px;margin:3px 0}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-demo-pill{display:none}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields{gap:5px 7px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-card{padding:9px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview{min-height:53px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields select,#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields input{height:35px}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (min-width:601px){#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr;max-width:950px;align-items:center}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-logo img{max-height:180px}}
#pilotContent .ig-feed,#pilotContent .ig-toolbar{min-width:0;width:100%;max-width:620px;margin-inline:auto}
#pilotContent .ig-head{gap:7px}#pilotContent .ig-head-title{font-size:20px}#pilotContent .ig-head-btn{height:36px;min-height:36px;padding:0 13px;font-size:13px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:none}
#pilotContent .ig-story-strip{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:6px 2px 10px}
#pilotContent button.ig-story{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;flex:0 0 70px!important;width:70px!important;min-width:70px!important;max-width:70px!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;border:0!important;background:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;line-height:1.3!important;border-radius:0!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-ring{display:block!important;flex:none!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;width:68px!important;height:68px!important;min-height:68px!important;aspect-ratio:1!important;margin:0 0 6px!important;padding:3px!important;border-radius:50%!important;box-shadow:none!important;overflow:hidden!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-media{display:flex!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;width:62px!important;height:62px!important;border-radius:50%!important;border:2px solid white!important;overflow:hidden!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-media img,#pilotContent .ig-story-media video{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover!important;border-radius:50%!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-fallback{display:flex!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;font-size:22px!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-author{font-size:11px!important;width:70px!important;line-height:1.4!important}#pilotContent .ig-story-time{font-size:10px!important;width:70px!important}
#pilotContent .ig-media-item{margin:0;flex:0 0 100%;width:100%;max-width:100%;border:0;border-radius:0}
#pilotContent .ig-media-item img,#pilotContent .ig-media-item video{object-fit:contain;height:auto;max-height:480px}
@media(max-height:700px) and (max-width:600px){#tovatiTestLogin .tu-demo-pill{display:none}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-logo img{max-height:112px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-art h1{margin:3px 0;font-size:18px}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (min-width:601px){#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-card{padding:8px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields{gap:4px 6px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields select,#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-fields input{height:32px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-branches button{min-height:32px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-preview{min-height:48px;margin:5px 0;padding:4px 8px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-login-disclaimer{font-size:9px}#tovatiTestLogin .tu-admin-link{padding:4px 0 0;margin-top:3px;min-height:22px}}


/* Feed full-screen fix and refreshed Instagram-style design */
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotShell{top:0!important;bottom:calc(78px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;z-index:2200!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#edf8ff 0%,#f8fcff 16%,#eef7fd 100%)!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotShell .p-shell-head,
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotShell .p-local-bar,
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotStorageWarning{display:none!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotContent{padding:10px 10px calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;background:transparent!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotContent .p-inner{max-width:720px!important;padding:0!important}
body.pilot-feed-page > .app,body.pilot-feed-page > #tovatiTopNav{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#pilotContent .ig-feed{gap:12px;max-width:100%!important}
#pilotContent .ig-toolbar-feed{padding:14px;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#f5fbff);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(15,90,138,.10);border:1px solid #d8ebf6}
#pilotContent .ig-head-feed{display:grid;gap:12px}
#pilotContent .ig-head-copy{display:grid;gap:4px}
#pilotContent .ig-head-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#1697d4;letter-spacing:.02em}
#pilotContent .ig-head-title{font-size:28px!important;line-height:1.15!important;color:#123f63!important;font-weight:900!important}
#pilotContent .ig-head-subtitle{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#5f7b90}
#pilotContent .ig-head-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;width:100%}
#pilotContent .ig-head-btn{height:44px!important;min-height:44px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:18px!important;padding:0 10px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#33c9f5,#0b7fe2 72%)!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:800!important;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(15,132,210,.18)!important}
#pilotContent .ig-head-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
#pilotContent .ig-strip-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:2px 2px 0;color:#5f7f95;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
#pilotContent .ig-strip-head strong{font-size:15px;color:#18496c}
#pilotContent .ig-story-strip-wrap{padding:10px 8px 8px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eff8ff,#f8fcff);border:1px solid #d8ebf7;overflow:hidden}
#pilotContent .ig-story-strip{display:grid!important;grid-auto-flow:column!important;grid-auto-columns:78px!important;justify-content:start!important;align-items:start!important;gap:12px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;padding:2px 2px 6px!important;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;direction:ltr!important}
#pilotContent button.ig-story{direction:rtl!important;scroll-snap-align:start;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;flex:0 0 78px!important;width:78px!important;min-width:78px!important;max-width:78px!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-ring{width:76px!important;height:76px!important;min-height:76px!important;padding:3px!important;margin:0 0 7px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#27c7ef,#0a79de)!important;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(8,123,201,.18)!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-media{width:68px!important;height:68px!important;border:3px solid #fff!important;background:#e9f6ff!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-fallback{font-size:24px!important;color:#0b6fb8!important;font-weight:900!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-author{width:78px!important;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:800!important;color:#214d6f!important;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#pilotContent .ig-story-time{width:78px!important;font-size:10px!important;color:#6f8798!important;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#pilotContent .ig-story-add .ig-story-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7edff8,#1990ee)!important}
#pilotContent .ig-story-post .ig-story-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#14c4ec,#0f7ddf)!important}
#pilotContent .ig-post{border-radius:26px!important;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d9eaf4;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fafdff);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(12,79,124,.08)!important}
#pilotContent .ig-post-head{padding:14px 14px 10px!important}
#pilotContent .ig-avatar{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid #d8eef9;background:#eaf7ff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;color:#0d6fb4}
#pilotContent .ig-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
#pilotContent .ig-post-caption{padding:12px 14px 4px!important;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#244f6f}
#pilotContent .ig-post-actions{padding:10px 14px 12px!important}
#pilotContent .ig-post-comments{padding:0 14px 14px!important}
#pilotContent .ig-mini-btn{min-height:34px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #cfe5f2;background:#f4fbff;color:#0a6fae;font-weight:800;box-shadow:none}
#pilotContent .ig-mini-btn.is-liked{background:#eaf6ff;color:#0967a1;border-color:#afd9ee}
@media (max-width:640px){
 body.pilot-feed-page #pilotContent{padding:8px 8px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important}
 #pilotContent .ig-toolbar-feed{padding:12px;border-radius:24px}
 #pilotContent .ig-head-title{font-size:24px!important}
 #pilotContent .ig-head-subtitle{font-size:12px}
 #pilotContent .ig-head-actions{gap:8px}
 #pilotContent .ig-head-btn{height:42px!important;font-size:13px!important;border-radius:16px!important}
 #pilotContent .ig-strip-head{padding-top:2px}
}

/* TOVATI traffic r4 — isolated from permit indicators, cards and feed styling. */
.tt-widget .timebox{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:6px!important;min-width:0}
.tt-widget .tt-timer,.app #cards .tt-widget .tt-timer{display:block!important;direction:ltr;unicode-bidi:isolate;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:clamp(13px,3.5vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.25!important;font-weight:800;color:#234e69!important;letter-spacing:.035em;overflow-wrap:normal!important;min-width:8ch;text-align:center}
.tt-widget .tt-lights{display:inline-flex!important;direction:ltr;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px!important;background:#30363c!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:4px 7px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #0004!important}
.tt-widget .tt-lights .lamp{display:block!important;flex:0 0 13px;width:13px!important;height:13px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:#5e656b!important;opacity:.55!important;animation:none;box-shadow:none!important}
.tt-widget .tt-lights .lamp.on{opacity:1!important}
.tt-widget .tt-lights .lamp.green.on{background:#1acb6a!important;box-shadow:0 0 5px #1acb6a66!important}
.tt-widget .tt-lights .lamp.orange.on{background:#ffab29!important;box-shadow:0 0 5px #ffab2966!important}
.tt-widget .tt-lights .lamp.red.on{background:#f42c4c!important;box-shadow:0 0 5px #f42c4c77!important}
.tt-widget .tt-lights.tt-blinking .lamp.red.on{animation:ttPriorityPulse 1.25s ease-in-out infinite!important}
@keyframes ttPriorityPulse{0%,100%{filter:brightness(.42);transform:scale(.93)}50%{filter:brightness(1.2);transform:scale(1.06)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tt-widget .tt-lights.tt-blinking .lamp.red.on{animation:none!important;outline:1px solid #ff9ba9;outline-offset:2px}}


/* TOVATI notification-card r5 — requested compact message-tab structure only. */
.app #cards .card-badges{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;gap:6px!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important}
.app #cards .notification-head-meta{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:flex-start!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:3px!important;min-width:0!important}
.app #cards .notification-dept{font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.3!important;color:#678295!important;white-space:nowrap!important;max-width:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important}
.app #cards .notification-type-badge{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;min-height:26px!important;padding:3px 9px!important;border:1px solid #9ed5f2!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f3fbff,#dff3ff)!important;color:#0873b5!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:900!important;line-height:1!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
.app #cards .notification-head-meta .priority{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;min-height:26px!important;padding:3px 9px!important;border-radius:999px!important;font-size:11px!important;line-height:1!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
.app #cards .notification-id-box .notification-user-status{margin-top:2px!important;color:#315b74!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:700!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important}
.app #cards .notification-headline{display:-webkit-box!important;-webkit-box-orient:vertical!important;-webkit-line-clamp:2!important;line-clamp:2!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;max-height:2.75em!important;min-height:0!important;font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.35!important;font-weight:900!important;color:#153e61!important;margin:0!important}
.app #cards .notification-meta-row{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:6px 12px!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;margin-top:6px!important;color:#607d91!important;font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.35!important}
.app #cards .notification-meta-item{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:4px!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important}
.app #cards .notification-meta-item b{font-size:10px!important;color:#7890a1!important;font-weight:700!important}
.app #cards .operations-meta-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(92px,.54fr)!important;gap:6px!important;align-items:center!important;margin-top:7px!important}
.app #cards .ops-notes-toggle{min-height:34px!important;height:34px!important;padding:4px 8px!important;border-radius:10px!important;gap:5px!important}
.app #cards .ops-note-title{font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.15!important}
.app #cards .ops-note-action{display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;min-width:24px!important;width:24px!important;height:24px!important;padding:0!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:transparent!important;color:#2a7ca8!important}
.app #cards .ops-note-action svg{width:14px!important;height:14px!important;stroke-width:1.5!important}
.app #cards .ops-note-action-label{display:none!important}
.app #cards .elapsed-chip{min-height:34px!important;padding:3px 5px!important;border-radius:10px!important;gap:1px!important;justify-content:center!important}
.app #cards .elapsed-chip b,.app #cards .elapsed-chip .elapsed-text{margin:0!important;line-height:1!important}
.app #cards .elapsed-chip .timebox,.app #cards .tt-widget .timebox{gap:1px!important}
.app #cards .tt-widget .tt-timer{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.05!important;margin:0!important}
.app #cards .tt-widget .tt-lights{padding:3px 6px!important;gap:3px!important;margin:0!important}
.app #cards .tt-widget .tt-lights .lamp{width:12px!important;height:12px!important;flex-basis:12px!important}
@media(max-width:640px){
 .app #cards .notification-head-meta{align-items:flex-start!important}
 .app #cards .notification-headline{font-size:16px!important}
 .app #cards .notification-meta-row{font-size:10.5px!important;gap:5px 10px!important}
 .app #cards .operations-meta-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 104px!important}
}


/* TOVATI notification-card r6 — compact single-line message metadata + order user status. */
.app #cards .notification-head-meta{display:block!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important}
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:5px!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip .priority,.app #cards .notification-meta-strip .notification-type-badge{flex:0 0 auto!important;min-height:24px!important;height:24px!important;padding:2px 8px!important;font-size:10.5px!important;line-height:1!important;border-radius:999px!important}
.app #cards .notification-inline-value{display:inline-block!important;min-width:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;white-space:nowrap!important;color:#58788e!important;font-size:10.5px!important;line-height:24px!important;font-weight:700!important;padding-inline:2px!important}
.app #cards .notification-room{flex:1 1 92px!important;text-align:center!important}
.app #cards .notification-initiator{flex:0 1 86px!important;text-align:center!important}
.app #cards .notification-user-status,.app #cards .order-user-status{display:block!important;margin-top:2px!important;color:#315b74!important;font-size:10.5px!important;font-weight:700!important;line-height:1.1!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important}
.app #cards .notification-dept,.app #cards .notification-meta-row{display:none!important}
.app #cards .general-pane>.card-head{gap:5px!important}
.app #cards .department-box>header h2{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:6px!important;min-width:0!important}
.app #cards .department-km{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;padding:3px 8px!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:#e3f4ff!important;border:1px solid #b9dff5!important;color:#0872b2!important;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:900!important;line-height:1.2!important;direction:ltr!important;unicode-bidi:isolate!important}
.app #cards .department-title-sep{color:#8aabba!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:700!important}
@media(max-width:640px){
 .app #cards .notification-meta-strip{gap:4px!important}
 .app #cards .notification-meta-strip .priority,.app #cards .notification-meta-strip .notification-type-badge{font-size:10px!important;padding:2px 7px!important;min-height:22px!important;height:22px!important}
 .app #cards .notification-inline-value{font-size:10px!important;line-height:22px!important}
 .app #cards .notification-room{flex-basis:82px!important}
 .app #cards .notification-initiator{flex-basis:72px!important}
 .app #cards .department-km{font-size:11px!important;padding:3px 7px!important}
}


/* R7 compact top navigation + bottom Home */
#tovatiTopNav{min-height:50px!important;height:50px!important;padding:3px 9px!important;gap:5px!important;align-items:center!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95)!important}
#tovatiTopNav #tovatiTopUserSlot{min-width:0!important;flex:1 1 auto!important;max-width:none!important}
#tovatiTopNav #tovatiTestIdentity{height:44px!important;min-height:44px!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;align-items:center!important}
#tovatiTopNav .tu-identity-user{gap:7px!important;min-width:0!important}
#tovatiTopNav .tu-avatar{width:42px!important;height:42px!important;flex:0 0 42px!important;border-width:2px!important}
#tovatiTopNav .tu-identity-user strong{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.15!important}
#tovatiTopNav .tu-identity-user small{font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.15!important;margin-top:2px!important}
#tovatiTopNav button[data-test-switch]{display:none!important}
#tovatiTopNav>.am-top-action{flex:0 0 42px!important;width:42px!important;height:42px!important;min-height:42px!important;padding:0!important;border:1px solid #c9e2ef!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#edf8ff)!important;color:#176b9d!important;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(19,89,133,.08)!important}
#tovatiTopNav>.am-top-action .tovati-top-icon{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;border-radius:50%!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important}
#tovatiTopNav>.am-top-action svg{width:22px!important;height:22px!important}
