#tovatiTopNav>.am-top-action .tovati-top-label{display:none!important}
#mobileBottomNav{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
#mobileBottomNav [data-am-home]{position:relative!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){
 #tovatiTopNav{height:50px!important;min-height:50px!important;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px!important}
 body.pilot-open #pilotShell{top:50px!important}
 body.pilot-feed-page #pilotShell{top:0!important}
}

/* R8 — priority workflow, summary and mobile scroll performance */
@media(max-width:1024px){
  html,body{scroll-behavior:auto!important;overscroll-behavior-y:none!important}
  body:not(.pilot-open):not(.row-detail-open){touch-action:pan-y pinch-zoom}
  #tovatiTopNav,#mobileBottomNav{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.985)!important}
  .app #cards>.department-box>.department-cards>.work-card:not(.priority-folded){content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 520px;contain:layout paint style}
  .app #cards>.department-box>.department-cards>.work-card{transition:none!important}
  .app #cards>.department-box{content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 920px}
  body.mobile-screen-operations .app{padding-bottom:calc(150px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important}
}
.priority-session-bar{display:flex;position:fixed;z-index:2090;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:calc(82px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));max-width:680px;margin:auto;gap:9px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #c8e3f3;border-radius:20px;background:#fffffff7;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(18,72,108,.16);direction:rtl}
.priority-session-bar[hidden]{display:none!important}
.priority-session-bar button{height:44px;border:1px solid #beddec;border-radius:14px;background:#f5fbff;color:#236281;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;padding:0 16px;cursor:pointer;min-width:92px}
.priority-session-bar button.primary{flex:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#20bdf0,#0875df);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(16,124,202,.18)}
.priority-session-bar::before{content:attr(data-progress);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:46px;border-radius:12px;background:#e8f6ff;color:#1472aa;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;order:3}
.priority-summary-mode .app>#cards{margin-top:6px!important}
.priority-session-summary{display:grid;gap:12px;padding:2px 0 20px;direction:rtl}
.priority-summary-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:5px 12px;padding:16px 17px;border:1px solid #c7e2f1;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#eaf7ff);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(22,96,143,.09)}
.priority-summary-hero>span{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:#174e73}.priority-summary-hero>strong{grid-row:1/3;grid-column:2;font-size:28px;color:#0878c8}.priority-summary-hero>small{font-size:12px;color:#678498}
.priority-summary-total{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.priority-summary-total>div{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid #d8e8f2;background:#fff;font-weight:800}.priority-summary-total b{font-size:22px}.priority-summary-total .is-immediate{color:#c92745;background:#fff1f4}.priority-summary-total .is-today{color:#a36a00;background:#fff8e8}.priority-summary-total .is-tomorrow{color:#078563;background:#ecfaf5}
.priority-summary-depts{display:grid;gap:10px}.priority-summary-depts article{padding:13px;border:1px solid #d2e6f2;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(22,76,112,.06)}
.priority-summary-depts article header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}.priority-summary-depts article header strong{font-size:17px;color:#1b5277}.priority-summary-depts article header span{padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#e9f6ff;color:#1475aa;font-weight:900;font-size:12px}
.priority-summary-depts article>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}.priority-summary-depts article>div>span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:8px 3px;border-radius:12px;background:#f5f9fc;color:#638092;font-size:10px;font-weight:700}.priority-summary-depts article>div b{font-size:16px;color:#224f6a}.priority-summary-depts .is-immediate b{color:#d02b47}.priority-summary-depts .is-today b{color:#aa7300}.priority-summary-depts .is-tomorrow b{color:#078762}.priority-summary-depts .is-pending b{color:#778b98}
@media(max-width:420px){.priority-session-bar{left:7px;right:7px;padding:7px;gap:7px}.priority-session-bar button{height:42px;font-size:13px;padding:0 12px}.priority-summary-depts article>div{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}


/* R9: one aligned, values-only metadata row; all rules stay within work cards. */
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip{
 display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:34px 52px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.12fr)!important;
 align-items:center!important;justify-content:stretch!important;gap:5px!important;
 box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;min-height:30px!important;
 padding:3px 5px!important;border:1px solid #d6e6ef!important;border-radius:11px!important;
 background:rgba(255,255,255,.64)!important;direction:rtl!important;
}
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip>*{
 box-sizing:border-box!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important;
 height:22px!important;min-height:22px!important;margin:0!important;align-self:center!important;
 line-height:22px!important;font-size:10.5px!important;text-align:center!important;
 overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;white-space:nowrap!important;
}
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip .notification-type-badge,
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip .priority{
 display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
 width:100%!important;padding:0 4px!important;line-height:1!important;font-size:10.5px!important;
}
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip .notification-inline-value{
 display:block!important;padding:0 4px!important;border-inline-start:1px solid #d7e6ef!important;
 color:#42677e!important;font-weight:600!important;
}
.app #cards .notification-meta-strip bdi{unicode-bidi:isolate}
.app #cards .quick button[data-op]{touch-action:manipulation!important}
@media(max-width:360px){
 .app #cards .notification-meta-strip{grid-template-columns:30px 46px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.08fr)!important;gap:3px!important;padding-inline:4px!important}
 .app #cards .notification-meta-strip>*{font-size:10px!important}
}

/* Isolated feed styling: no changes to login, home banners or SAP cards. */
html.tovati-feed-lock{overflow:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important}
body.pilot-feed-page{--tf-nav:78px;overflow:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important;background:#f4f9fe!important}
body.pilot-feed-page>.app,body.pilot-feed-page>#tovatiTopNav,body.pilot-feed-page>#mobileWorkspace,body.pilot-feed-page>.p-desktop-launch{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotShell{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100vh!important;height:100dvh!important;z-index:2300!important;display:flex!important;overflow:hidden!important;transform:none!important;background:#f3f8fd!important;padding:0 0 calc(var(--tf-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;isolation:isolate}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotShell>.p-shell-head,body.pilot-feed-page #pilotShell>.p-local-bar{display:none!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotStorageWarning{display:none!important}
body.pilot-feed-page.pilot-volatile #pilotStorageWarning{display:block!important;font-size:12px!important;padding:6px 14px!important;line-height:1.4!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotContent{display:block!important;flex:1 1 0!important;min-height:0!important;min-width:0!important;width:100%!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior-y:contain!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:0!important;background:#f3f8fd!important;touch-action:pan-x pan-y!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotContent>.p-inner{max-width:600px!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:0 0 24px!important;min-height:100%!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav{display:grid!important;visibility:visible!important;pointer-events:auto!important;position:fixed!important;z-index:2400!important;bottom:0!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;min-height:calc(var(--tf-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;padding:9px 6px calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;background:#fff!important;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0!important;border:1px solid #d9e7f1!important;box-shadow:0 -3px 18px #124b7310!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav button{min-height:52px!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav small{font-size:10px!important}
#pilotContent .tf-feed{font:14px/1.5 Arial,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:#123c5c;direction:rtl;width:100%;min-width:0}
.tf-sr{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important}
#pilotContent .tf-feed *{box-sizing:border-box}
#pilotContent .tf-feed button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
#pilotContent .tf-feed button:focus-visible,#pilotModal [data-tf-action]:focus-visible,#tovatiStoryViewer button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #00a4d9!important;outline-offset:2px}
#pilotContent .tf-top{padding:0 0 0;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #dfebf4}
#pilotContent .tf-utility{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:calc(5px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 12px 0;min-height:42px}
#pilotContent .tf-storage-tag{font-size:10px;color:#778e9f;letter-spacing:.03em}
#pilotContent .tf-icon-button,#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-icon-button{display:inline-grid!important;place-items:center!important;flex:none!important;width:40px!important;min-width:40px!important;height:40px!important;min-height:40px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:50%!important;padding:8px!important;background:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:#245679}
#pilotContent .tf-icon-button svg,#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-icon-button svg{width:24px;height:24px;display:block;flex:none}
#pilotContent .tf-avatar,#pilotModal .tf-avatar,#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-avatar{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e4f6ff,#c6e2f7);color:#146ab0;font:bold 16px Arial;border:1px solid #dceaf4;vertical-align:middle}
#pilotContent .tf-avatar img,#pilotModal .tf-avatar img,#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 34%}
#pilotContent .tf-stories{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px 14px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scrollbar-width:none;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;scroll-padding-inline:16px;touch-action:pan-x pan-y;direction:rtl;width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;overscroll-behavior-x:contain}
#pilotContent .tf-stories::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#pilotContent button.tf-story{display:flex!important;flex-flow:column nowrap!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;flex:0 0 74px!important;width:74px!important;min-width:74px!important;max-width:74px!important;height:100px!important;min-height:100px!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;background:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;gap:7px!important;scroll-snap-align:start}
#pilotContent .tf-ring{display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;width:74px!important;height:74px!important;min-height:74px!important;padding:3px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:#e1ebf3!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}
#pilotContent .tf-ring>.tf-avatar{width:68px!important;height:68px!important;min-height:68px!important;border:3px solid #fff!important;border-radius:50%!important;font-size:23px!important;flex:none!important}
#pilotContent .tf-story.has-story .tf-ring{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#65d2eb,#2689d6)!important}
#pilotContent .tf-story.unseen .tf-ring{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#20cce8,#0579df 62%,#0958b3)!important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0994d91f}
#pilotContent .tf-story-name{display:block!important;width:78px;max-width:78px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:16px;color:#1b425e;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#pilotContent .tf-my-story{position:relative;flex:0 0 74px;width:74px;scroll-snap-align:start}
#pilotContent .tf-story-add{position:absolute!important;top:51px!important;left:0!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;width:26px!important;height:26px!important;min-width:26px!important;min-height:26px!important;padding:4px!important;border:3px solid white!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:#0689d9!important;color:white!important;box-shadow:none!important;z-index:1}
#pilotContent .tf-story-add svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke-width:2.4}
#pilotContent .tf-compose{margin:0 14px 10px;padding:10px 10px 0;border:1px solid #e0edf5;border-radius:19px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff,#f5faff)}
#pilotContent .tf-compose-prompt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;width:100%;min-height:42px;padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;text-align:right;color:#668194;font-size:13px}
#pilotContent .tf-compose-prompt>span:not(.tf-avatar){flex:1}
#pilotContent .tf-compose-prompt>svg{width:22px;height:22px;color:#218ed1}
#pilotContent .tf-compose-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0;margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #e1edf4;padding:5px 0}
#pilotContent .tf-compose-actions button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:39px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:#235572;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:4px}
#pilotContent .tf-compose-actions button+button{border-inline-start:1px solid #e0ebf3;border-radius:0}
#pilotContent .tf-compose-actions svg{width:21px;height:21px;color:#068ddd;stroke-width:1.7}
#pilotContent .tf-tabs{display:flex;justify-content:flex-start;gap:20px;padding:0 18px;border-top:1px solid #f0f5f9}
#pilotContent .tf-tabs button{border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:#8194a4;padding:10px 0 9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
#pilotContent .tf-tabs button.active{color:#086cae;border-bottom-color:#078bd3}
#pilotContent .tf-post-list{display:grid;gap:12px;padding-top:12px}
#pilotContent .tf-post{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0eaf2;border-inline:0;overflow:hidden;min-width:0}
#pilotContent .tf-post-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 13px}
#pilotContent .tf-post-person{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:1;min-width:0;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;text-align:right;color:#1b3f58}
#pilotContent .tf-post-person>span:last-child{min-width:0}
#pilotContent .tf-post-person strong{font-size:13px;display:block;font-weight:700}
#pilotContent .tf-post-person small{font-size:10px;display:block;color:#7a8e9e;margin-top:1px}
#pilotContent .tf-media{position:relative;background:#eff5f9;min-width:0;width:100%}
#pilotContent .tf-carousel{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;direction:ltr;scrollbar-width:none;touch-action:pan-x pan-y;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;width:100%;min-width:0;gap:0}
#pilotContent .tf-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#pilotContent .tf-media-slide{position:relative;margin:0;flex:0 0 100%;min-width:0;width:100%;max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;scroll-snap-align:center;background:#eef3f8;display:grid;place-items:center}
#pilotContent .tf-media-slide>button{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent}
#pilotContent .tf-media-slide img,#pilotContent .tf-media-slide video{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain;max-height:600px;color:#708798}
#pilotContent .tf-media-count{position:absolute;right:12px;top:12px;background:#10314dba;color:#fff;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;padding:3px 9px;direction:ltr;pointer-events:none}
#pilotContent .tf-carousel-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:5px;padding:8px;background:#fff}
#pilotContent .tf-carousel-dots button{display:block;border:0;width:7px;height:7px;min-height:7px;min-width:7px;border-radius:50%;padding:0;background:#ccdce7}
#pilotContent .tf-carousel-dots button.active{background:#0988d1;width:15px;border-radius:6px}
#pilotContent .tf-media-error{position:absolute;inset:20px;background:#f3f7fb;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:22px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;z-index:2}
#pilotContent .tf-media-error[hidden]{display:none}
#pilotContent .tf-post-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:5px 9px 0}
#pilotContent .tf-post-actions .tf-save{margin-inline-start:auto}
#pilotContent .tf-icon-button.liked{color:#e74166!important}
#pilotContent .tf-icon-button.saved{color:#087ccc!important}
#pilotContent .tf-post-copy{padding:3px 14px 13px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}
#pilotContent .tf-post-copy p{margin:4px 0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#pilotContent .tf-likes{display:block;font-size:11px}
#pilotContent .tf-comments-link,#pilotContent .tf-add-comment,#pilotContent .tf-work-link{display:block;border:0;background:none;padding:4px 0;text-align:right;font-size:11px;color:#6f8798}
#pilotContent .tf-work-link{color:#0584c9}
#pilotContent .tf-comment-preview{font-size:11px}
#pilotContent .tf-empty{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:300px;padding:40px 22px;text-align:center;color:#184c70}
#pilotContent .tf-empty-art{display:grid;place-items:center;width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:26px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#e1f1fe);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #fff,0 10px 28px #116ba519;border:1px solid #d3e8f7;color:#1486cc;transform:rotate(-6deg);margin-bottom:18px}
#pilotContent .tf-empty-art svg{width:38px;height:38px}
#pilotContent .tf-empty h2{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 8px;line-height:1.4}
#pilotContent .tf-empty p{font-size:12px;color:#7e94a5;margin:0 0 20px;line-height:1.7}
#pilotContent .tf-primary,#pilotModal .tf-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:43px;padding:10px 20px;border:0;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#1caee6,#096dcc);color:white;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #137ccb25}
#pilotContent .tf-primary svg,#pilotModal .tf-primary svg{width:20px;height:20px}
#pilotContent .tf-more-posts{padding:14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d8e9f3;border-radius:12px;color:#1676b0;margin:0 14px}
#pilotContent .tf-system-notices{margin:12px;padding:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #deebf4;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px}
#pilotModal.tf-composer-modal,#pilotModal.tf-comments-modal,#pilotModal.tf-profile-modal{border:1px solid #d1e4f2;border-radius:24px;max-width:560px;background:#fff;color:#194365}
#pilotModal .tf-composer-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin:0 0 14px}
#pilotModal .tf-composer-author strong{display:block;font-size:15px}
#pilotModal .tf-composer-author small{display:block;color:#7891a2;font-size:11px;margin-top:2px}
#pilotModal.tf-composer-modal label[hidden]{display:none!important}
#pilotModal .tf-composer-text textarea{min-height:110px!important;resize:vertical;border-color:#e0edf4!important;background:#fafdff!important;font-size:16px!important;border-radius:14px!important}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-zone{display:block!important;position:relative;cursor:pointer;border:1px dashed #93c6e9;border-radius:16px;min-height:130px;padding:18px 12px;background:#f3faff;color:#198bc7;text-align:center;margin-top:12px}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-zone>input[type=file]{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;inset:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;z-index:1}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-zone>span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:0}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-zone svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:#108dd0}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-zone b{font-size:14px;color:#22618b}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-zone small{font-size:11px;color:#718c9f;line-height:1.6}
#pilotModal .tf-compress-note,#pilotModal .tf-local-note{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:#778f9f;margin:9px 0}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-preview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-item{position:relative;min-width:0;border:1px solid #e3ecf4;border-radius:12px;padding:5px;background:#f8fcff}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-item img,#pilotModal .tf-upload-item video{width:100%;height:86px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;display:block}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-item>span{display:block;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;line-height:1.5;margin-top:3px}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-item>small{font-size:9px;color:#6a889e}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-item>button{position:absolute;top:1px;left:1px;width:29px;height:29px;min-width:29px;min-height:29px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c9dde9;color:#254762;font-size:20px}
#pilotModal .tf-upload-status{font-size:12px;color:#137abc;min-height:20px;margin:8px 0}
#pilotModal .tf-extra-fields{border-top:1px solid #e2edf4;padding-top:8px;margin-top:10px}
#pilotModal .tf-extra-fields>summary{font-size:12px;color:#53809e;cursor:pointer;padding:7px 0}
#pilotModal .tf-extra-fields label{margin-top:7px}
#pilotModal .tf-comments-list{max-height:38dvh;overflow-y:auto;margin-bottom:16px}
#pilotModal .tf-comments-list article{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #edf4f8;font-size:12px}
#pilotModal .tf-comments-list article>div{min-width:0;flex:1}
#pilotModal .tf-comments-list article p{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:5px 0;line-height:1.7}
#pilotModal .tf-comments-list article small{color:#8a9fac;font-size:10px}
#pilotModal .tf-profile{text-align:center}
#pilotModal .tf-profile>.tf-avatar{width:92px;height:92px;font-size:28px;border:4px solid #d7edfb}
#pilotModal .tf-profile h2{margin:12px 0 6px;font-size:22px}
#pilotModal .tf-profile p{font-size:13px;color:#62809a}
#pilotModal .tf-profile-counts{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:48px;margin:22px 0}
#pilotModal .tf-profile-counts span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#7991a4}
#pilotModal .tf-profile-counts b{display:block;font-size:22px;color:#1d5c86}
#pilotModal .tf-profile>small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#8599a9;margin:10px 0}
#pilotModal .tf-profile-posts{text-align:right}
#pilotModal .tf-profile-posts p{padding:10px;border:1px solid #e2eef5;border-radius:10px;white-space:pre-wrap}
#pilotModal .tf-profile-posts small{display:block;color:#89a0b0;margin-top:6px;font-size:10px}
#pilotModal .tf-storage-info{text-align:center}
#pilotModal .tf-storage-info>svg{width:40px;height:40px;color:#0e92d4}
#pilotModal .tf-storage-info p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:#56748e;text-align:right}
#pilotModal .tf-secondary{display:block;margin:10px auto;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #c9e2f3;border-radius:12px;background:#f9fdff;color:#2675a6;font-size:12px}
#pilotModal .tf-post-menu{display:grid;gap:8px}
#pilotModal .tf-post-menu button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid #dbe9f2;background:#f6fbfe;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;color:#226080;font-size:14px}
#pilotModal .tf-post-menu svg{width:20px;height:20px}
#pilotModal .tf-post-menu .tf-danger{color:#b74458}
#tovatiStoryViewer{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;max-width:none;height:100vh;height:100dvh;max-height:none;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:#0b1928;color:white;overflow:hidden;direction:rtl;z-index:28000;font-family:Arial,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
#tovatiStoryViewer:not([open]){display:none}
#tovatiStoryViewer::backdrop{background:#071525}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-width:560px;width:100%;height:100%;margin:auto;padding:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 12px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));box-sizing:border-box}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-progress{display:flex;gap:4px;direction:ltr;height:3px;flex:none}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-progress>span{flex:1;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:#ffffff30;overflow:hidden}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-progress i{display:block;height:100%;background:#d7f5ff}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:none;padding:12px 0}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-head>div{flex:1;min-width:0}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-head strong{display:block;font-size:14px}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-head small{display:block;color:#b4c9d6;font-size:10px;margin-top:3px}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-icon-button{color:#fff!important;cursor:pointer}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-content{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;background:#07121f;border-radius:15px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-content img,#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-content video{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;object-fit:contain;display:block}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-loading{color:#bdd5e4;font-size:14px}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-caption{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-y:auto;max-height:16vh;flex:none;margin:8px 0}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-navigation{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;direction:ltr;flex:none;padding:4px 0;font-size:11px;color:#adc1d0}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-navigation button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;height:36px;border:0;background:transparent;color:white;cursor:pointer}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-navigation button:disabled{opacity:.2;cursor:default}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-navigation svg{width:20px;height:20px}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-download{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid #39576c;background:#112a40;color:#d3e9f6;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
#tovatiStoryViewer .tf-viewer-download svg{width:17px;height:17px}
@media(min-width:640px){#pilotContent .tf-post{border-inline:1px solid #e0eaf2;border-radius:18px;margin-inline:12px}#pilotContent .tf-top{border:1px solid #e0edf5;border-radius:0 0 22px 22px}body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav{max-width:600px;margin-inline:auto;box-sizing:border-box}#pilotContent .tf-empty{min-height:360px}}
@media(max-width:360px){#pilotContent .tf-stories{gap:9px;padding-inline:12px}#pilotContent .tf-compose-actions button{font-size:11px;gap:4px}#pilotContent .tf-compose-prompt{font-size:12px}#pilotModal .tf-upload-preview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#pilotContent .tf-feed *,#tovatiStoryViewer *{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

:root{--tovati-feed-css-ready:1}
body.pilot-feed-page #pilotContent:focus{outline:none!important}
/* The feed keeps its navigation on wide screens as well. */
body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav button{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:3px!important;min-width:0!important;padding:0 2px!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;color:#486e8e!important;cursor:pointer!important}
body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav .nav-icon{display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;width:38px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#f4faff}
body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav .nav-icon svg{display:block;width:23px;height:23px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav small{display:block!important;line-height:1.3!important;white-space:nowrap!important}

/* TOVATI R10: isolated workspace shell, staff presence and compact navigation. */
:root{--tovati-workspace-css-ready:1;--r10-nav:55px;--r10-accent:#0b88dc;--r10-cyan:#24c3ed;--r10-line:#cce6f4}
/* A single viewport and a single vertical scroller for ALL internal screens. */
html.tovati-module-lock{overflow:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important;height:100%!important}
body.pilot-open{overflow:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important;--tf-nav:55px}
body.pilot-open>.app,body.pilot-open>#tovatiTopNav,body.pilot-open>#mobileWorkspace,body.pilot-open>.p-desktop-launch{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
body.pilot-open #pilotShell{display:flex!important;position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;top:0!important;bottom:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100vh!important;height:100dvh!important;max-height:100dvh!important;transform:none!important;z-index:2300!important;background:#edf8ff!important;overflow:hidden!important;isolation:isolate;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) 0 calc(var(--r10-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}
body.pilot-open #pilotContent{flex:1 1 0!important;min-height:0!important;width:100%!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:contain!important;touch-action:pan-x pan-y!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:12px 10px 20px!important;background:#eff8ff!important;scrollbar-width:thin}
body.pilot-open #pilotContent>.p-inner{width:100%;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto!important;padding:0!important;min-height:100%}
body.pilot-open #pilotShell>.p-shell-head{flex:0 0 auto!important;min-height:48px;padding:6px 10px!important;background:#fafdff!important;backdrop-filter:none!important}
body.pilot-open .p-shell-head h1{font-size:19px!important}
body.pilot-open .p-shell-head button{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;min-width:36px!important;min-height:36px!important;border-radius:12px}
body[data-pilot-page="feed"] #pilotShell>.p-shell-head,body[data-pilot-page="feed"] #pilotShell>.p-local-bar,body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotShell>.p-local-bar,body[data-pilot-page="personal"] #pilotShell>.p-local-bar{display:none!important}
body[data-pilot-page="feed"] #pilotContent{padding:0 0 14px!important;background:#edf8ff!important}
body[data-pilot-page="feed"] #pilotContent>.p-inner{max-width:640px!important;padding:0!important}
body.pilot-open #pilotStorageWarning{flex:none;font-size:11px!important}
/* Bottom navigation: 78px -> 55px, six accessible icon-only targets. */
#mobileBottomNav,body.pilot-open #mobileBottomNav,body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))!important;position:fixed!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;height:calc(var(--r10-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;min-height:calc(var(--r10-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;max-height:calc(var(--r10-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;padding:4px 6px calc(4px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;gap:2px!important;z-index:2500!important;background:#fafdff!important;border:1px solid #cae4f3!important;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0!important;box-shadow:0 -3px 12px #176c9810!important;backdrop-filter:none!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;overflow:visible!important}
#mobileBottomNav button,body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav button{height:46px!important;min-height:46px!important;max-height:46px!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;gap:0!important;background:transparent!important;min-width:0!important}
#mobileBottomNav small,#mobileBottomNav .nav-label{display:none!important}
#mobileBottomNav .nav-icon,body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav .nav-icon{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;min-width:36px!important;min-height:36px!important;margin:0!important;border-radius:50%!important;border:1px solid #daedf7!important;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#eaf6ff)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#mobileBottomNav .nav-icon svg{width:23px!important;height:23px!important}
#mobileBottomNav .am-feed-button .nav-icon{width:40px!important;height:40px!important;margin:0!important;border:2px solid #ccf0ff!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #dbf5ff!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2dd1f2,#087be0)!important;color:white!important}
#mobileBottomNav button.active .nav-icon{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2bc3f0,#0b7dda)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#b7e9ff!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ddf4ff!important}
#mobileBottomNav .am-nav-badge{top:0!important;inset-inline-end:5px!important;height:14px!important;min-width:14px!important;font-size:9px!important}
#prioritySessionBar{bottom:calc(var(--r10-nav) + 6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important}
#pilotToast{bottom:calc(var(--r10-nav) + 18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important}
body.pilot-open #prioritySessionBar{display:none!important}
body.test-login-required #mobileBottomNav{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
/* Feed: framed staff rail with the title above, no utility/menu/prompt row. */
#pilotContent .tf-utility,#pilotContent .tf-compose-prompt{display:none!important}
#pilotContent .r10-feed-top{padding:8px 10px 0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#effaff,#f8fcff)!important;border:0!important}
#pilotContent .r10-team-frame{border:2px solid var(--r10-cyan);border-bottom:0;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;padding:11px 10px 5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#e6f7ff);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #178fbc0e;min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
#pilotContent .r10-team-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:0 4px 10px}
#pilotContent .r10-team-caption h2{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:700;color:#17587b;margin:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#pilotContent .r10-team-caption>span{font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;color:#5088a4}
#pilotContent .r10-stories{display:flex!important;direction:rtl!important;align-items:start!important;gap:10px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;scrollbar-width:none;width:100%;padding:0 2px 7px!important;min-width:0;touch-action:pan-x pan-y!important}
#pilotContent .r10-stories::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#pilotContent .r10-person-tile{flex:0 0 90px;width:90px;min-width:90px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;scroll-snap-align:start;min-height:130px}
#pilotContent .r10-person-name{display:block;font-size:11px;line-height:16px;color:#174967;font-weight:700;width:90px;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
#pilotContent .r10-person-tile .tf-story{position:relative;display:block!important;width:72px!important;min-width:72px!important;max-width:72px!important;height:72px!important;min-height:72px!important;padding:0!important;flex:none!important;border:0;background:none!important}
#pilotContent .r10-person-tile .tf-ring{width:72px!important;height:72px!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;padding:3px!important;background:#c8e7f6!important;border:0!important;border-radius:50%!important;box-sizing:border-box}
#pilotContent .r10-person-tile .tf-avatar{width:66px!important;height:66px!important;border:3px solid #fff!important;box-sizing:border-box}
#pilotContent .r10-person-tile .tf-story.unseen .tf-ring{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#20cdf2,#087be0)!important}
#pilotContent .r10-person-tile .tf-story.has-story:not(.unseen) .tf-ring{background:#85bad7!important}
#pilotContent .r10-you{position:absolute;bottom:0;right:-5px;font-size:9px;color:#fff;background:#0a86ca;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 5px;line-height:1.2}
.r10-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;background:#edf3f7;color:#667f90;border:1px solid #d8e5ec;border-radius:11px;font:600 11px/1.3 Arial,sans-serif;min-height:25px;padding:4px 6px;white-space:nowrap;max-width:100%;vertical-align:middle}
button.r10-status{cursor:pointer}
.r10-status.status-work{background:#e0f8ef;border-color:#a8e0cd;color:#137454}.r10-status.status-sick{background:#fff1e8;border-color:#f4d2b6;color:#a15d26}.r10-status.status-vacation{background:#f1eafa;border-color:#d9c6ef;color:#8052a1}.r10-status.status-early{background:#fff4d9;border-color:#e8d5a0;color:#846326}.r10-status.status-late{background:#ffecef;border-color:#ecc2cb;color:#a25164}.r10-status.status-course{background:#e4f2ff;border-color:#b8d7ee;color:#2e6f9d}
#pilotContent .r10-compose-actions{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));border:2px solid var(--r10-cyan);border-top:1px solid #a5dcf5;border-radius:0 0 20px 20px!important;padding:5px 6px!important;margin:0!important;gap:4px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d7f4ff,#eaf7ff)!important}
#pilotContent .r10-compose-actions button{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:41px!important;padding:7px 3px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#ffffffb5!important;color:#126da3;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
#pilotContent .r10-compose-actions button+button{border-inline-start:0!important;border-radius:12px!important}
#pilotContent .r10-compose-actions svg{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none}
#pilotContent .tf-tabs{justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:8px 0 0;border:0;background:transparent}
#pilotContent .tf-tabs button{font-size:11px;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;padding:7px 12px;background:#e7f3fc;color:#51849f}
#pilotContent .tf-tabs button.active{color:#0873ad;background:#d5f1ff;border-bottom-color:#1abdec}
/* Bounded post and media dimensions. Image ratio can never enlarge the card. */
#pilotContent .tf-post-list{padding:12px 10px 16px;gap:14px;background:#edf8ff}
#pilotContent .tf-post{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid #bfdef0!important;border-top:3px solid #52c8ee!important;border-radius:20px!important;box-shadow:0 7px 18px #0f6fa10a!important;background:#fff!important;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;--r10-media-height:clamp(150px,calc((100vw - 24px) * .8),360px)}
#pilotContent .tf-post.has-media{height:calc(var(--r10-media-height) + 182px);max-height:542px}
#pilotContent .tf-post.text-only{min-height:214px;max-height:285px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#eef9ff)!important}
#pilotContent .tf-post-head{height:53px;min-height:53px;flex:none;padding:7px 10px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,#ebf8ff);border-bottom:1px solid #e0f1fa}
#pilotContent .tf-post-person strong{font-size:13px;color:#165477}#pilotContent .tf-post-person small{font-size:10px}
#pilotContent .tf-post .tf-media{flex:none;height:var(--r10-media-height);max-height:360px;overflow:hidden}
#pilotContent .tf-post .tf-carousel{height:100%;width:100%;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;align-items:stretch}
#pilotContent .tf-post .tf-media-slide{height:100%;max-height:100%;aspect-ratio:auto!important;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 100%;min-width:100%}
#pilotContent .tf-post .tf-media-slide>button,#pilotContent .tf-post .tf-media-slide img,#pilotContent .tf-post .tf-media-slide video{height:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;width:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important}
#pilotContent .tf-carousel-dots{position:absolute;bottom:5px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:5px 8px;background:#ffffffde;border-radius:15px;z-index:2}
#pilotContent .tf-post-actions{height:39px;min-height:39px;flex:none;padding:2px 9px;background:#f1faff;gap:5px}
#pilotContent .tf-post-actions .tf-icon-button{height:34px!important;width:34px!important;min-height:34px!important;min-width:34px!important;padding:6px!important}
#pilotContent .tf-post-actions svg{width:22px!important;height:22px!important}
#pilotContent .tf-post-copy{min-height:0;flex:1;padding:4px 12px 8px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}
#pilotContent .tf-post-copy .r10-caption{margin:2px 0;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;white-space:normal;flex-shrink:0}
#pilotContent .tf-comment-preview{white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-height:18px;margin:0!important}
#pilotContent .tf-comments-link,#pilotContent .tf-work-link,#pilotContent .tf-add-comment{font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;padding:2px 0;min-height:16px;flex-shrink:0}
#pilotContent .tf-likes{font-size:10px;line-height:1.2}
#pilotContent .r10-read-post{background:none;border:0;color:#1a83b7;font-size:10px;padding:0;text-align:right;align-self:start}
#pilotContent .tf-empty{min-height:255px;margin:0;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#e6f6ff);border:1px dashed #a6d8ef;border-radius:20px;padding:28px 18px}
/* Messages: a self-contained, scrollable screen. */
.r10-messages{max-width:680px;margin:auto;display:grid;gap:12px}
.r10-message-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.r10-message-toolbar>span{font-size:10px;color:#6c8a9e}
.r10-message-filter,.r10-message-notes{border:1px solid #cde5f3;background:#fafdff;border-radius:16px;padding:10px 12px}
.r10-message-filter>summary,.r10-message-notes>summary{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#40718d;cursor:pointer}
.r10-message-list{display:grid;gap:12px}
.r10-message{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d0e5f0;border-right:3px solid #6abfdf;border-radius:18px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px #24688108;min-width:0}
.r10-message.is-mine{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#faffff,#e3f6ff);border-right-color:#10aadb}
.r10-message>header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#225d7b}.r10-message>header strong{font-size:13px}.r10-message>header time{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#6d8a9e;margin-top:2px}
.r10-message>p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;margin:9px 2px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.r10-message-reply{background:#ffffffa9;border-right:2px solid #a1d4ec;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:9px;margin:7px 0;font-size:12px}.r10-message-reply p{margin:4px 0}
.r10-text-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border:0;background:none;color:#1685ba;font:600 12px Arial;cursor:pointer;padding:5px}
.r10-text-button svg{width:18px;height:18px}
/* Personal workspace */
.r10-personal{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;color:#225571;font:14px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif}
.r10-personal-hero{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:17px 14px;border:1px solid #b8e1f5;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#d7f2ff);border-radius:22px;position:relative}
#pilotContent .r10-personal-hero>.tf-avatar{width:68px;height:68px;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #75caef}
.r10-personal-hero>div{min-width:0;flex:1}.r10-eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#328caf;font-weight:700}
.r10-personal-hero h2{margin:2px 0;font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;color:#165273}.r10-personal-hero p{margin:3px 0 7px;font-size:11px;color:#618699}
.r10-status-edit{display:grid;place-items:center;align-self:start;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #c5e4f4;background:#fff;color:#0b87bd;cursor:pointer}.r10-status-edit svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.r10-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin:12px 0}
.r10-stats>button{border:1px solid #c5e4f5;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#ebf8ff);border-radius:15px;padding:10px 4px;color:#1b6c98;cursor:pointer}
.r10-stats b{display:block;font-size:23px;line-height:1.2}.r10-stats span{font-size:11px}
.r10-personal-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;border-bottom:1px solid #cee5f1;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.r10-personal-tabs button{flex:none;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid #d0e7f4;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 11px;background:#fafdff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#58819a;cursor:pointer}
.r10-personal-tabs button.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#21bde9,#0b89d9);color:#fff;border-color:#26b6e2}
.r10-scope-toggle{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:#dfedf7;border-radius:14px;padding:4px;margin:7px 0 14px}
.r10-scope-toggle button{border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;color:#668396;padding:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.r10-scope-toggle button.active{background:#fff;color:#1584b9;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #155a710c}
.r10-personal-content{background:#f9fdff;border:1px solid #d6e8f3;padding:12px;border-radius:18px}
.r10-details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:0}
.r10-details>div{min-width:0;border:1px solid #dbeaf4;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 10px}
.r10-details dt{font-size:10px;color:#7391a5}.r10-details dd{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.r10-personal-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin:12px 0}
.r10-personal-actions button{border:1px solid #c6e1ef;border-radius:10px;background:#edf8ff;color:#1d719b;padding:9px 5px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}
.r10-list-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:12px 0 9px}
.r10-list-heading h3{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:#225f7e}.r10-list-heading h3>span{font-size:11px;background:#e2f2fc;color:#188bb6;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:8px;margin-inline-start:6px}
.r10-search input{height:40px!important;min-height:40px!important;font-size:14px!important;background:#fff!important;margin-bottom:10px}
.r10-team-list,.r10-work-list{display:grid;gap:9px}
.r10-team-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;border:1px solid #d6e9f4;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;padding:9px 8px;min-width:0}
.r10-team-row>button:first-child{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:none;text-align:right;color:#215674;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.r10-team-row strong{font-size:12px;display:block}.r10-team-row small{font-size:10px;color:#7690a3;display:block}.r10-team-row>button>span:last-child{min-width:0}
#pilotContent .r10-team-row .tf-avatar{width:38px;height:38px}
.r10-work-item{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #d4e6f1;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;text-align:right;color:#285a78;font:12px/1.5 Arial;text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden}
button.r10-work-item{cursor:pointer}.r10-work-item>strong{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;font-size:13px;margin:4px 0}.r10-work-item>small{color:#7492a7;font-size:10px;display:block}.r10-work-item p{margin:5px 0}
.r10-work-code{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:7px;color:#167eae;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}.r10-work-code .p-chip{font-size:10px;line-height:1.2}
.r10-request-state{font-size:10px;background:#fff2d4;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 5px;color:#9a7225}
.r10-load-more{border:1px solid #c3e5f3;background:#edfaff;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;font-size:12px;color:#1987b3;cursor:pointer}
.r10-empty{padding:20px 12px;text-align:center;color:#5b86a0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff,#f0f9ff);border:1px dashed #c9e2f2;border-radius:15px}
.r10-empty>span{color:#61b7d9;display:block}.r10-empty>span svg{width:28px;height:28px}.r10-empty>strong{font-size:13px}.r10-empty p{font-size:11px;margin:0;max-width:320px;line-height:1.65}
.r10-local-note{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;color:#748e9e;display:block;margin:13px 2px 3px}
.r10-personal-tasks{display:grid;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}.r10-task{display:flex;gap:9px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #c8e5f0;border-radius:13px;background:#fff}.r10-task.done{background:#edfbf5}.r10-task.done strong{text-decoration:line-through;color:#608472}.r10-task-check{width:31px;height:31px;min-width:31px;background:#ecf8ff;color:#268aaa;border:1px solid #b7dae9;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}.r10-task-check svg{width:18px;height:18px}.r10-task strong{font-size:12px;display:block}.r10-task small{font-size:10px;color:#7a919d;display:block}.r10-task p{margin:3px 0;font-size:11px}
.r10-presence-person{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}.r10-presence-person small{display:block;color:#7a91a0;font-size:11px}.r10-presence-person strong{font-size:16px}
.r10-status-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-bottom:15px}
#pilotModal .r10-status-option{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:12px 10px;border:1px solid #d1e6f3;background:#f4fbff;border-radius:15px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
#pilotModal .r10-status-option:has(input:checked){background:#d8f5ff;border-color:#19b8df;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #19b8df}
#pilotModal .r10-status-option input{height:16px!important;min-height:16px!important;width:16px!important;max-width:16px!important;padding:0!important;flex:none;accent-color:#129cce}
#pilotModal .r10-status-option .r10-status-emoji{font-size:21px;margin:0!important}.r10-worker-profile>header{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 14px}.r10-worker-profile h3{font-size:20px;margin:0}.r10-worker-profile p{font-size:12px}.r10-worker-profile>header .tf-avatar{width:70px!important;height:70px!important}.r10-worker-profile .tf-primary{margin:12px 4px 0}
.r10-request-context{padding:12px;background:#f0f9ff;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #c9e5f4;margin-bottom:12px}.r10-request-context p{margin:6px 0;font-size:12px}
/* Permit ticker: exact source values, mode-specific, no title or pause button. */
.app>#permitTicker,.app.native-layout-active>#permitTicker{border:2px solid #22c0ed!important;border-radius:17px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e2f8ff,#c6efff)!important;padding:4px!important;min-height:41px!important;height:41px!important;gap:0!important}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-title,#permitTicker .permit-ticker-pause{display:none!important}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-window{flex:1!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;border:0!important;background:none!important}
#permitTicker .permit-ticker-item{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px!important;background:#ffffffcf!important;border:1px solid #c4eaf9!important;border-radius:20px!important;margin:0 5px!important;padding:3px 9px!important;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.5!important}
#permitTicker .r10-permit-status{color:white!important;border:0!important;border-radius:16px!important;padding:3px 8px!important;font-size:12px!important;animation:r10PermitPulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}
#permitTicker .ticker-request .r10-permit-status{background:#e92843!important}#permitTicker .ticker-outside .r10-permit-status{background:#13a273!important}
#permitTicker .r10-permit-number{font-size:13px!important;font-weight:800!important;color:#215d7c!important}
#permitTicker .r10-permit-description{font-weight:600;color:#385d73}
@keyframes r10PermitPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.45}}
/* Summary uses actual centres from each merged record, never invented section labels. */
.r10-summary-caption{font-size:11px;color:#5085a0;margin:7px 0 6px}.summary-section>span{min-width:0}.summary-section>span>strong{font-size:12px;direction:ltr;display:block}.summary-section>span>small{font-size:10px;color:#7899aa;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.summary-section>b{font-size:16px!important}.r10-summary-more{font-size:11px;border-top:1px solid #d4eaf5;padding-top:6px;margin-top:6px}.r10-summary-more summary{color:#168bb7;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:7px}
/* Maintenance: same card details & tabs; only action row differs. */
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards>.department-box .card-tabs{display:grid!important}
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards>.department-box .card-head>.ids+div{display:block!important}
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards>.department-box .id-status{display:block!important}
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards>.department-box .maintenance-open{display:none!important}
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards>.department-box .general-pane{gap:0!important}
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards>.department-box .desc{font-size:16px!important}
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app #cards .quick,body.pilot-maintenance #cards .quick{display:none!important}
body.mobile-screen-maintenance .p-schedule-card.r10-maintenance-actions,body.pilot-maintenance .p-schedule-card.r10-maintenance-actions{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px!important;padding:8px 10px 10px!important;min-width:0;background:transparent!important;border:0!important}
.r10-maintenance-button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-height:48px;padding:6px 3px!important;border:1px solid #a2d8ef;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eafaff,#d5f2ff);color:#1379aa;font:bold 11px/1.3 Arial;min-width:0;cursor:pointer}
.r10-maintenance-button svg{width:19px!important;height:19px!important;flex:none}
.r10-maintenance-button.r10-schedule{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#29c6ed,#0b87df);color:#fff;border-color:#49bcec}
.r10-maintenance-button span{flex:none!important;font-size:11px!important;white-space:nowrap}
#maintenancePlanToolbar>[data-p-open="workers"]{display:none!important}
#maintenancePlanToolbar>.p-btn{font-size:12px!important;min-height:42px!important;border-radius:16px!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){
 body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app,body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app.native-layout-active{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;grid-template-areas:'topnav topnav topnav' 'brand brand brand' 'ticker ticker ticker' 'summary summary summary' 'filterbutton rows planning' 'filters filters filters' 'cards cards cards'!important;column-gap:8px!important;padding-bottom:calc(var(--r10-nav) + 30px)!important}
 body.mobile-screen-maintenance #mobileFilterToggle,body.mobile-screen-maintenance #rowViewTop,body.mobile-screen-maintenance #maintenancePlanToolbar{align-self:stretch!important;height:44px!important;min-height:44px!important;max-height:44px!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0!important}
 body.mobile-screen-maintenance #mobileFilterToggle,body.mobile-screen-maintenance #rowViewTop{font-size:12px!important;padding:6px 4px!important;border-radius:16px!important;gap:5px!important}
 body.mobile-screen-maintenance #mobileFilterToggle svg,body.mobile-screen-maintenance #rowViewTop svg{width:19px!important;height:19px!important}
 body.mobile-screen-maintenance #maintenancePlanToolbar>.p-btn{width:100%;min-width:0;height:44px!important;min-height:44px!important;font-size:12px!important;padding:5px!important;white-space:nowrap;gap:5px!important}
 body.mobile-screen-maintenance #maintenancePlanToolbar svg{width:19px!important;height:19px!important}
}
@media(min-width:1025px){#mobileBottomNav{max-width:550px!important;margin:auto!important}.app{padding-bottom:85px!important}body.pilot-open #pilotContent{padding-bottom:26px!important}}
@media(max-width:360px){#pilotContent .r10-team-caption h2{font-size:12px}#pilotContent .r10-compose-actions button{font-size:11px!important;gap:4px}.r10-maintenance-button span{font-size:10px!important}.r10-details dd{font-size:11px}.r10-team-row strong{font-size:11px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#permitTicker .r10-permit-status{animation:none!important}#permitTicker .permit-ticker-track{animation:none!important}#permitTicker .permit-ticker-window{overflow-x:auto!important}.r10-personal *{scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

body.pilot-feed-page #mobileBottomNav small,body #mobileBottomNav button small{display:none!important}

/* R11 — report summary and local notification form only. */
:root{--tovati-report-css-ready:1}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-topline{align-items:center!important;gap:12px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-title{font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.3!important;font-weight:800!important;color:#214e70!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-total strong{font-size:30px!important;line-height:1.1!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-report-stamp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:#68899e;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;margin:8px 0 12px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-report-stamp time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.r11-report-light{display:inline-block;flex:0 0 8px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#18b47c;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #19b4821c;animation:r11ReportPulse 1.7s ease-in-out infinite;margin-inline-end:5px}
@keyframes r11ReportPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #19b4821c}50%{opacity:.4;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #19b48206}}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-summary-caption{margin:5px 0 9px;color:#6288a0;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-department-summary{row-gap:10px!important;column-gap:16px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-department-summary .summary-department{min-width:0;gap:6px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-department-summary .summary-department>span{font-size:12px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-width:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-department-summary .summary-department>b{font-size:16px!important;flex:none!important}
/* The prioritization actions are part of the document, not a floating layer. */
body #prioritySessionBar,body .app>#prioritySessionBar{position:static!important;inset:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;top:auto!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;z-index:auto!important;grid-area:priorityfooter!important;grid-column:1/-1!important;align-self:start!important;justify-self:stretch!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;margin:16px 0 0!important;padding:9px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;border:1px solid #bce0f1;border-radius:19px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#eaf8ff);box-shadow:0 4px 13px #176d9710!important}
body #prioritySessionBar[hidden],body.pilot-open #prioritySessionBar{display:none!important}
.r11-open-notification{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;color:#1675ad!important;border:1px solid #b5daec!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#eaf8ff)!important;cursor:pointer}
#r11OpenNotification svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;stroke-width:2}
@media(max-width:1024px){
 body .app,body .app.native-layout-active{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;grid-template-areas:'topnav topnav topnav' 'brand brand brand' 'ticker ticker ticker' 'summary summary summary' 'filterbutton newnotice rows' 'filters filters filters' 'cards cards cards' 'priorityfooter priorityfooter priorityfooter'!important;column-gap:8px!important;padding-bottom:calc(var(--r10-nav) + 25px)!important}

 body .app>#mobileFilterToggle,body .app>#rowViewTop{height:44px!important;min-height:44px!important;padding:5px!important;font-size:12px!important;border-radius:17px!important;gap:5px!important;white-space:nowrap!important}

 body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app>#mobileFilterToggle,body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app>#rowViewTop,body.mobile-screen-maintenance #r11OpenNotification,body.mobile-screen-maintenance #maintenancePlanToolbar>.p-btn{font-size:11px!important;gap:4px!important}

 #r11OpenNotification{grid-area:newnotice!important;width:100%!important;position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;height:40px!important;margin:0!important}
