@media(max-width:360px){#mobileSummaryBox .summary-title{font-size:15px!important}#mobileSummaryBox .summary-total strong{font-size:26px!important}#mobileSummaryBox .r11-department-summary .summary-department>span{font-size:11px!important}body.mobile-screen-maintenance #r11OpenNotification,body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app>#rowViewTop,body.mobile-screen-maintenance .app>#mobileFilterToggle,body.mobile-screen-maintenance #maintenancePlanToolbar>.p-btn{font-size:10px!important;gap:2px!important}body.mobile-screen-maintenance #r11OpenNotification svg{width:14px;height:14px}}
/* SAP-inspired fields: a new local workflow, not an SAP transaction. */
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal{width:min(740px,calc(100vw - 20px))!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px)!important;padding:0!important;border:1px solid #badfed!important;border-radius:22px!important;background:#f6fbff!important}
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-head{padding:12px 15px!important;background:#fff!important}
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-head h2{font-size:19px!important}
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-body{padding:12px!important;min-height:0!important;overflow:auto!important;overscroll-behavior:contain}
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-foot{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr 1.3fr!important;gap:8px!important;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;background:#fff!important;border-top:1px solid #d1e6f3!important;flex:none!important}
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-foot button{font-size:13px!important;min-height:42px!important;padding:6px 8px!important;min-width:0!important;border-radius:13px!important;white-space:normal!important}
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .r11-save-self{background:#e8f7ff!important;color:#147dad!important;border:1px solid #a9d7ec!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .r11-send-planner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#26bdea,#0d79d5)!important;color:white!important;border:0!important}
.r11-form{display:grid;gap:10px}
.r11-form-intro{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:3px 3px 7px}.r11-form-intro>span{display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:13px;width:40px;height:40px;background:#d9f3ff;color:#0b87c0}.r11-form-intro svg{width:22px;height:22px}.r11-form-intro strong{font-size:15px;color:#254d69;display:block}.r11-form-intro small{font-size:11px;color:#708c9f;display:block;margin-top:3px}
.r11-form-section{border:1px solid #cde4f1;border-radius:16px;padding:12px;background:#fff;min-width:0}
.r11-form-section h3,.r11-form-section>summary{font-size:13px!important;color:#1a5578!important;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:0 0 11px!important;line-height:1.5}
.r11-form-section>summary{cursor:pointer;margin:0!important}.r11-form-section[open]>summary{margin-bottom:11px!important}.r11-form-section>summary>span{font-size:10px;color:#849cab;margin-inline-start:auto}
.r11-form-section h3>b,.r11-form-section>summary>b{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;border-radius:8px;width:22px;height:22px;background:#e5f7ff;color:#0985be;font-size:12px}
.r11-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:11px 12px}.r11-wide{grid-column:1/-1}.r11-form-grid>*,.r11-form-grid label{min-width:0}
#pilotModal .r11-form label{font-size:11px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#65879b!important}
#pilotModal .r11-form input,#pilotModal .r11-form select,#pilotModal .r11-form textarea{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;min-height:40px!important;font:14px/1.4 Arial!important;color:#244d68!important;border:1px solid #c8dfec!important;background:#fafdff!important;border-radius:11px!important;padding:8px!important}
#pilotModal .r11-form textarea{height:90px;resize:vertical;max-height:280px}
#pilotModal .r11-form input[readonly]{background:#edf5fa!important;color:#5f7c90!important}
#pilotModal .r11-form .r11-checkbox{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:38px;padding:6px 7px;background:#f1f9ff;border-radius:10px}
#pilotModal .r11-form .r11-checkbox input{width:17px!important;height:17px!important;min-height:17px!important;padding:0!important;flex:none;accent-color:#138ec3}
#pilotModal .r11-form .r11-checkbox>span{margin:0!important}
.r11-routing-note{border-inline-start:3px solid #48bddd;padding:8px 10px;margin-top:12px;border-radius:8px;background:#edf9ff;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#51809a}
.r11-form-footnote,.r11-local-info{color:#6c889b;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;margin:1px 3px 4px}
.r11-drafts-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.r11-drafts-heading h3{font-size:15px;color:#255c7c;margin:0 0 3px}.r11-drafts-heading span{font-size:11px;color:#7697aa}
.r11-small-primary{border:1px solid #9dd4e9;border-radius:12px;min-height:38px;padding:7px 10px;color:#167da8;background:#e4f7ff;display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font:700 12px Arial;white-space:nowrap}.r11-small-primary svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.r11-drafts>.r11-local-info{margin:10px 0}
.r11-personal-shortcuts{display:flex;gap:9px;margin:0 0 13px;flex-wrap:wrap}.r11-personal-shortcuts button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #b8dff2;border-radius:13px;background:#eaf8ff;color:#197ba4;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}.r11-personal-shortcuts svg{width:19px;height:19px}.r11-personal-shortcuts b{margin-inline-start:7px}
.r11-draft-filters{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow:auto;margin:12px 0;scrollbar-width:thin;padding:2px 0 4px}.r11-draft-filters button{flex:none;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #cfe4f1;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;color:#7391a4;font:12px Arial;cursor:pointer}.r11-draft-filters button.active{background:#dcf5ff;color:#0a82b8;border-color:#98d9ef}
.r11-draft-list{display:grid;gap:10px}.r11-draft-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #cce4f1;border-radius:15px;padding:12px;overflow:hidden}.r11-draft-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:10px;color:#7897a8;flex-wrap:wrap}.r11-stage{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:11px;background:#edf3f8;color:#65839a;display:inline-block}.r11-stage.is-queued{color:#126f9c;background:#dcf3ff}.r11-stage.is-handling{background:#fff2d1;color:#9b7424}.r11-stage.is-closed{background:#dbf6eb;color:#248663}.r11-draft-card h4{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:#295773;margin:9px 0 4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.r11-draft-card p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#728fa1;margin:4px 0}.r11-draft-card small{font-size:10px;color:#7b99a9}.r11-draft-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.r11-draft-actions button{border:1px solid #c4e2f0;background:#f1faff;color:#2086af;border-radius:9px;font-size:11px;min-height:32px;padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.r11-receipt{border:1px solid #bce3d2;background:#ebfaf3;color:#317d61;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:12px}
.r11-detail h3{font-size:18px;margin:13px 0;color:#2b5875;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.r11-detail-text{white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.7;font-size:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.r11-detail dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.r11-detail dl>div{border:1px solid #cfe4ee;border-radius:10px;padding:9px;min-width:0}.r11-detail dt{font-size:10px;color:#7591a4}.r11-detail dd{font-size:12px;color:#295673;margin:3px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media(max-width:420px){#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal{width:calc(100vw - 12px)!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 12px)!important;border-radius:18px!important}#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-body{padding:9px!important}#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-foot{gap:6px!important;padding:8px!important}#pilotModal.r11-notification-modal .p-modal-foot button{font-size:11px!important;padding:6px!important}.r11-form-section{padding:10px}.r11-form-grid{gap:10px 8px}.r11-form-intro small{font-size:10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.r11-report-light{animation:none}}

/* R12 scoped styles. Original home, login, work cards and source banners untouched. */
:root{--tovati-briefing-css-ready:1}
#pilotContent .r12-feed{width:100%;max-width:640px;margin:auto;color:#194761;background:#edf7fe}
.r12-team-top{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f7fdff,#e5f5ff);padding:10px 10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #cae8f6}
.r12-team-frame{border:1.5px solid #56cbeb;border-radius:21px 21px 0 0;background:#f9fdff;overflow:hidden;padding:10px 8px 2px;box-shadow:0 5px 16px #13799c0a}
.r12-team-heading{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 5px 8px}
.r12-team-heading h2{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;margin:0;color:#185575;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.r12-team-heading>span{font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;color:#5c8fa5}
#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail{gap:9px!important;margin:0!important;padding:0 3px 8px!important;scroll-padding-inline:3px}
#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail .r10-person-tile{width:78px;min-width:78px;flex:0 0 78px;min-height:116px;gap:4px}
#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail .r10-person-name{width:78px;font-size:10px;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail .tf-story,#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail .tf-ring{width:64px!important;height:64px!important;min-width:64px!important;max-width:64px!important;min-height:64px!important}
#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail .tf-avatar{width:58px!important;height:58px!important;border-width:2px!important}
#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail .tf-ring{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#57ccef,#1c8ad1)!important;padding:3px!important;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #1b90bb18}
#pilotContent .r12-staff-rail .r10-status{font-size:10px;padding:3px 4px;min-height:23px}
.r12-create{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));padding:5px;background:#dbf3ff;border:1.5px solid #56cbeb;border-top:1px solid #bee5f4;border-radius:0 0 18px 18px;gap:5px}
.r12-create button{border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#197ca8;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-height:38px;font:bold 11px Arial;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 3px;white-space:nowrap}
.r12-create button:first-child{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#20bce8,#1083d7);color:#fff}
.r12-create svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none}
#pilotContent .r12-feed-tabs{padding:10px 0 0;margin:0;gap:4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
#pilotContent .r12-feed-tabs button{font-size:11px;padding:9px 8px;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;flex:1;background:none;color:#688d9f;white-space:nowrap}
#pilotContent .r12-feed-tabs button.active{background:#edf7fe;color:#1376ab;border-color:#22bce5}
.r12-report-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 12px 8px;font-size:11px;color:#5c839b}
.r12-report-tools>span{font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-inline-end:auto;color:#2d6c8a}
.r12-report-tools svg{width:16px;height:16px}
#pilotShell .r12-report-tools select{width:auto!important;max-width:46%;min-height:30px;font-size:11px;padding:3px 5px;border:1px solid #cbe6f5;background:#fff;border-radius:9px}
.r12-briefings{display:grid;gap:13px;padding:0 10px 8px}
.r12-brief{--tone:#137fb5;--tone-light:#e9f8ff;--gradient:linear-gradient(135deg,#36bde7,#0876c6);border:1px solid #c7e2f1;border-radius:19px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 16px #175c8110}
.r12-brief.r12-red{--tone:#d93551;--tone-light:#fff0f3;--gradient:linear-gradient(125deg,#f65b75,#df2d4c 68%,#cb2946)}
.r12-brief.r12-orange{--tone:#b56a12;--tone-light:#fff6e4;--gradient:linear-gradient(125deg,#ffbf5c,#e98d27 70%,#d4781c)}
.r12-brief.r12-green{--tone:#119b80;--tone-light:#eafbf5;--gradient:linear-gradient(125deg,#29c4a4,#0c9a84 75%,#087b71)}
.r12-brief.r12-navy{--tone:#4266b8;--tone-light:#edf2ff;--gradient:linear-gradient(125deg,#6b9ae1,#3c59ad)}
.r12-brief-head{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:11px 12px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,var(--tone-light));min-height:57px}
.r12-rank{width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gradient);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;flex:none;border:2px solid #ffffffcc}
.r12-brief-head>div{min-width:0;flex:1}.r12-brief-head strong{font-size:13px;color:#234e68;display:block}.r12-brief-head small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#738d9a;margin-top:3px;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
.r12-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#416e84;cursor:pointer;flex:none}.r12-icon svg{width:24px;height:24px}
.r12-brief-color{position:relative;isolation:isolate;width:100%;min-height:192px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:16px 17px;overflow:hidden;border:0;background:var(--gradient);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;text-align:center}
.r12-brief-color:after{content:'';position:absolute;width:190px;height:190px;border:1px solid #ffffff1f;border-radius:50%;left:-70px;bottom:-130px;z-index:-1;box-shadow:0 0 0 35px #ffffff0c,0 0 0 70px #ffffff07}
.r12-brief-count{font-size:54px;font-weight:850;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.r12-brief-color>strong{font-size:23px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:800}.r12-brief-color>span:not(.r12-brief-count):not(.r12-brief-watermark){font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;opacity:.95}.r12-brief-color>small{font-size:11px;border:1px solid #ffffff4a;border-radius:20px;padding:3px 11px;background:#ffffff12;margin-top:4px}
.r12-brief-watermark{position:absolute;right:12px;top:12px;opacity:.17;pointer-events:none}.r12-brief-watermark svg{width:56px;height:56px}
.r12-brief footer{padding:8px 9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-height:46px;background:#fff}
.r12-brief footer button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border:0;background:var(--tone-light);color:var(--tone);min-height:32px;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 8px;font:bold 11px Arial;cursor:pointer}.r12-brief footer svg{width:17px;height:17px}.r12-brief footer small{margin-inline-start:auto;color:#7491a3;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.r12-local-note{padding:0 13px 12px;margin:5px 0;font-size:10px;line-height:1.65;color:#7691a3}
.r12-awaiting{margin:4px 0 8px;padding:24px 15px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff,#ecf9ff);border:1px dashed #bbddeb;border-radius:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;text-align:center;color:#427891;font-size:13px}.r12-awaiting>svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:#39acd3}.r12-awaiting p{margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#7495a6;line-height:1.6;max-width:310px}
#pilotContent .r12-field-posts{padding-top:4px}.r12-section-caption{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#53829a;padding:3px}
.r12-list-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:14px}.r12-count-pill{font-size:11px;color:#147bb0;background:#e5f7ff;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 9px}
.r12-brief-list{display:grid;gap:8px}.r12-work-row{padding:12px;border:1px solid #cce4f1;border-radius:15px;background:#f7fcff}.r12-work-row>div{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.r12-work-row bdi{color:#196b93;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}.r12-work-row>strong{display:block;margin:7px 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:#1d4e68}.r12-work-row>small{font-size:11px;color:#7794a5}.r12-op{font-size:10px;border-radius:14px;padding:3px 8px;background:#e5f2fb;color:#346d8d}.r12-op.immediate{color:#b82c49;background:#ffe8ed}.r12-op.today{color:#a67117;background:#fff3d3}.r12-op.tomorrow{color:#137c62;background:#e1f7ec}
.r12-work-row .r12-list-actions{margin-top:8px;justify-content:flex-start;gap:7px}.r12-list-actions button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border:1px solid #b9ddeb;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;min-height:35px;padding:5px 9px;color:#167ba8;font:bold 11px Arial;cursor:pointer}.r12-list-actions svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.r12-publish-receipt{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #b4decf;background:#ecfbf5;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:14px;color:#207a66;font-size:13px}.r12-publish-receipt button{border:0;background:#149c80;border-radius:12px;color:#fff;min-height:36px;padding:5px 12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
/* Day planner */
#pilotContent .r12-planner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;color:#214e69;width:100%;min-width:0}
body[data-pilot-page="planning"] #pilotContent{background:#eef8ff!important;padding:10px!important}
.r12-planner-header{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:7px 2px 10px}.r12-eyebrow{font-size:11px;color:#3989ae}.r12-planner-header h2{margin:3px 0;font-size:23px}.r12-plan-modes{display:flex;gap:3px;border:1px solid #c5e1ef;padding:3px;border-radius:12px;background:#e5f2fa}.r12-plan-modes button{border:0;background:none;color:#6b8a9e;border-radius:9px;min-height:32px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.r12-plan-modes button.active{background:#fff;color:#137eaf;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #21688914}
.r12-date-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c6e0ef;border-radius:15px;padding:7px}.r12-date-nav button{width:36px;min-height:36px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#edf8ff;color:#257eaa;border:1px solid #d3e8f3;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.r12-date-nav button:nth-child(2){width:48px}.r12-date-nav svg{width:19px;height:19px}
#pilotShell .r12-date-nav input{min-height:36px;padding:3px 7px;font-size:13px;background:#fff;border:0;width:auto;flex:1;max-width:100%;min-width:0}
.r12-plan-filters{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:8px 0 12px}
#pilotShell .r12-plan-filters select{min-height:34px;padding:4px 7px;font-size:12px;border-color:#cbe4f2;background:#fafdff;flex:1}
.r12-plan-workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,.7fr) minmax(320px,1.3fr);gap:14px;align-items:start}
.r12-backlog{border:1px solid #c7e5f3;border-radius:18px;padding:10px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#e9f8ff);min-width:0;position:sticky;top:0}
.r12-backlog-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;padding:2px 1px 8px}.r12-backlog-heading strong{font-size:13px}.r12-backlog-heading b{background:#d7f2fd;border-radius:13px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:11px;margin:0 3px;color:#1f83ac}.r12-backlog-heading button{border:0;color:#2085ad;background:none;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}
#pilotShell .r12-backlog input{min-height:33px;font-size:12px;padding:5px 9px;border-color:#cde7f4}
.r12-jobs{overflow-y:auto;max-height:510px;display:grid;gap:7px;margin-top:8px;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;padding-bottom:2px}
.r12-job{position:relative;display:flex;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cce3f1;border-inline-start:4px solid #569dc6;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #195b7610;min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
.r12-job.op-immediate{border-inline-start-color:#ed3d61}.r12-job.op-today{border-inline-start-color:#e7ad35}.r12-job.op-tomorrow{border-inline-start-color:#22b594}.r12-job.is-selected{outline:2px solid #27bbe5;background:#eefbff}
.r12-job-content{min-width:0;flex:1;text-align:right;border:0;background:none;padding:9px 10px;color:#245774;cursor:pointer}.r12-job-content>span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px}.r12-job-content bdi{font-weight:800;color:#25799f}.r12-job-content em{font-size:10px;font-style:normal;border-radius:9px;padding:2px 5px;color:#7596a9;background:#f0f7fb}.r12-job-content>strong{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;margin:4px 0}.r12-job-content>small{font-size:10px;color:#7995a7}
.r12-drag-handle{flex:none;width:38px;padding:7px;min-height:38px;background:#e8f7ff;border:0;border-inline-start:1px solid #d0e9f5;color:#4b90b3;touch-action:none!important;cursor:grab;user-select:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}.r12-drag-handle:active{cursor:grabbing}.r12-drag-handle svg{width:22px;height:22px;pointer-events:none}
.r12-no-jobs{font-size:12px;text-align:center;color:#82a0b2;padding:10px}.r12-jobs>[data-r12-action="more-jobs"]{border:1px solid #c8e5f4;border-radius:10px;padding:7px;background:#f5fcff;color:#3283a9;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px}
.r12-board-section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #bcddea;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;min-width:0}.r12-board-heading{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff,#e9f9ff);border-bottom:1px solid #cfe8f5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:11px 13px;gap:8px}.r12-board-heading strong{font-size:15px}.r12-board-heading small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#6892a7;margin-top:4px}.r12-add-plan{width:35px;height:35px;background:#e2f7ff;border:1px solid #b7e8f8;border-radius:11px;color:#2586b1;cursor:pointer;font-size:25px}
.r12-selection{font-size:11px;background:#f3fbff;color:#508ca8;padding:7px 10px;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid #e1f1f8}
.r12-timeline-scroll{height:570px;max-height:66dvh;min-height:260px;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;position:relative}
.r12-timeline{position:relative;min-width:0;direction:rtl;background:#fbfeff}.r12-hour-row{height:88px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:53px minmax(0,1fr);border-bottom:1px solid #dceef7;box-sizing:border-box}
.r12-hour-row time{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 3px;text-align:center;direction:ltr;color:#6e94a9;border-inline-end:1px solid #d9ebf5;background:#f0f9fe}
.r12-hour-slots{display:grid;grid-template-rows:44px 44px;min-width:0}.r12-hour-slots button{border:0;border-bottom:1px dashed #dfedf5;background:transparent;text-align:center;min-height:0;padding:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a3bbca;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;box-sizing:border-box}.r12-hour-slots button+button{color:#b0c6d3;font-size:10px}.r12-hour-slots button:hover,.r12-hour-slots button:focus-visible{background:#eafaff;outline:2px solid #84cde8;outline-offset:-2px}
.r12-hour-slots .r12-drop-target{background:#bceffa!important;color:#167b9b!important;outline:2px solid #16b9e0;outline-offset:-2px}
.r12-event-layer{position:absolute;inset:0 53px 0 0;pointer-events:none}
.r12-event{position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#f8fcff,#eaf5ff);border:1px solid #afd4ed;border-inline-start:4px solid #3299ce;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;pointer-events:auto;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #08516d0c}
.r12-event.op-immediate{border-inline-start-color:#e84b66;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fff,#fff0f3)}.r12-event.op-today{border-inline-start-color:#eeac34;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fff,#fff6e2)}.r12-event.op-tomorrow{border-inline-start-color:#13ab8c;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fff,#eafbf5)}
.r12-event-body{min-width:0;flex:1;text-align:right;padding:5px 7px;background:none;border:0;color:#2b617f;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden}.r12-event-body>span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px}.r12-event-body small{font-size:9px;color:#6b8c9f}.r12-event-body strong{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;margin:3px 0;overflow:hidden}.r12-event .r12-drag-handle{width:28px;padding:3px;background:#ffffff80}
.r12-drag-ghost{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:240px;pointer-events:none;z-index:2147483500;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#dbf5ff);border:2px solid #1ab9e3;border-radius:14px;padding:11px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px #154e7840;color:#1b5c7e;direction:rtl;box-sizing:border-box;will-change:transform}.r12-drag-ghost strong{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}.r12-drag-ghost small{font-size:11px;color:#188bb6;display:block;margin-top:4px}.r12-dragging{user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;cursor:grabbing}
.r12-drop-confirm{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 12px;background:#e8f9ff;border:1px solid #ace0f0;border-radius:13px;margin-bottom:12px;color:#217ca1;font-size:13px}.r12-drop-confirm svg{width:20px;height:20px}.r12-drop-confirm span{flex-basis:100%;font-size:11px}
#pilotModal.r12-assignment-modal .p-checkboxes{max-height:180px;overflow:auto;padding:5px;border:1px solid #d4eaf5;border-radius:10px}
.r12-planner button:focus-visible,.r12-feed button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #1595c5;outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:760px){.r12-plan-workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:11px}.r12-backlog{position:static;padding:9px}.r12-jobs{max-height:198px}.r12-planner-header h2{font-size:20px}.r12-timeline-scroll{height:440px;max-height:61dvh}.r12-brief-color{min-height:178px}.r12-brief-count{font-size:49px}.r12-brief-color>strong{font-size:21px}.r12-brief-color>span:not(.r12-brief-count):not(.r12-brief-watermark){font-size:11px}.r12-publish-receipt{font-size:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}}
@media(max-width:350px){.r12-create button{font-size:10px;gap:3px}.r12-create svg{width:17px;height:17px}.r12-brief footer button{font-size:10px;padding:5px}.r12-brief footer small{font-size:9px}.r12-report-tools>span{width:100%}.r12-brief-color>strong{font-size:19px}.r12-date-nav{gap:4px;padding:5px}.r12-date-nav button{width:30px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.r12-planner *,.r12-feed *{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important}}

body[data-pilot-page="planning"] #pilotShell>.p-shell-head,body[data-pilot-page="planning"] #pilotShell>.p-local-bar{display:none!important}

:root{--tovati-status-css-ready:1}
/* Status-tab scope prevents changes to the approved header, feed and other panes. */
.work-card .r13-status-panel{display:grid;gap:10px;min-width:0;padding:2px;color:#244c67}
.r13-status-panel svg,.r13-completion-modal svg,.r13-waiting-list svg,.r13-waiting-intro svg{display:inline-block;width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 20px;vertical-align:middle}
.work-card .r13-status-panel label{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:0 0 5px!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700;color:#47728a}
.work-card .r13-status-panel .r13-auto{border:1px solid #bce1f2;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#f9feff,#e9f7ff);border-radius:15px;padding:11px 13px}
.r13-auto-heading{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#4084a6}
.r13-auto-caption{margin-inline-start:auto;font-size:10px;color:#6e91a2;background:#fff8;border:1px solid #d3e7f0;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px}
.r13-auto-value{display:block;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25;margin:6px 0 3px;color:#156eab}
.r13-auto>small{font-size:11px;color:#5c7c91}
.r13-source-statuses{display:flex;gap:5px 12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;font-size:10px;color:#657e8d}
.r13-source-statuses span{border-inline-start:2px solid #a2cce2;padding-inline-start:6px}
.work-card .r13-status-panel .r13-auto.r13-active{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#effffb,#dcf8f1);border-color:#a6dcca}.r13-active .r13-auto-value{color:#127b65}
.work-card .r13-status-panel .r13-auto.r13-waiting{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#fffdf5,#fff2d9);border-color:#f0d495}.r13-waiting .r13-auto-value{color:#a76e13}
.work-card .r13-status-panel .r13-auto.r13-done{background:#e8edf0;border-color:#cbd4db}.r13-done .r13-auto-value{color:#506472}
.work-card .r13-status-panel select{box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%!important;height:43px!important;min-height:43px!important;padding:6px 10px!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.4!important;border:1px solid #c3dde9!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#244c67!important}
.work-card .r13-status-panel .r13-complete{display:flex!important;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%!important;min-height:45px!important;padding:10px 14px!important;margin:0!important;border:1px solid #11967b!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#12b497,#058269)!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:16px!important;font-weight:800!important;box-shadow:0 4px 9px #12846b16!important;cursor:pointer}
.work-card .r13-status-panel .r13-complete:disabled{opacity:1;background:#e1e7ea!important;border-color:#c7d0d5!important;color:#6c7e88!important;box-shadow:none!important;cursor:default}
.work-card .r13-status-panel .r13-improve{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:37px!important;width:100%;padding:7px 12px!important;margin:0!important;border:1px solid #e6d394!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fffdf2,#fff4d5)!important;color:#8b6a1b!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700;box-shadow:none!important}
/* Previous minimum was 98px. 64px is 34.7% shorter, without hiding user text. */
.app #cards .manual .r13-status-panel textarea,.row-detail-overlay .manual .r13-status-panel textarea{box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%!important;min-height:64px!important;height:64px!important;max-height:160px;line-height:1.5!important;padding:8px 10px!important;font-size:14px!important;border:1px solid #c7dde7!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#284f65!important;resize:vertical}
.r13-status-panel>div:empty{display:none}
.r13-muted{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#6e8593}.r13-role-note{margin-top:-5px}
.r13-work-details{border-top:1px solid #dce9ef;padding-top:7px}.r13-work-details summary{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;list-style:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;color:#54768a;min-height:29px}.r13-work-details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.r13-work-details summary>span{margin-inline-start:auto}.r13-detail-body{padding:8px}.r13-detail-body p{margin:3px 0 10px;font-size:12px}.r13-detail-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px}.r13-assigned{display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:12px;padding:7px 0}.r13-assigned small{font-size:11px;color:#708896}
.r13-completion-note{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #cbd6dc;border-radius:12px;background:#f0f4f6;color:#3e616f;font-size:12px}.r13-completion-note p{margin:4px 0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.r13-completion-note small{font-size:10px;color:#78909c}
.r13-wait-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:9px;border:1px solid #f1d59c;border-radius:12px;background:#fff7e8;color:#9b6b21;cursor:pointer;text-align:right}.r13-wait-link>span{flex:1;display:grid;gap:2px}.r13-wait-link b{font-size:12px}.r13-wait-link small{font-size:11px}
/* Completed cards keep their data and controls readable, while their frame/surfaces turn gray. */
.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed{background:#edf0f3!important;border-color:#b9c4cc!important;border-top-color:#9daeb9!important;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #68778614!important}
.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed>.card-tabs,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .card-pane-stack,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .card-pane,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .general-pane .card-head,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .general-pane .summary{background:#edf0f3!important}
.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .card-tab{background:#edf0f3!important;color:#647989!important}.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .card-tab.active{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#8a9ba8,#637b8c)!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .id,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .elapsed-chip,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .ops-notes-toggle{background:#f6f8f9!important;border-color:#cdd7df!important;color:#526b7b!important}
.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .desc,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .priority-collapsed-title{color:#627785!important}.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .quick button{background:#d8e0e5!important;color:#697e8a!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-color:#c4cfd7!important;outline:0!important}
.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .priority,.app #cards#cards article.work-card.work-completed .notification-type-badge{background:#e1e7eb!important;color:#637784!important;border-color:#c4cfd7!important;animation:none!important}
/* Shared modal uses native <dialog>, keeping confirmation above all screens. */
#pilotModal.r13-completion-modal{width:min(510px,calc(100vw - 20px));border-radius:20px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 22px)}
.r13-finish-head{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #bce5d9;border-radius:14px;background:#f0fbf6;color:#236b57;margin-bottom:16px}.r13-finish-head>svg{width:28px;height:28px;flex-basis:28px}.r13-finish-head strong{font-size:17px}.r13-finish-head p{margin:6px 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45}.r13-finish-head small{color:#6c897e;font-size:11px}
#pilotModal .r13-finish-label{display:flex;gap:6px;font-weight:700;color:#3d6c7c;margin-bottom:7px}#pilotModal #r13FinishText{height:96px;min-height:96px;resize:vertical;font-size:16px;border-radius:12px}
.r13-word-hint{font-size:11px;color:#9a7638;margin:6px 0 14px}.r13-word-hint.ready{color:#18896d}#pilotModal .r13-ack{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;margin:10px 0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}#pilotModal .r13-ack input{margin:2px 0 0;flex-shrink:0}
.r13-local-note{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#708795;background:#f4f8fa;padding:10px;border-radius:10px}
#pilotModal.r13-completion-modal #pilotSubmit{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#12ad90,#078469);border-color:#0d9479;border-radius:12px;color:#fff}#pilotModal.r13-completion-modal #pilotSubmit:disabled{opacity:.38}
.r13-waiting-intro{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:15px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff8ec,#fff);border:1px solid #ecd3a2;border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:14px}.r13-waiting-intro h2{font-size:21px;margin:0;color:#725322}.r13-waiting-intro p{font-size:12px;color:#8e846f;margin:5px 0 0}.r13-waiting-intro>b{margin-inline-start:auto;font-size:27px;color:#b28232}.r13-waiting-icon{color:#b78534}.r13-waiting-list{display:grid;gap:12px}.r13-waiting-card{padding:15px;border:1px solid #d8e5ed;border-inline-start:4px solid #e9b34a;border-radius:17px;background:#fff}.r13-waiting-card h3{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;margin:9px 0 4px}.r13-waiting-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:13px;color:#45748a}.r13-waiting-top>span:first-child{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.r13-wait-count{font-size:10px;border:1px solid #eddaa9;background:#fff5dd;color:#b18431;border-radius:20px;padding:3px 8px}.r13-wait-reasons{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.r13-wait-reasons span{font-size:11px;padding:4px 9px;background:#fff5e6;color:#9d702d;border-radius:12px}.r13-wait-detail{font-size:12px;color:#6e8593}.r13-waiting-card .p-row{margin:10px 0 0}
@media(min-width:750px){.r13-waiting-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

/* R14 only: daily PDF report settings, archive and feed publication. */
:root{--tovati-daily-css-ready:1}
#pilotContent .r14-settings{max-width:1080px;margin:auto;color:#173e59;display:grid;gap:16px}
#pilotContent .r14-hero{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:22px;border-radius:23px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff,#e8f7ff);border:1px solid #c8e5f4}
#pilotContent .r14-hero>span,.r14-doc-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 48px;width:48px;height:48px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#26c7ed,#0875d8);border-radius:15px;color:white}
#pilotContent .r14-hero svg,.r14-doc-icon svg{width:26px;height:26px}
#pilotContent .r14-hero h2{margin:3px 0 6px;font-size:24px}#pilotContent .r14-hero p{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:#4c758e}#pilotContent .r14-hero small{color:#4b819e;font-size:12px}
#pilotContent .r14-runtime-note{border:1px solid #e5d49c;background:#fffae9;padding:15px 17px;border-radius:16px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#79642c}
#pilotContent .r14-runtime-note p{margin:5px 0 0}
#pilotContent .r14-config{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;background:#fff;padding:18px;border:1px solid #cde4f0;border-radius:18px}
#pilotContent .r14-config .r14-check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
#pilotContent .r14-config-status{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0;color:#34806c;font-size:12px}
#pilotContent .r14-primary-actions,.r14-feed-actions,.r14-tile-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#pilotContent .r14-btn,#pilotModal .r14-btn{border:1px solid #bcddea;background:#fff;color:#195b83;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:42px;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:13px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:none}
#pilotContent .r14-btn.primary,#pilotModal .r14-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25bfea,#0874d6);border:1px solid #27afe3;color:white}
#pilotContent .r14-btn svg,#pilotModal .r14-btn svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none}
#pilotContent .r14-btn:disabled,#pilotModal .r14-btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}
#pilotContent .r14-btn:focus-visible,#pilotModal .r14-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #30abd1;outline-offset:2px}
#pilotContent .r14-progress{font-size:13px;color:#a94c22;line-height:1.5;padding-inline:4px}#pilotContent .r14-progress:empty{display:none}
#pilotContent .r14-rules{background:#f6fbff;padding:16px;border:1px solid #d4e8f3;border-radius:17px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
#pilotContent .r14-rules summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:#225f83}#pilotContent .r14-rules ol{padding-inline-start:22px}
#pilotContent .r14-archive{border:1px solid #d0e7f3;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;padding:18px}#pilotContent .r14-archive h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px}
#pilotContent .r14-archive-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid #dfedf5}
#pilotContent .r14-archive-row strong{display:block}#pilotContent .r14-archive-row small{font-size:12px;color:#5b8097;display:block;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5}#pilotContent .r14-archive-row>div:last-child{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-shrink:0}
#pilotContent .r14-footer-note,#pilotModal .r14-footer-note{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#718995;margin:0}
#pilotContent .r14-empty{padding:18px;color:#6b8799;line-height:1.65;font-size:14px}
#pilotContent .r14-settings-tile{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 20px;padding:19px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#f5fcff,#deeffa);border:1px solid #91d8f3;border-radius:20px}
#pilotContent .r14-settings-tile h2{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 5px}#pilotContent .r14-settings-tile p{font-size:13px;color:#547b93;margin:0}#pilotContent .r14-tile-actions{margin-inline-start:auto}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-reports{display:grid;gap:14px;padding:12px 12px 8px}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-report{border:1px solid #80c9e6;border-radius:21px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#e8f7ff);box-shadow:0 6px 20px #127cb314}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px 14px 8px}#pilotContent .r14-feed-head>div{min-width:0;flex:1}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-head strong{display:block;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}#pilotContent .r14-feed-head small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#638096;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-head .r14-doc-icon{width:40px;height:40px;flex-basis:40px;border-radius:12px}
#pilotContent .r14-icon{width:38px;height:38px;min-width:38px;flex:0 0 38px;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:23px;cursor:pointer;color:#225e7e;padding:0;box-shadow:none}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-counts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;padding:15px 14px;text-align:center}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-counts>div{background:#fff9;padding:10px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #c6e9f5}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-counts b{display:block;font-size:28px;color:#0877ba;line-height:1.1}#pilotContent .r14-feed-counts span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#568198;margin-top:7px}
#pilotContent .r14-feed-actions{padding:0 14px 12px}#pilotContent .r14-feed-actions .r14-btn{flex:1}
#pilotContent .r14-delivery{display:block;border-top:1px solid #d4e8f3;padding:8px 14px 11px;font-size:10px;color:#698698;line-height:1.4}
#pilotModal.r14-report-modal{width:min(1240px,98vw);max-width:98vw}
#pilotModal .r14-report-preview{color:#173e59;direction:rtl}#pilotModal .r14-report-preview header h3{font-size:22px;margin:16px 0 6px}#pilotModal .r14-report-preview header p{font-size:13px;color:#607f96}
#pilotModal .r14-source-warning{padding:11px;background:#fff7df;border-radius:12px;color:#987135;font-size:12px}
#pilotModal .r14-report-group{margin:15px 0 22px;border:1px solid #cfe6f3;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
#pilotModal .r14-report-group h4{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#e9f7ff;color:#1b5f85;margin:0;padding:12px;font-size:15px}
#pilotModal .r14-report-group h4 span{font-size:13px;background:#fff;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:30px}
#pilotModal .r14-report-group>p{padding:4px 12px;color:#67899b;font-size:13px}
#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll{overflow:auto;max-height:60vh;overscroll-behavior:contain;touch-action:pan-x pan-y}
#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll table{border-collapse:collapse;min-width:1150px;width:100%;text-align:right;font-size:12px}
#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#17648b;color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:10px;white-space:nowrap}
#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll td{padding:10px;vertical-align:top;border:1px solid #dfecf3;white-space:pre-wrap;max-width:240px;min-width:86px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll td:nth-child(3){min-width:210px}#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll td small{display:block;color:#5b7f95;margin-top:3px}#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll tr:nth-child(2n){background:#f4faff}#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll tr.is-done{background:#edf0f2}#pilotModal .r14-table-scroll .is-unprioritized{color:#ae4b31;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:640px){#pilotContent .r14-config{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding:13px;gap:12px}#pilotContent .r14-config .r14-btn{grid-column:1/-1}#pilotContent .r14-hero{padding:16px;gap:10px}#pilotContent .r14-hero h2{font-size:20px}#pilotContent .r14-primary-actions .r14-btn{flex:1 1 42%;font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px}#pilotContent .r14-tile-actions{width:100%;margin:0}#pilotContent .r14-tile-actions .r14-btn{flex:1;font-size:12px}#pilotContent .r14-archive-row{flex-wrap:wrap}#pilotContent .r14-feed-head strong{font-size:14px}#pilotContent .r14-feed-counts{gap:6px;padding:12px}#pilotContent .r14-feed-counts span{font-size:11px}#pilotContent .r14-feed-counts b{font-size:24px}}

:root{--tovati-enhancements-css-ready:1}
/* R15: completion folds are UI state, never source-data changes. */
.work-card>.r15-completed-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:10px 13px;border:0;background:#eaf0f4;color:#526979;cursor:pointer;text-align:right;font:700 14px/1.5 Arial;border-radius:0;min-height:40px;box-shadow:none}
.work-card>.r15-completed-toggle span{overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-width:0;flex:1}
.work-card>.r15-completed-toggle svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;color:#7a8e9a}
.work-card>.r15-completed-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.work-card.r15-completed-collapsed{min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;border:1px solid #b9c8d2!important;border-top:3px solid #9caeb9!important;padding:0!important;background:#eaf0f4!important;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 44px!important;content-visibility:visible!important}
.work-card.r15-completed-collapsed>:not(.r15-completed-toggle){display:none!important}
.work-card.r15-completed-collapsed>.r15-completed-toggle{display:flex!important;height:41px!important;min-height:0!important;padding:7px 12px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-report-top{display:flex!important;gap:9px!important;align-items:center!important;margin:0!important;padding:0 0 9px!important;border-bottom:1px solid #d4e6f0!important;min-width:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-title-group{flex:1;min-width:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-title{font:700 17px/1.35 Arial!important;white-space:normal!important;color:#195473}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-total{display:block!important;flex:none;min-width:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-total strong{font-size:28px!important;line-height:1.1!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-report-stamp{margin:4px 0 0!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;font-size:11px!important;gap:6px!important;line-height:1.4}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-report-light{width:7px;height:7px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-summary-toggle{display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;flex:0 0 32px!important;min-width:32px!important;min-height:32px!important;width:32px!important;height:32px!important;border:1px solid #d2e7f0!important;background:#effaff!important;border-radius:50%!important;padding:5px!important;color:#2086b5!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-summary-toggle svg{width:18px;height:18px}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .r15-summary-toggle svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded{padding-top:10px!important;padding-bottom:10px!important;min-height:0!important;overflow-anchor:none}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .r15-report-top{padding-bottom:0!important;border-bottom:0!important}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .r11-report-stamp,#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .r15-report-body{display:none!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-report-body{padding-top:10px}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-departments{gap:6px!important;padding:0!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-department{padding:7px 8px!important;background:#f2f9fc;border:1px solid #e1eef5;border-radius:10px;gap:5px!important;min-width:0;align-items:center}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-department span{font-size:12px!important;min-width:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-department b{font-size:18px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-section small{font-size:10px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-priority-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;margin:10px 0 8px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-stat{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;border:1px solid #d6e7f0;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:7px 8px;min-width:0;font-size:11px;color:#4c6a7b}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-stat b{font-size:16px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-stat-emergency,#mobileSummaryBox .r15-stat-urgent{background:#fff2f3;border-color:#f4d3da;color:#a4384d}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-urgent-percent{border:1px solid #66c3ee;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#e4f7ff,#ccecff);border-radius:13px;padding:10px 12px;color:#165779}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-urgent-percent>div{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-urgent-percent strong{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;direction:ltr;color:#057bbd}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-urgent-percent span{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-urgent-percent small{display:block;font-size:10px;margin-top:3px;color:#4b7189}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-filter-note{font-size:11px!important;padding:8px 0 0!important;margin:8px 0 0!important}
.app>#permitTicker,.app.native-layout-active>#permitTicker{border-left:0!important;border-right:0!important;border-top:2px solid #34bfe8!important;border-bottom:2px solid #34bfe8!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){.app>#permitTicker,.app.native-layout-active>#permitTicker{width:100vw!important;max-width:100vw!important;justify-self:center!important;margin-inline:0!important}}
/* Finish-prioritizing recaps occupy the normal card region, not a full-screen layer. */
body.priority-summary-mode .r15-priority-summary{position:static!important;inset:auto!important;width:100%!important;max-width:900px!important;margin:auto!important;min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;display:block!important;padding:12px!important;border:1px solid #b8ddf1;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 14px #1747650c}
.r15-priority-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #d8e9f1;padding-bottom:8px;font-size:15px;color:#174e6b}
.r15-priority-header span{font-size:12px}.r15-priority-header b{color:#0783bd;font-size:20px}
.r15-priority-table-scroll{max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.r15-priority-table{border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;width:100%;min-width:290px;font:12px/1.4 Arial;color:#335b70}
.r15-priority-table th,.r15-priority-table td{padding:8px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5f0f5;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle}
.r15-priority-table th:first-child{width:42%;text-align:right;font-weight:600}.r15-priority-table thead{font-size:10px;color:#6a8192}
.r15-priority-table tbody td{font-size:17px;font-weight:700}.r15-priority-table bdi{font-size:10px;color:#6b8795}
.r15-priority-table .is-immediate{color:#b83754}.r15-priority-table .is-today{color:#967218}.r15-priority-table .is-tomorrow{color:#12876f}
.r15-priority-summary>small{display:block;font-size:11px;margin-top:8px;color:#668396}
.r15-priority-summary .r12-publish-receipt{padding:7px 9px!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0 0 10px!important;font-size:10px!important;border-radius:10px!important;gap:6px!important}
.r15-priority-summary .r12-publish-receipt button{padding:6px 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;min-height:30px!important}
#cards:has(.r15-priority-summary){scroll-margin-top:65px}
/* Settings and initial automatic plan. */
.r15-settings-entry{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #aadcf4;border-radius:19px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#f5fcff,#ddf4ff);margin-bottom:14px;color:#195678}
.r15-settings-entry>span{display:grid;place-items:center;background:#d4effe;border-radius:13px;width:44px;height:44px;flex:none}
.r15-settings-entry svg,.r15-auto-hero svg{width:26px;height:26px}.r15-settings-entry>div{flex:1}.r15-settings-entry h2{margin:0;font-size:19px}.r15-settings-entry p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:12px}
.r15-primary,.r15-plan-shortcut button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:42px;border:1px solid #099bdd;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#1dbce8,#087ed5);color:#fff;font:700 14px/1.3 Arial;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.r15-primary svg,.r15-plan-shortcut svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none}.r15-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.r15-auto-page{max-width:960px;margin:auto;direction:rtl;color:#244e68}.r15-auto-hero{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 16px;padding:16px;background:#e9f7ff;border:1px solid #beddF0;border-radius:19px}.r15-auto-hero h2{margin:2px 0;font-size:23px}.r15-auto-hero small{font-size:11px}.r15-auto-hero p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:13px}
#r15AutoForm{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1e6f1;border-radius:18px;padding:14px}#r15AutoForm fieldset{border:0;margin:0;padding:0;min-width:0}
.r15-auto-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.r15-auto-grid label{min-width:0;font-size:12px}.r15-auto-grid input,.r15-auto-grid select{margin-top:4px}
.r15-auto-checks{display:grid;gap:9px;margin:16px 0}.r15-auto-checks label{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px}.r15-auto-checks input{width:19px!important;min-height:19px!important;height:19px}
.r15-details{border:1px solid #d8e8f1;border-radius:12px;margin:12px 0;padding:10px;background:#f7fcff}.r15-details summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;min-height:26px}.r15-details summary svg{width:18px;height:18px;vertical-align:middle}.r15-details p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.r15-section-caps{max-height:320px;overflow:auto}.r15-section-caps label{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #dfedf5;padding-bottom:6px}.r15-section-caps small{display:block;font-size:10px}.r15-section-caps input{max-width:90px!important}
.r15-generate{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:12px;background:#e9f7ff;border-radius:14px;padding:13px;margin:14px 0}.r15-generate label{flex:1}.r15-planning-note{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#607b8e;border-right:3px solid #a8d5ec;padding:8px 10px;background:#f5fbff}
.r15-proposal{margin:16px 0}.r15-proposal header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.r15-proposal h3{font-size:19px;margin:8px 0}.r15-proposal-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin:8px 0 14px}.r15-proposal-metrics span{padding:9px;background:#e8f6ff;border-radius:11px;text-align:center;font-size:11px}.r15-proposal-metrics b{display:block;font-size:23px;color:#147bb2}
.r15-proposal-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.r15-proposal-list article{padding:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c9e2f1;border-radius:15px;border-top:3px solid #24b6e3}.r15-proposal-list article>div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px}.r15-proposal-list strong{display:block;margin:8px 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4}.r15-proposal-list p{margin:5px 0;font-size:12px}.r15-proposal-list small{font-size:11px;color:#647e8f}.r15-proposal-list em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;color:#8b641c;background:#fff7df;padding:5px;border-radius:6px}
.r15-kind{background:#e9f6fd;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;color:#2281ad}.r15-unscheduled{padding:7px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddebf3}.r15-unscheduled strong,.r15-unscheduled span{display:block;font-size:12px}.r15-unscheduled span{color:#956d35;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}
.r15-plan-shortcut{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin:0 0 8px}.r15-plan-shortcut button{font-size:12px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 11px}
/* A linked feed item renders the same card, without limiting the status panel. */
.r15-workpost{margin:12px 0;background:#f8fcff;border:1px solid #bcdeef;border-radius:19px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #237dae10}.r15-workpost .tf-post-head{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff,#e6f5ff)}
.r15-workpost-note{padding:0 12px;font-size:13px;color:#476575}.r15-feed-work{padding:8px;min-width:0}.r15-feed-work .work-card{margin:0!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;content-visibility:visible!important;min-height:0!important}
.r15-feed-work .card-tabs{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
.r15-feed-work .card-tab{font-size:13px!important;height:39px!important;padding:4px!important;min-width:0!important}
.r15-feed-work .card-pane-stack{display:block!important}.r15-feed-work .hidden{display:none!important}
.r15-feed-work .pane{min-height:0!important}.r15-feed-work .id{min-width:0!important}.r15-feed-work .id b{font-size:10px!important}.r15-feed-work .id strong{font-size:17px!important}
.r15-feed-work .notification-headline{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.4!important}.r15-feed-work .quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.r15-feed-work .quick button{font-size:13px!important;min-height:37px!important}
.r15-feed-work .r13-complete{width:100%}.r15-feed-work .general-pane .summary-grid{gap:5px}
.r15-feed-work .r13-panel{padding:8px}.r15-feed-work .r13-panel select{font-size:14px}.r15-embedded-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;padding:8px}
.r15-embedded-actions button{font-size:11px;min-height:36px;padding:5px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #c5dfef;background:#edf8ff;color:#1e6b95}.r15-embedded-actions .primary{background:#1597dd;color:white}
.r15-workpost>.tf-comments-link{padding:10px 14px!important;display:flex;gap:6px}.r15-workpost>.tf-comments-link svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.r15-work-unavailable{font-size:13px;padding:18px}.r12-create.r15-create{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important}.r12-create.r15-create button{font-size:11px!important;gap:5px!important;padding:10px 3px!important;min-width:0}.r12-create.r15-create svg{width:20px;height:20px}
@media(max-width:640px){.r15-settings-entry{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:13px}.r15-settings-entry>.r15-primary{width:100%}.r15-auto-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.r15-proposal-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}.r15-generate{gap:8px}.r15-generate .r15-primary{font-size:12px;padding:9px}.r15-priority-table{font-size:11px}.r15-priority-table th:first-child{width:40%}.r15-priority-table tbody td{font-size:16px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.r15-summary-toggle{transition:none}}

/* R16 maintenance action attention + compact preventive cards */
:root{--tovati-r16-ready:1}
@keyframes r16AttentionPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(17,183,227,.15),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55);transform:translateZ(0)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(17,183,227,.20),0 8px 18px rgba(13,123,188,.22),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75)}}
.r16-action-attention{animation:r16AttentionPulse 1s ease-in-out infinite!important;border-color:#27bfe8!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eefdff,#d6f4ff)!important;color:#0872a6!important;font-weight:900!important}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.r16-action-attention{animation:none!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(17,183,227,.16)!important}}
body[data-pilot-page="preventive"] #pilotContent{padding-top:8px!important}
body[data-pilot-page="preventive"] .p-inner{max-width:980px!important}
.pm-screen{display:grid;gap:10px}.pm-screen-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #d1e6f2;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,#f2faff)}
.pm-screen-head h2{margin:2px 0 4px;font-size:22px;color:#164b70}.pm-screen-head p{margin:0;color:#617f94;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.pm-screen-head .u-eyebrow{font-size:11px}
.pm-filter-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1.7fr) minmax(145px,.8fr) minmax(145px,.8fr);gap:8px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d5e6ef;border-radius:16px;background:#fff}.pm-filter-bar label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#627f91}.pm-filter-bar input,.pm-filter-bar select{height:38px;border:1px solid #c8dfeb;border-radius:10px;background:#fafdff;color:#173f59;padding:6px 9px;font:inherit}.pm-screen-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:#638093;font-size:12px}.pm-screen-meta>div{display:flex;gap:6px}
.pm-card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.pm-month-card{display:grid;gap:8px;min-width:0;padding:13px;border:1px solid #cfe3ef;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff,#f5fbff);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(20,91,136,.07);content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:280px}.pm-month-card.is-open{border-top:4px solid #21a9d8}.pm-month-card.is-upcoming{border-top:4px solid /* R17 — WhatsApp-like local messaging */
:root{--tovati-chat-css-ready:1}
body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotShell{top:0!important;bottom:calc(55px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;z-index:2200!important;background:#eef7fc!important}
body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotShell .p-shell-head,
body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotShell .p-local-bar,
body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotStorageWarning{display:none!important}
body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotContent{padding:0!important;background:#eef7fc!important;overflow:hidden!important}
body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotContent>.p-inner{height:100%;max-width:760px!important;padding:0!important;margin:0 auto!important}
.r17-wa{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#f4fbff;color:#173f59;overflow:hidden}
.r17-wa-header,.r17-chat-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0e82d4,#24b8e5);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(5,82,133,.18);flex:0 0 auto}
.r17-wa-header>div,.r17-chat-header>div{min-width:0;flex:1}.r17-wa-header h2{margin:0;font-size:24px}.r17-wa-header small,.r17-chat-header small{display:block;color:#e5f7ff;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.r17-chat-header strong{display:block;font-size:16px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.r17-round,.r17-back{width:42px;height:42px;min-width:42px;border:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff;cursor:pointer}.r17-round svg{width:22px;height:22px}.r17-round.subtle{font-size:22px}.r17-back{font-size:34px;line-height:1}
.r17-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:12px 14px 8px;padding:0 13px;height:44px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d4e6f1;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(13,78,119,.06);flex:0 0 auto}.r17-search svg{width:19px;height:19px;color:#6a8598}.r17-search input{border:0!important;background:transparent!important;min-height:0!important;height:40px!important;padding:0!important;outline:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;font-size:14px!important}
.r17-pinned-title,.r17-list-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 18px 6px;color:#5b788e;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;flex:0 0 auto}.r17-list-title button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#0b7ec1;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.r17-chat-list{background:#fff;border-top:1px solid #d9e8f1;border-bottom:1px solid #d9e8f1;flex:0 0 auto}.r17-groups{max-height:306px;overflow:auto}.r17-conversation{width:100%;min-height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:8px 14px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #edf3f7;background:#fff;color:inherit;text-align:right;cursor:pointer}.r17-conversation:last-child{border-bottom:0}.r17-conversation:active{background:#eef8fd}.r17-conversation-copy{min-width:0;flex:1}.r17-conversation-copy strong{display:block;font-size:15px;color:#153f5d}.r17-conversation-copy small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#6e8798;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:12px}.r17-conversation-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}.r17-conversation-meta time{font-size:10px;color:#7890a0}.r17-conversation-meta b{min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#16a7d9;color:#fff;font-size:10px}
.r17-group-avatar{width:48px;height:48px;min-width:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#e3f7ff,#b8e6f8);border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #a9d7e9;color:#0d6da2;font-size:22px}.r17-group-avatar.section{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#dbf7ff,#b7e9f7)}.r17-group-avatar.department{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#e5f5ff,#c4ddfa)}.r17-group-avatar.overhaul{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff4d9,#ffe0a0)}.r17-group-avatar.small{width:42px;height:42px;min-width:42px;font-size:19px}
.r17-empty{padding:24px;text-align:center;color:#6d8799}.r17-empty b{display:block;color:#305a74;margin-bottom:4px}.r17-empty span{font-size:12px}.r17-legacy{margin:10px 14px;border:1px solid #d2e6f1;border-radius:15px;background:#fff;padding:8px 12px;max-height:180px;overflow:auto}.r17-legacy summary{font-weight:800;color:#41687f;cursor:pointer}.r17-legacy article{padding:8px 2px;border-top:1px solid #edf3f6}.r17-legacy small{float:left;color:#8599a6}.r17-legacy p{margin:4px 0 0}.r17-local-warning{margin:auto 14px 12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:#eaf7fc;color:#668195;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;border:1px solid #cfe6f1}
.r17-chat{background:#e7f3f8;position:relative}.r17-chat-header{padding:10px 12px}.r17-chat-wall{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:14px 10px 18px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(236,248,252,.92),rgba(236,248,252,.92)),radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%,#bbddea 1px,transparent 1.5px);background-size:auto,24px 24px;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}.r17-day{width:max-content;max-width:90%;margin:8px auto;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:9px;background:#d7eaf2;color:#5f7787;font-size:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(13,69,103,.08)}.r17-bubble-row{display:flex;margin:5px 0}.r17-bubble-row.mine{justify-content:flex-start}.r17-bubble-row.theirs{justify-content:flex-end}.r17-bubble{max-width:82%;padding:7px 10px 5px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(9,61,94,.12);background:#fff;color:#173f59;position:relative}.r17-bubble-row.mine .r17-bubble{background:#d5f3fb;border-bottom-left-radius:4px}.r17-bubble-row.theirs .r17-bubble{border-bottom-right-radius:4px}.r17-bubble p{margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}.r17-bubble span{display:block;text-align:left;margin-top:2px;font-size:9px;color:#738c9b}.r17-sender{display:block;margin-bottom:3px;color:#0787c0;font-size:11px}.r17-first-message{max-width:85%;margin:30px auto;text-align:center;padding:16px;border-radius:14px;background:#dff2f8;color:#587588}.r17-first-message b,.r17-first-message span{display:block}.r17-first-message span{font-size:12px;margin-top:4px}
.r17-composer{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;padding:8px 9px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:#f6fbfd;border-top:1px solid #d5e6ef;flex:0 0 auto}.r17-composer textarea{flex:1;resize:none;max-height:120px;min-height:42px!important;padding:10px 14px!important;border-radius:22px!important;border:1px solid #cfe2ec!important;background:#fff!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.4!important}.r17-composer button{width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#23b9df,#087bc5);color:#fff;font-size:22px;transform:scaleX(-1);cursor:pointer}
.r17-contact-search select{height:48px!important}.r17-modal-note{color:#6b8394;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.r17-info header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}.r17-info h3{margin:0}.r17-info p{margin:3px 0 0;color:#6a8496}.r17-member-list{margin-top:10px;display:grid;gap:6px;max-height:390px;overflow:auto}.r17-member-list>div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf2f5}.r17-member-list span{min-width:0}.r17-member-list b,.r17-member-list small{display:block}.r17-member-list small{color:#7690a1;font-size:10px}
@media(max-width:640px){body[data-pilot-page="messages"] #pilotShell{bottom:calc(55px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important}.r17-wa-header{padding:11px 13px}.r17-wa-header h2{font-size:21px}.r17-search{margin:9px 10px 6px}.r17-pinned-title,.r17-list-title{padding-inline:14px}.r17-conversation{padding-inline:11px}.r17-groups{max-height:250px}.r17-chat-wall{padding-inline:8px}.r17-bubble{max-width:86%}}

/* R18 — chat attachments and work-order sharing */
:root{--tovati-chat-attach-ready:1}
.r18-composer{gap:7px}.r18-composer .r18-attach-button{transform:none!important;background:#eef8fd!important;color:#0879bb!important;border:1px solid #c7e2ef!important;font-size:26px!important;font-weight:300!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.r18-composer>button[type="submit"]{transform:scaleX(-1)}
.r18-attach-menu{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.r18-attach-menu button{display:grid;place-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:112px;border:1px solid #cde5f2;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff,#eef9ff);color:#124d72;font-size:28px;cursor:pointer}.r18-attach-menu button span{display:grid;gap:2px;text-align:center}.r18-attach-menu button b{font-size:14px}.r18-attach-menu button small{font-size:10px;color:#6d8798}
.r18-chat-media{display:block;width:min(280px,70vw);max-width:100%;max-height:330px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;background:#d9e9f1}.r18-chat-image-btn{display:block;padding:0!important;margin:0 0 4px!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;border-radius:12px!important;overflow:hidden;transform:none!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important}.r18-chat-image-btn .r18-chat-media{cursor:zoom-in}.r17-bubble.media-missing:before{content:'המדיה אינה זמינה במכשיר';display:block;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#f5e9e9;color:#9a4b4b;font-size:11px}
.r18-work-card{display:grid;gap:5px;width:min(310px,72vw);padding:11px 12px!important;margin:0 0 4px!important;border:1px solid #acdced!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fafdff,#e9f7fd)!important;color:#173f59!important;text-align:right!important;transform:none!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;cursor:pointer}.r18-work-card strong{font-size:14px;line-height:1.4}.r18-work-card>span,.r18-work-card small{font-size:10px;color:#668295;line-height:1.45}.r18-work-top{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.r18-work-top b{font-size:11px;color:#0a78af}.r18-work-top em{font-style:normal;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff2f3;color:#b52d3d;border:1px solid #f0bcc4;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}.r18-share-preview{margin-top:12px}.r18-modal-image{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:70dvh;margin:auto;border-radius:16px;object-fit:contain}
.r18-share-work{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:36px!important;border:1px solid #a8dced!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f2fbff,#e1f5fc)!important;color:#0874a8!important;font-weight:800!important;font-size:12px!important;box-shadow:none!important}.r18-share-work:active{background:#d8f0fa!important}
@media(max-width:640px){.r18-attach-menu{gap:8px}.r18-attach-menu button{min-height:96px;border-radius:17px}.r18-chat-media{width:min(255px,72vw);max-height:300px}.r18-work-card{width:min(280px,75vw)}}


/* R19 — visible inline attachment tray in chat */
:root{--tovati-chat-inline-attach-ready:1}
.r19-attach-tray[hidden]{display:none!important}
.r19-attach-tray{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;padding:10px 10px 8px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4fbff,#eaf7fd);border-top:1px solid #cfe5f1;animation:r19TrayIn .14s ease-out}
.r19-attach-tray button{min-height:68px;border:1px solid #bfe0ef;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;color:#175273;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(10,95,145,.08);cursor:pointer}
.r19-attach-tray button:active{transform:translateY(1px);background:#edf9ff}
.r19-attach-tray button span{font-size:23px;line-height:1}.r19-attach-tray button b{font-size:12px}
.r18-attach-button[aria-expanded="true"]{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#087bc5,#0a5d9f)!important;transform:none!important}
@keyframes r19TrayIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:390px){.r19-attach-tray{gap:6px;padding-inline:8px}.r19-attach-tray button{min-height:62px;border-radius:14px}.r19-attach-tray button b{font-size:11px}}


/* R20 daily report visual redesign */
#mobileSummaryBox{padding:12px 12px 18px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-shell{display:block}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-top{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:space-between!important;gap:12px!important;padding:0!important;border-bottom:0!important;margin:0 0 12px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:0;flex:1}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-badge{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fdff,#eff8ff);border:1px solid #d5e9f5;color:#1877b9;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-badge svg{width:28px;height:28px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-headtext{min-width:0;flex:1}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-title{font:900 21px/1.2 Arial!important;color:#0c4f83!important;white-space:normal!important;margin:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-stamp{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:8px!important;margin-top:8px!important;font-size:13px!important;color:#6b8798!important;justify-content:flex-start!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-stamp time{font-weight:600}
#mobileSummaryBox .r11-report-light{width:14px!important;height:14px!important;border-radius:50%;background:#63d4a3;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(99,212,163,.16)}
#mobileSummaryBox .r15-summary-toggle{width:40px!important;height:40px!important;min-width:40px!important;min-height:40px!important;flex:0 0 40px!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:#f6fbfe!important;border:1px solid #d6eaf5!important;color:#3386b4!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-body{display:grid;gap:14px;padding-top:0!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-summary-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dcecf5;border-radius:26px;padding:18px 16px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(16,84,126,.06)}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-card-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-card-lead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-card-icon{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fdff,#edf7fd);border:1px solid #d9ebf4;color:#1275b7;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 46px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-card-icon svg{width:23px;height:23px}

#mobileSummaryBox .r20-total-block span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#6a8799;margin-bottom:3px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-total-block strong{display:block;font-size:28px;line-height:1;color:#0b73c7;font-weight:900}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:1px solid #dbeaf2;border-radius:18px;padding:12px 12px;background:#fff;min-width:0}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-icon{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 44px;background:#f5fbff;color:#1978bb;border:1px solid #dcebfb}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-copy{min-width:0;display:grid;gap:2px}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-copy span{font-size:13px;color:#6c8494;line-height:1.2}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-copy b{font-size:20px;color:#114a71;line-height:1.1}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-copy small{font-size:10px;color:#8aa0af;line-height:1.2}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-urgent,#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-outage,#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-emergency{background:#fff6f7;border-color:#f0d8df}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-urgent .r20-mini-icon,#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-outage .r20-mini-icon,#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-emergency .r20-mini-icon{background:#fff0f2;border-color:#f2d8de;color:#c83452}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-urgent .r20-mini-copy b,#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-outage .r20-mini-copy b,#mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card.is-emergency .r20-mini-copy b{color:#c52d4f}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-group-grid .r20-mini-card.is-group{background:#fff}

#mobileSummaryBox .r20-percent-inner{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px;font-weight:900;color:#1875bf;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #e4eef5}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-percent-copy{min-width:0;display:grid;gap:4px;flex:1}

#mobileSummaryBox .r20-target-icon{margin-inline-start:auto;flex:0 0 46px}
#mobileSummaryBox .summary-filter-note{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid #e4eef5;padding-top:10px!important;margin-top:2px!important;color:#6c8797;font-size:12px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox .r20-empty-note{padding:10px 0;color:#7691a2;font-size:13px}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded{padding-top:12px!important;padding-bottom:12px!important}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .r20-report-top{margin-bottom:0!important}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .r20-report-stamp,#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .r20-report-body{display:none!important}
#mobileSummaryBox.r15-report-folded .summary-title{font-size:18px!important}
@media (max-width:390px){
  #mobileSummaryBox .r20-report-badge{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:18px}
  #mobileSummaryBox .summary-title{font-size:19px!important}
  #mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-grid{gap:10px}
  #mobileSummaryBox .r20-mini-card{padding:10px}
